tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag chen gaṅgā ma$$ 'i 'grel pa dam pa'i zhal gyi man ngag

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 00000000 ༄༅// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma karma pa// dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas srid zhi'i dpal gyur yi dam rnal 'byor ma// phrin las kun gyi byed por dbang bsgyur chos skyong ber can lcam dral la// rnal 'byor rtse gcig gus pas 'dud do 'bral med thugs rjes skyong bar mdzod// 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i chos zab mo phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i kun slong byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de gsan par gnang ba zhu/ de la gang zhig gsan par bya ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi rim pa ni skabs 'di la/ grub chen tai lo pa zhes bya ba/ nga rang tsho bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad kyi khungs gtug sa/ lhag par du bod la phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag mnga' bdag mar pa jo bo yab sras nas mar brgyud pa'i mthun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i man ngag zab mo la brten nas tshe gcig lus gcig la skad cig de nyid du 'tshang rgya thub pa'i grol lam phyag rgya chen po zhes pa'i nyams len 'di grub chen tai lo pas paṇa chen nā ro pa nas mar gdams ngag don brgyud kyi thog nas thob bsdad pa'i brgyud pa bzang po rmad du byung ba de 'dra zhig red/ nga rang tshos ga ba yin na'ang phyag rgya chen po zer nas bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ phyag chen de la yang rgya bod kyi mkhas pa thams cad kyis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyang du ma/ 'grel pa'i bstan bcos kyang du ma/ man ngag dang khrid kyi lugs srol byas nas brtsams bzhag pa'i dpe cha yang mang po zhig yod red/ yin na yang dpe cha mang che ba de kha cig rgya che drag /lung grangs mang*/ de 'dra red bsdad pa'i skabs su la gdams ngag gcig tu bsgril nas gsungs thub yag de dka' las khag po chags bsdad pa red/

yin na yang 'di'i skabs su grub chen tai lo pa'i phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma 'di gzhung nyung nyung gcig la gdams ngag dang man ngag kho nas rgyan bzhag pa ma gtogs lung dang rigs pa mang po'i spros pa med pa byas nas bzhag bzhag yod red/ gang zag las dang po pa thams cad kyi nyams len byed na'ang bde po/ gang zag dbang po 'bring thams cad kyi nyams len byed na'ang bde po/ gang zag skal pa mchog tu 'gyur pa thams cad kyi nyams len byed na'ang shin tu bde po red bsdad yag gi man ngag dam pa zhig chags bsdad kyi yod red/ 'di gdams ngag mdzod kyi nang la sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad bzhugs pa'i gras la yod red/ sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi nang nas bka' brgyud kyi nang la grub chen tai lo pa'i phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma'i gzhung 'di bzhag yod red/ nga rang zhu sa de skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang chen po dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che mchog gi sku mdun nas zhus pa yin/ spyir btang rang la phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len gang yang yod ma red la 'grel ba bri thub pa dang bshad thub pa'i spobs pa dang nus pa gang yang med/ yin na yang brgyud pa'i byin rlabs zer yag de rtsa ba chen po yin pa dang*/ khyad par du gtso bo'i dmigs yul 'di bal yul ban chen sgrub theng dang po tshor go bde po byed nas zhu na yag po zhig red 'gro sa red bsam pa'i kun slong dang brgyud pa gcig kyang red 'gro gi red/ de yi phyir zhu ba yin/ 00000000 ༄༅// grub chen tai lo pa'i phyag rgya chen po gad+gā ma'i gzhung sa bcad 'grel pa dang bcas pa bzhugs so// 00000000 tai lo pas nā ro pa la shar chu bo gaṅgā ma'i 'gram du gsungs bzhag pa yin dus phyag rgya chen po gad+gā ma zer nas gsungs kyi yod red/ tshig gi cha nas dang don gyi cha nas byed na/ chu mo gaṅgā ma la rgyun chad med pa bzhin du nyams kyi rnal 'byor pa de tsho la phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len de la nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu nyams 'od gsal du shar yong dus de'i steng nas rgyun chad med pa/

de ni rnam rtog skyes pa rnam rtog 'gag pa/ 'phral gyi rnam rtog ga re shar ba yin na'ang tshogs drug gi yul la rnam par shes pa drug gi 'phro 'du thams cad chos nyid phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas byung ba dang phyag rgya chen po'i rtsal yin pa dang phyag rgya chen po'i rol pa yin pa dang*/ nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu phyag rgya chen po'i 'od gsal gyi nyams la rgyun chad med pa yin pa yin dus chu bo gaṅgā ma dang 'dra ba yin dus de 'dra'i cha nas gaṅgā dang 'dra ba/ de 'dra yin dus tshig gis cha nas chu bo gaṅgā ga'i 'gram du gsungs pa yin pa dang*/ don gyi cha nas phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len la rgyun chad med pa'i brda yin pa yin dus gaṅgā zer nas gzhung 'di gsungs pa red 'dug00000000 / 16711680 de la mtshan gyi don ni/ 00000000 00000000 00000255 ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ mahā mu dra u pa desha / 00000000u pa desha zer yag de man ngag zer gyi yod red/ mahā mu dra zer na phyag rgya chen po zer gyi yod red pa/ 00000000 00000255 bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag / ༈ / 00000000phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes dang*/ rgya ni de las mi 'da' ba'o// gsungs pa red/ de yin dus spyir btang 'di yi skabs su phyag zer ba'i tshig de ga re red zer na/ gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de red/ gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes zer ba de ga re red zer na/ 'di skabs su tshig kha thug zhu bzhag na/ gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes zer ba de da lta nga rang tsho'i da lta'i skad cig ma'i rnam rtog 'di rang la gsal stong gi ye shes zer ba red ma gtogs da lta'i skad cig ma'i shes pa 'di ma yin pa las logs su gsal stong ye shes zer ba de kha kha yod ma red/ dus da lta'i snang rig gsal tsam 'di// chos kun rdzob bden pa'i rang ngo yin// 'di ma bcos rang gi gnad shes na// don dam pa'i bden pa'ang 'di kho na// gsungs pa nang bzhin da lta'i bzang po dang ngan pa'i rnam rtog gang shar ba de 'dra'i rnam rtog kho rang brtag dpyad ma btang nas/

rnam rtog la ma brtag par rnam rtog de rang sor bzhag bzhag na 'khor ba'i rgyu/ rnam rtog de la gtad nas rnam rtog la rtsad dpyad nas rnam rtog gi rang ngo skyong thub na/ rnam rtog gi ngo bo ngo shes na ye shes/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu/ des na 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba yang 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po 'di red/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po zer ba de ga ba la ngos 'dzin byed dgos kyi red zer na/ sems gsal stong gnyis med kyi ye shes de rang la go dgos pa red/ des na phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyi shar ba'i don de la phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag zer nas lab pa red/ de 'dra'i sems gsal stong ye shes 'di 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'dis ma khyab pa yod ma red/ de la brten nas rgya zer nas de la zer gyi yod red/ mar 'khor ba'i chos yin na'ang sems kyi rang bzhin red/ gsal stong gi ye shes kyi rang bzhin red/ yar mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos yin na yang gsal stong gi ye shes kyi rang bzhin red ma gtogs 'khor ba'i chos dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos gnyis po 'di la gcig gsal stong gi ye shes kyi rgya'i thebs bsdad pa dang gcig la gsal stong gi ye shes kyi rgya'i ma thebs pa yod ma red/ 'khor 'das kyi chos gang dang gang yin na'ang gsal stong gi ye shes kyi rol pa/ gsal stong gi ye shes kyi rtsal/ gsal stong gi ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ rtsal dang rang bzhin gyi nus pa red bsdad kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus rgya ni de las mi 'da' ba'o gsungs pa red/ des na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis ma thebs pa gcig kyang med pa red/ de la brten nas sngags kyi skabs su la'ang snang stong zung 'jug /gsal stong zung 'jug /bde stong zung 'jug

/rig stong zung 'jug zer nas stong pa bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi'i nyams len de tsho tshang ma yang rtsa ba 'di sngags bla med dang 'brel yong dus gsungs stangs de dang*/ da lta 'di'i skabs su phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag lugs dang gnyis go ba len tshul gcig pa yin pa red/ des na phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag /man ngag zer ba 'di brgyud pa'i man ngag red/ grub chen tai lo pa rang nyid kyi thugs dam gyi mthil lam thugs dam gyi nyams bzhes dang thugs dam gyi drod rtags gang yin pa de slob ma skal pa dang ldan pa dang brgyud pa 'dzin nus pa'i slob ma skal pa dang ldan pa la mar gsungs pa yin pas na de la man ngag lab pa red ma gtogs slob ma thams cad la slob bshad byed pa la man ngag zer nas gsungs kyi ma red/ gang zag kha shas kha shas gang zag skal pa'am dbang po rab red bsdad mkhan de tsho la brda thabs kyi tshul dang gsang ba'i tshul du gsungs pa de la man ngag lab pa red/ nyams len byed na tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thub pa/ nyams su ma len na 'khor ba mtha' can du skye 'gro ba 'o de 'dra'i brda zab po dang thabs zab po de la man ngag zer nas btags pa red 'dug00000000 16711680 'gyur gyi phyag ni/ 00000000 00000000 00000255 dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ / 00000000rdo rje mkha' 'gro zer ba de don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor la go ba red/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor de la/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// gsungs pa red/ spyir btang nga rang tsho'i rdo rje phag mo zer ba de kun rdzob tu rdo rje phag mo zer ba de lha'i zhal dang phyag gi rnam pa zhig la mthong gi yod red de/ don dam pa la rgyal yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo/ rnam pa rdo rje phag mo'i rang bzhin yin pa/ 'phags pa'i gzhi thams cad bskyed thub mkhan/ don dam pa'i dbyings sam don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor de la rdo rje phag mo zer nas nga tshos ming btags kyi yod red/

phag zer na spyir btang gi gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'am gtsang dme gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa phar bshig thub pa de la phag gi rnam pa bstan gyi 'dug /de nang bzhin byed nas nam rgyun nga rang tshos phag pa zer ba de btsog pa zhig la brtsi gi yod red pa/ phag pa la gtsang btsog gang yang yod ma red/ 'di 'dra po byed nas gnyis 'dzin gyi drwa ba'am gnyis 'dzin gyi zhen pa de phar bshig nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi steng la bzhugs bsdad pa de'i brda thabs de phag gi mgo la brten nas mtshon thub kyi yod pa red/ de la brten nas phag 'di ston gyi yod red/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro zer ba de 'di'i skabs la don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor la go yi yod red/ rdo rje zer ba'i skabs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las cha tshang bsdus bsdad pa de la rdo rje lab kyi yod red/ sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje yon tan rdo rje phrin las rdo rje zer nas rdo rje lnga'i thog nas gsung mkhan yang yod red/ rdo rje bzhi'i thog nas kyang sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje ye shes rdo rje zer nas rdo rje bzhi'i thog nas gsungs kyi yod red/ gang ltar rdo rje zer ba de gang red/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan de la rdo rje zer nas ming btags pa red/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan nam gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes de la rdo rje zer nas ming btags pa red/ mkha' 'gro zer ba de 'di 'dra'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes de ga 'dras byed nas yong gi yod red zer na/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes de yang snang stong zung 'jug /gsal stong zung 'jug /bde stong zung 'jug /rig stong zung 'jug gi dbyings las ma 'das pa yin pa yin dus mkha' 'gro zer ba de dbyings stong nyid mtshon pa'i brda la mkha' 'gro zer nas lab/

rdo rje zer ba de de 'dra'i dbyings stong pa nyid de yang gang gi thog nas skye dgos kyi red zer nas bshad yong dus/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsung gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yon tan gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phrin las gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i steng nas ngo sprod dgos kyi yod pa yin dus rdo rje zer ba de gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan la go ba dang*/ 'di 'dra'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan de yang gang la go dgos kyi yod red zer na/ bde chen bzhi'i steng nas 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ snang stong zung 'jug /gsal stong zung 'jug /bde stong zung 'jug /rig stong zung 'jug bzhi'i steng nas ngo sprod byed pa/ 'o da 'di thabs zab mo yod pa red/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di 'dra'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro de 'o na/ su la rdo rje phag mo 'dra po zhig la phar bsam blo btang nas nga tshos phyag 'tshal dgos red pas zer na/ ma red/ de 'dra ba de nga rang la yod red/ nga rang la yod pa la yod par shes pa'i thog nas phyag 'tshal dgos pa red ma gtogs da lta 'di'i skabs su rdo rje mkha' 'gro zer ba 'di phar yul gcig la bsam blo btang*/ de la nga rang tshos dus rgyun du phyag 'tshal ba 'dra po gcig nga rang tshos bsam blo gtang rgyu yod ma red/ rang nyid la yod pa la yod par ngo shes pa'i thog nas phyag 'tshal dgos pa red/ ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kun rdzob tu 'khrul pa'i snang tshul des khor mo yug tu 'khor bar rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong gi yod red de/ don dam pa la 'di 'dra po'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i yon tan 'di nam yang 'du 'bral med pa/

'di 'dra po'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i yon tan 'di rang la rang chas kyi tshul du sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa 'di ngo shes tsam dang ngo ma shes pa'i sa mtshams gcig red ma gtogs don dam pa la sems can thams cad sangs rgyas yin pa/ skad cig gcig gis byed brag phyed// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro de rang la yod pa la yod par ngo shes na de'i thog nas 'khrul grol gnyis kyi sa mtshams bcad kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// zer ba de 'di 'dra po'i yon tan de rang la rang chas su yod pa rang la ye gdod ma nas yod pa'i rgyu mtshan la bsam blo btang nas de la phyag 'tshal ba red 'dug / da nā ro pa la nyan par bskul ba red/00000000 16711680 de la snying po'i gdams ngag 'doms par dam bca' ba ni/ 00000000 0000025500000255 0000000000000255 dka' ba spyad cing bla ma la gus pa// sdug bsngal bzod ldan blo ldan nā ro pa// skal ldan khyod kyis blo la 'di ltar byos/ ༈ /1/

00000000da 'di zer ba'i skabs su/ dka' ba spyad cing bla ma la gus pa// grub chen nā ro pa zer ba des rje btsun tai lo pa la bsten/ tai lo pa la bsten pa'i skabs la'ang dka' ba chen po brgyad dang dka' phran mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi sku lus rang gi steng du spyad nas sku tshe de nyid la zung 'jug mkha' spyod kyi 'bras bu thob song ba de 'dra red/ des na dka' ba spyad zer ba de dka' ba mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi rang gi lus la spyad pa red/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i brgyud pa rnam dag yong ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i brgyud pa la bslad mi zhugs pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i brgyud pa zam ma chad pa'i don dag la/ bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// rje btsun mi las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis bla ma las kyang slob ma bzang slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang nas dngos gnas drang gnas kyi brgyud pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zab mo'i don tshe gcig lus gcig la nyams su len thub na sangs rgyas thub pa'i de 'dra'i man ngag dam pa yod pa yin dus/ 'di 'dra'i man ngag dam pa de yang tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta bar du las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur/ don med pa'i sdug bsngal dang du blangs/ de nas ngan song du 'khor mo yug gi sdug bsngal rgyun chad med par myong bsdad pa de la phan pa dang 'bras bu gcig kyang byung yod ma red/ da res dngos gnas drang gnas kyi de lta bu'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam/ mdo sngags thams cad kyi nying bcud phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag 'di 'dra po nyams su len nas ma 'ongs pa la dngos gnas drang gnas spyir nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad de'i nang nas kyang de 'dra po'i brgyud pa la dngos gnas drang gnas dad pa dang spro ba dang mos gus yod bsdad mkhan de tsho la de 'dra'i nyams su len rgyu'i go skabs bzang po zhig byung ba yin na/

de'i steng nas rigs drug gi ma rgan sems can thams cad la phan thogs pa zhig yong sa red bsam nas de 'dra po'i man ngag la spro ba dang*/ de 'dra po'i nyams len la brtson 'grus chog mi shes pa byed pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas dka' ba spyad ces lab pa red 'dug /de ma gtogs dka' ba spyad zer ba 'di nam nyin mtshan med par sdug rus byed bsdad pa tsam la go rgyu ma yin pa/ spro ba dang dang ba gzhir byas de'i steng nas brtson 'grus kyi lcags brabs nas nam nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu nyams su len nas da lta yang dngos gnas drang gnas bka' brgyud rdo rje 'chang gi brgyud pa 'di bar ma chad par yong thub pa de rje btsun nā ro pa'i bka' drin la brten nas byung ba red/ des na dka' ba spyad zer ba 'di red/ bla ma la gus pa zer ba de bla ma la snying thag pa nas sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes yod pa la brten nas bla ma la gus pa zer nas lab pa red 'dug /de ma gtogs bla ma la gus pa yod pa tsam la go rgyu ma red/ bla ma snying gi dbus su yod pa/ don dam pa'i bla ma dang kun rdzob kyi bla ma gnyis dbyer ma mchis pa shes thub na bla ma la gus pa gtso bo 'di yong gi yod red/ 'di'i skabs su don dam gyi bla ma 'di rang gi sems rgyud la yod red/ don dam gyi bla ma rang gi sems rgyud la yod pa de yang kun rdzob brda thabs kyi bla ma la ma bsten par yong gi med pa yin dus/ kun rdzob brda'i bla ma la bsten nas don dam pa'i rang gi sems rgyud kyi bla ma ngo 'phrod dgos kyi yod dus/ bla ma la gus pa zer ba yin/ gtso bo 'di skabs su bla ma 'di don dam gyi bla ma la gus pa/ don dam pa'i bla ma 'di gong du bshad pa nang bzhin rang gi sems gsal stong gnyis su med pa rang gi sems snang stong gnyis su med pa rang gi sems rig stong gnyis su med pa rang gi sems bde stong gnyis su med pa'i gnas lugs sam sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa/

de dang du len 'dod kyi spro ba yod pa yin dus de la gus pa skye yong dus de'i shugs kyis man ngag de ston mkhan gyi bla ma dam pa de la yang rang bzhin gyis gus pa chags thub kyi yod dus 'di'i 'brel pa de 'dra yong gi yod pa red/ de ma gtogs spyir btang ston mkhan gyi kun rdzob kyi bla ma la dad pa skyes nas don dam gyi bla ma la dad pa skyes zer ba de yong gi yod ma red/ dang po sems kyi gnas lugs zer ba de bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa/ de 'dra ba de dngos gnas drang gnas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas thub pa'i thabs zab mo de tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas thub pa'i yon tan rang gi sems rgyud la yod pa shes yong dus de la gus pa skye yong ba red/ de la gus pa skyes nas de nyams su len 'dod kyi spro ba/ de nyams su len 'dod kyi dad pa dang mos gus slebs yong dus de'i stobs kyis 'di ston mkhan gyi bla ma de yang de 'dra zhig dgos kyi 'dug /de ston mkhan gyi bla ma de la mtshan nyid 'di 'dra zhig dgos kyi 'dug /de ston mkhan gyi bla ma de la yon tan 'di 'dra zhig dgos kyi 'dug bsam nas yon tan de ldan gyi bla ma dang mtshan nyid de ldan gyi bla ma la rang bzhin gyis gus pa yong gi yod pa red/ don dam pa'i yon tan la ma gus na 'di ston mkhan gyi kun rdzob kyi bla ma la gus pa yong gi ma red/ des na mtshan nyid de ldan gyi bla ma la gus par byed pa la/ dang po de 'dra po'i mtshan nyid dang yon tan de la rgyu mtshan cha tshang shes ma thub na'ang don yid la byed pa gcig dgos kyi yod red/ don yid la byed pa dang de 'dra po'i don la gsal 'debs pa gcig dgos kyi yod red/ don la gsal 'debs pa dang don yid la byed pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas yon tan dang mtshan nyid de ldan gyi bla ma la gus pa yong gi yod red/ des na bla ma la gus pa/

de nas bla ma la gus pa skyes yong dus/ de 'dra'i bla ma des rang la sdug po btang*/ bla ma des phyag 'jug gnang bka' bkyon gnang*/ dka' las dang lus srog la thub pa'i dka' las mang po sprad na'ang sdug bsngal de bzod thub kyi yod red/ sdug bsngal de chog mi shes pa yin pa red/ sdug bsngal de dang du len 'dod yod pa red/ sdug bsngal de la spro ba mthong gi yod pa red/ sdug bsngal de la don yod par shes yong dus/ sdug bsngal bzod ldan blo ldan nā ro pa// sdug bsngal bzod par ldan zer gyi yod red/ spyir btang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la sogs pa la sdug bsngal bzod par ldan na'ang sdug bsngal ma bzod rang bzod 'khyer ba red ma gtogs sdug bsngal don ldan gang yang ma red pa/ chos kyi ched du dngos gnas drang gnas phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas thub pa'i man ngag 'di lta bu gcig la dka' las byung na'ang byung bsam nas de lta bu'i dka' las de la don yod par shes/ dka' las de la phan yon yod par shes/ dka' las de la mtshan nyid yod par shes yong dus de nas sdug bsngal de la bzod thub kyi yod pa red/ sdug bsngal bzod ldan zhes de 'dra'i sdug bsngal thams cad bzod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de yang dang po de ga re la thug gi 'dug /don dam pa'i yon tan dang don dam pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan de la spro ba yod pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas 'brel ba yong sdod kyi 'dug /de lta bu la spro ba yod par ma shes na sdug bsngal bzod thub kyi ma red/ 'o de 'dra yin dus phyi ma phyi ma de tsho de snga ma snga ma la 'brel bsdad pa red/ sdug bsngal bzod ldan blo ldan nā ro pa// sdug bsngal bzod thub mkhan de su red/ blo ldan nā ro pa red/ blo ldan zer ba'i skabs su blo gros dang ldan pa/ legs pa dang nyes pa so sor phyed thub pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa/

skyon dang yon tan so sor phyed thub pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa/ 'khor ba 'di rgyu gang gis 'khor ba yin pa dang*/ 'khor ba 'di rgyu gang gis grol thub kyi yod pa'i 'khrul grol gyi sa mtshams 'di shes thub mkhan de 'dra'i blo dang ldan pa'am de 'dra'i shes rab dang ldan mkhan de paṇa chen nā ro pa red/ des na khyod skal pa dang ldan pa red/ zhes gsungs song*// skal ldan khyod kyis blo la 'di ltar byos// khyod rang gi sems la de lta bur zhog gsungs pa red/ nā ro pa'i yon tan yang dka' ba spyad thub pa dang bla ma la gus pa yod pa dang sdug bsngal bzod pa de tsam mar bshad bzhag pa 'dra po ma yin pa dka' ba spyad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bla ma la gus pa zer dus bla ma la ga 'dra byed nas gus pa yong gi yod pa/ gus pa de 'go ga 'dra tshugs kyi yod pa/ de la don dam dang kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag gnyis bshad/ de 'dra po la sdug bsngal bzod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal bzod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de yang rgyu mtshan snga ma snga ma la brten nas sdug bsngal bzod kyi yod pa red 'dug /de lta bu'i yon tan khyad par can yod bsdad pa'i paṇa chen nā ro pa khyod blo la 'di lta bu byos shig00000000 16711680 da gdams pa dngos las phyag rgya chen po sgra rtog gi spyod yul las 'das par bstan pa ni/ 00000000 00000000 00000255 phyag rgya chen po bstan du med kyis kyang*// dper na nam mkha' gang gis gang la brten// rang sems phyag rgya che la brten yul med// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog / ༈ /2/ 00000000phyag rgya chen po zer ba de spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba red/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par gyis// de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas te// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin// zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi phyag rgya chen po zer ba de la ston yag gang yang yod ma red/

brda yi thog nas ston yag yod ma red/ thabs kyi sgo nas ston yag yod ma red/ man ngag zer ba'i skabs su nga rang tshos man ngag ston gyi yod red de/ phyag rgya chen po zer ba de dngos gnas de 'dra yod red da zer nas bla ma ga tshod gcig thabs mkhas pa yod na'ang bstan yag yod ma red/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang chos nyid kyi gnas tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa de tsho yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang ma bstan/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang bstan par mi 'gyur/ da lta'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang mi ston gsungs pa red/ yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang ma gzigs/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yang gzigs par mi 'gyur/ da lta'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang mi gzigs gsungs pa red/ ma gzigs mi gzigs pa'i gzigs pa chen po zer nas bshad 'dug pa de dang gcig pa red/ phyag rgya chen po la bstan yag med pa red/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la yang*/ 'on kyang khyod kyi gsang ba 'di ni bsnyad bgyi ma lags so// spyir btang gi stong nyid kyi rnam gzhag thams cad de chos thams cad bdag med pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan de tsho tshang ma zhib phrar bshad/ de'i shugs la gang zag gi bdag med pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan de tsho thams cad zhib phrar bshad/ de nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin pa la bdag med pa gnyis kyi steng nas chos thams cad stong nyid du bsgrubs pa red/ 'on kyang gsungs yong dus dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ khyod kyi gsang ba 'di ni bsnyad bgyi ma lags so// zer gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas tshul 'di bshad dgos na sgra las 'das ba/ tshig las 'das ba/ dpe las 'das pa/ don las 'das pa yin pa red/ sgra tshig dpe don thams cad las 'das yong dus bshad mi thub pa yin pa red/ rgyud bla ma las/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min cing*// don dam phyir na bsam pas min// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i// sgom pa la sogs yul ma yin// des na shin tu phra ba yin pa'i phyir na 'jig rten pa'i thos pa'i yul ma yin pa dang*/

shin tu don dam pa yin pa'i phyir na/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa/ chos nyid shin tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa dang chos nyid shin tu zab pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas 'jig rten pa'i sgom pa'i yul ma yin gsungs pa red 'dug /'o des na phyag rgya chen po bstan du med zer ba de bstan rgyu gcig yod nas bstan thub kyi mi 'dug gsungs kyi yod ma red/ bstan rgyu gcig yod nas bstan ma thub pa yin na dpe thabs zad kyi las ka red/ don dam pa kho rang la bstan rgyu med pa red/ sgra las 'das pa red/ tshig las 'das pa red/ dpe las 'das pa red/ de la brten nas/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// dus rgyun nga rang tshos gcod 'don pa'i skabs la rgyal yum gyi bstod pa de la brten nas yong gi yod red/ smra bsam brjod med zer ba de smra rgyu zhig yod nas smra ma thub pa ma yin pa/ bsam rgyu zhig yod nas bsam ma thub pa ma yin pa/ brjod rgyu zhig yod nas brjod ma thub pa de 'dra red mi 'dug /smra ba las 'das pa bsam pa las 'das pa brjod pa las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir na/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// de la brten nas 'di'i skabs la da lta gong la bshad bsdad pa'i phyag rgya chen po zer ba de'ang mtha' bzhi spros pa brgyad dang bral ba red/ nga rang tsho 'jig rten pa'i blo'i yul du gyur thub kyi ma red/ spyod 'jug las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min// blo ni kun rdzob yin par brjod// ces gsungs 'dug /don dam pa de blo yi spyod yul ma red/ da lta nga rang tsho 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog zer mkhan de 'dra zhig yod red/ nyon mongs pa chags sdang gi gzhan dbang du gyur bsdad pa'i rnam rtog de 'dra zhig yod red/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur bsdad pa'i rnam rtog de 'dra zhig yod red/

rang la rang dbang med pa'i rnam rtog de 'dra zhig yod red/ 'khor bar 'jug par du byed pa'i rnam rtog de 'dra zhig yod red/ rnam rtog de la'ang rags pa dang phra ba yod red/ rnam rtog rags pa ngos zin na'ang phan gyi ma red/ shin tu phra ba lhan skyes kyi bdag gi 'dzin pa de tsho spang thub kyi ma red/ 'o de 'dra'i dngos gnas drang gnas kyi srid pa'i drwa ba de la khams gsum gyi phra rgyas mtha' dag gi nang la tshud bsdad pa'i nga rang tsho'i rnam rtog gi drwa ba de 'dra gcig gi nang la bsdad pa'i skabs su phyag rgya chen po zer mkhan de ga ba mthong thub ste/ dngos gnas drang gnas kyi skal pa dang dbang po dang shes rab mchog tu gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yang phyag rgya chen po bstan dgos na bstan yag med pa red/ gang phyir gzugs la dmus long bzhin// byis pas de sngon mthong ma myong*// btsas pa'i khyim na bu chung gis// nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin 'phags pas kyang*// zer nas rgyud bla ma'i nang la gsungs 'dug /btsas pa'i phyir na bu chung gis mdang sum skyes pa'i phru gus de ring zhog pa'i nyi ma mthong yong dus mig la 'od gcig ma gtogs nyi ma la ngos 'dzin byed ma thub pa nang bzhin gyis sa thob pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyis kyang*/ chos nyid gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa de tsho zur tsam mthong ba ma gtogs gsal po mthong thub kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /des na phyag rgya chen po zer mkhan de la bstan yag med pa red/ phyag rgya chen po zer mkhan de dpe las 'das pa red/ de la brten nas/ tai lo nga la ci yang bstan du med// rang gis rang nyid mthong na grol bar 'gyur// zer nas nā ro pa la mchil l+h+wam brgyab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de red pa/ bstan yag gang yang yod ma red/ tshig mang po bshad pa yin na tshig la mgo bo 'khor gyi red/ don mang po bshad bsdad pa yin na don la mgo bo 'khor gyi red/

tshig don gnyis la mgo bo 'khor song na/ tshig don gnyis las 'das thub kyi ma red/ phyag rgya chen po bshad pa de rjod byed kyi tshig las 'das pa red/ brjod bya'i don las 'das pa red/ lta ba'i yul las 'das pa red/ spros pa'i yul las 'das pa red/ sgom pa'i yul las 'das pa red/ mthar thug la gang yang yod ma red/ des na/ phyag rgya chen po bstan du med// zer ba'i tshig 'di la go ba chen po 'dug /phyag rgya chen po bstan rgyu zhig yod nas bstan du med gsungs pa ma red/ phyag rgya chen po kho rang dpe las 'das pa tshig las 'das pa don las 'das pa yin dus yong gi yod ma red/ da lta rgyud bla ma nang la/ ngag yul min phyir don dam gyis bsdus phyir// rtog gnas min phyir dpe las 'das pa'i phyir// bla na med phyir srid zhis ma bsdus phyir// rgyal yul 'phags rnams kyis kyang bsam mi khyab// rgyu mtshan drug gi thog nas gsungs kyi yod red/ ngag gi yul ma yin pa'i phyir na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa/ don dam pa'i bden pas bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa/ ngag yul min phyir don dam gyis bsdus phyir// 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog gi gnas ma red/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog gi yul ma red/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog gi drwa bas rtogs thub kyi ma red/ des na/ rtog gnas min phyir dpe las 'das pa'i phyir/ zer na/ dpe zhig bzhag dgos na'ang dpe las 'das pa red/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon mi thub pa red/ bla na med phyir zer na/ yon tan gyi mchog dam pa yin pa/ yon tan gyi mthar thug pa yin pa'i phyir na bla na med pa/ de'i gong na yon tan gzhan dang de'i gong na mtshan nyid gzhan de'i gong na thabs gzhan med pa dang*/ de'i gong na lta ba dang sgom pa la sogs pa med pa yin dus bla na med pa/ bla na med pa'i phyir na bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ srid zhis ma bsdus phyir/

srid pa'i skyon gyis bsdus yod ma red/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan gyis kyang bsdus yod ma red/ srid zhi gnyis las 'das pa red/ srid pa las kyang 'das pa mya ngan las kyang 'das pa yin dus/ ngag yul min phyir don dam gyis bsdus phyir// rtog gnas min phyir dpe las 'das pa'i phyir// bla na med phyir srid zhis ma bsdus phyir// rgyal yul 'phags rnams kyis kyang bsam mi khyab// gsungs 'dug /'phags pa rnams kyis kyang rtogs thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ 'o des na de ga tsam gyis tsog tsog gcig byed lag pa gnyis de sbyar shes pa tsam gyis gang yang phan gyi yod ma red/ bsgom gyi yod zer nas u tshugs brgyab na'ang phan gyi med pa red/ des na gnad 'gag la brten nas 'gro dgos pa de gal chen po red 'dug /gnad 'gag zer ba de gang red/ gnad 'gag zer ba de bla ma'i man ngag dang 'grogs nas 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/ shes rab che bas phan gyi ma red/ brtson 'grus che bas phan gyi yod ma red/ shes rab che ba gcig pus kyang rtogs thub kyi mi 'dug /brtson 'grus chen po gcig gis kyang phan gyi mi 'dug /shes rab dang brtson 'grus gnyis kyi steng la dngos gnas drang gnas kyi bla ma'i man ngag gcig dang 'grogs dgos kyi yod red/ bla ma'i man ngag zer yong dus bla ma de'ang sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i bla ma gcig gi man ngag dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs/ de ga tsam bla ma gcig la so so skye bo'i 'du shes bzhag nas phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag zhu dgos na rtogs thub yag yod ma red/ des na bla ma bzang por dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus kyi steng nas bla mas man ngag ston yong dus de nas rtogs thub kyi yod red/ bla ma des kyang rtogs thub yag cha tshang gsungs thub yag gang yang yod ma red de yin na'ang gang drag drag byas nas tshig dang rjod byed dang brjod bya'i steng nas 'brel nas mar bshad yong dus rang gis de'i steng nas bsgom pa'i nges shes kyi steng nas brtson 'grus bskyed dgos kyi yod red/

brtson 'grus bskyed yong dus ga re byas nas ngo shes thub kyi red zer na/ bstan yag med pa gcig la bsgom brgyab yong dus yang ngo shes 'gro ba de ga 'dra red zer na/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag dang sems kyi gnas lugs zer ba de dpe dang tshig las 'das pa red/ yin na yang sgom brgyab nas shes rgyu yod pa de chos nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pa red/ gang red zer na/ de 'dra'i bstan rgyu med pa'i chos de rang gi sems rgyud dang 'brel yod red/ de 'dra'i bstan rgyu med pa'i chos de rang gi sems la ye gdod ma nas rang chas su yod red/ de 'dra'i bstan rgyu med pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i don dag de rang gi sems la ye nas rang chas su yod red/ rang ji tsam ji tsam nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur/ rang ji tsam ji tsam sdug bsngal gyi khol por gyur na'ang de 'dra'i sems rgyud la yod pa'i phyag rgya chen po 'di sdug tu 'gro yag yod ma red/ rang ji tsam ji tsam yon tan yar ldan du song bas/ rang ji tsam ji tsam rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong 'phel du 'gro yong dus phyag rgya chen po de'ang bzang du bzang du 'gro yag yod ma red/ des na bzang du sangs rgyas kyis btang mi thub/ ngan du sems can gyis kyang btang mi thub pa'i chos nyid kyi gnas lugs gra ma chag pa phyag rgya chen po'i sems rgyud de rang la yod pa yin dus rang la yod bsdad pa 'di rang gis mngon du gyur pa red ma gtogs/ bla mas brda dang man ngag la brten nas gsar pa gcig tshur sprad yong rgyu med pa yin dus/ phyag rgya chen po bstan du med gsungs pa red 'dug /'o da 'di zhe drag gis zab po yod pa red/ phyag rgya chen po bstan du med kyis kyang*// ga 'dras byas nas bstan du med pa red zer nas lab yong na/ da yang so so skye bo la dpe gcig ma lab rang lab red pa/ dpe yi steng nas don de bstan na ma gtogs lam sang rdog rdog gcig shes yag med pa red/
des na dpe gcig bzhag dgos kyi yod red/ dpe las 'das pa red de yin na yang dpe dgos kyi yod red/ don la dpe las 'das pa red de kun rdzob tu dpe gcig dgos kyi yod red/

00000000 dper na nam mkha' gang gis gang la brten// 00000000gsungs 'dug /nam mkha' zer ba de ga re red/ ngo bo stong pa red gang yin zhe na nam mkha'i rang bzhin gang la'ang ma brten pa yin/ nam mkha' zer ba de rang bzhin gsal ba red/ nam mkha' zer ba de mtshan nyid 'gag pa med pa red/ nam mkha' zer ba de dbyings kun la khyab pa red/ nam mkha' zer ba de nga tsho thams cad la khyab kyi 'dug /gtsang ma la yang khyab yod red/ btsog pa la yang khyab yod red/ ma gtogs nam mkha' de gsang spyod la khyab yod ma red zer na 'grig gi mi 'dug /nam mkhas gsang spyod la'ang khyab yod red/ nam mkha' gzhal yas khang la'ang khyab yod red/ nam mkhas srid zhi la'ang khyab yod red/ nam mkha' de sa cha ga ba yin na'ang khyab pa nang bzhin gyis mdor na phyag rgya chen po'i gnas tshul 'di 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab yod red gsungs kyi yod red/ nam mkhas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la khyab pa bzhin du phyag rgya chen pos kyang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab bsdad yod red ma gtogs/ sems can las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa thams cad la khyab med/ 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad las grol bsdad pa'i sangs rgyas la khyab bsdad yod red zer na 'grig gi yod ma red pa/ des na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab yod pa'i phyir na nam mkha'i rang bzhin/ nam mkha' de mtshan nyid 'gag pa med pa red/ nga tsho phar tshur ga ba 'gro na'ang red las ka byed na'ang red nam mkhas go bkag gi mi 'dug /'gro sdod kyi spyod lam bzang ngan gyi spyod lam gang la yin na'ang ca lag yar 'degs 'jog la sogs pa gang byed na'ang nam mkhas go bkag gi yod ma red/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid kho rang yang go 'byed pa red pa/ 'di nang bzhin gyi phyag rgya chen po'i klong la 'khor 'das kyi rol pa sna tshogs shar thub pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i klong la mar 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad kyang shar chog pa/

phyag rgya chen po'i klong la yar mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyang shar chog gi yod red/ 'khor 'das kyi skyon dang yon tan thams cad byung yang phyag rgya chen po'i klong las byung*/ 'gags kyang phyag rgya chen po'i klong la 'gags pa red 'dug /des na rtog pa'i sgyu 'phrul thams cad kyang gtso bo de phyag rgya chen po'i klong las rang byung ba red ma gtogs yong gi yod ma red/ rdzogs pa chen po'i skabs la yang de rang bshad kyi yod red/ chos nyid kyi rtsal dang rol pa zer ba de rang bshad kyi yod red/ des na phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam nang la/ yod pa ma yin rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs// zer ba'i tshig 'di dang 'di'i skabs nas yong gi 'dug /sems kyi gnas lugs zer mkhan de yod red pas zer na/ yod ma red gsungs song*/ yod pa ma yin/ yod ma red zer ba de ga re red spyir btang yod ma red gsungs kyi yod ma red/ yin na yang 'jig rten pa'i blo ngor bstun nas yod red zer nas bshad dgos na yod ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /nga tshos yod red zer na rdog rdog 'dra po gcig yod/ spyir btang tshang mas mthong rgyu yod pa gcig la go yi yod red pa/ de 'dra yod ma red gsungs pa red/ rang gi sems rgyud kyi nyams len dang sgom dang 'grogs nas ngo shes pa ma gtogs/ phyi log nas bstan rgyu med pa yin dus/ yod pa ma yin rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs// gsungs 'dug /'o na med pa red pas zer na ma red/ med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// zer nas mar 'khor ba la 'khor yag de yang sems kyi gnas lugs gcig yod nas 'khor gyi yod red/ de ma rtogs nas 'khor gyi yod red pa/ yar mya ngan las 'das pa zer mkhan de yang sems kyi gnas lugs gcig yod nas rtogs kyi yod red/ gang red zer na de ngo shes nas grol gyi yod red pa/ des na sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po 'di ngo shes nas yar thar pa thob yag yod pa dang*/

de ngo ma shes nas mar 'khrul 'gro yag yod pa de/ 'khrul grol gnyis kyi rtsa ba 'di sems kyi gnas tshul rtogs yod med la thug gi 'dug /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba'i/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ do ha nang sa ra has gsungs pa nang bzhin red/ de yin dus nam mkha' ni ngo bo stong pa yin pa/ de la brten nas phyag rgya chen po de yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid red/ nam mkha' 'di ni rang bzhin gsal ba red/ nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa'i snang ba sna tshogs de'ang nam mkha'i nang la yong chog gi 'dug /de nang bzhin phyag rgya chen po'i nang la yang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gsal chog gi yod red/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid 'gag pa med pa red/ 'di nang bzhin gyi phyag rgya chen po'i klong la'ang mtshan nyid 'gag pa yod ma red/ de nang bzhin gyi nam mkha' zer mkhan de dbyings kun la khyab pa red/ de nang bzhin phyag rgya chen po de'ang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab bsdad pa red/ de yin dus sa ra has/ phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// nam mkha'i rang bzhin lta ba 'dra// gsungs pa red/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin lta ba 'dra zer na nga tshos nam mkha' la lta ba'i skabs su/ nam mkha' la ltos dang zer ba'i skabs su nam mkha' la blta tshul byed kyi yod red de/ nam mkha' ngo ma lta yag med pa/ sngon po ni kha dog red ma gtogs nam mkha' ma red pa/ nam mkha' blta yag mi 'dug /nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don du brtag par gyis// gsungs 'dug /nam mkha' mthong song bas zer na ngas nam mkha' mthong song zer gyi yod red/ nam mkha' ga 'dras mthong song*/ skar ma mthong song zer na ni skar ma ni nam mkha' ma red/ nyi ma dang zla ba nam mkha' ma red/ sprin pa ni nam mkha' ma red/ da nam mkha' ga ba mthong song*/ yin na yang 'jig rten pa'i kha skad la nam mkha' mthong song zer nas lab kyi yod red/

'di lab chog gi 'dug /lab chog gi yod red/ de nang bzhin byed nas ngas sems kyi gnas lugs mthong song zer yag gcig la mthong ba med pa'i don gcig la mthong ba dam pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs ngo ma la mthong rgyu yod ma red/ ma mthong ba 'di nyid mthong ba dam pa'i mchog yin gsungs pa red/ 'di red ma gtogs ngas sems kyi gnas lugs mthong song zer ba'i skabs la 'od gsal po ling ling yod pa gcig mthong ba de la sems kyi gnas lugs mthong zer gyi ma red/ de mthong ba yin na de ni sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyi las sla po byed nas sangs rgyas 'gro sa red/ mi dran dgu dran de mthong ba tsam zhig la sems kyi gnas lugs mthong zer gyi yod ma red/ 'o na rnam rtog bkag pa tsam gcig gis sems kyi gnas lugs song zer na de yang ma red/ rnam rtog bkag pa tsam gcig yin na ni ci yang med pa'i gzugs med khams la'ang yod red/ des phan gyi mi 'dug /rnam rtog bkag tsam gyis kyang phan gyi mi 'dug /'o na ga re red/ da gnad ka gcig yod pa red/ gnad ka de yang bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dam pa dang 'grogs nas 'gro dgos pa yin dus/ de 'dra'i gnad ka yod bsdad pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs de bltas na rnyed rgyu med pa/ rig pas btsal na rnyed ma thub pa/ de ga tsam sgom brgyab bsdad pas mthong thub yag med pa de 'dra'i brgyud pa'i byin rlabs gcig med na 'jug thub kyi mi 'dug /nga tshos brgyud pa'i byin rlabs zer ba de 'di red/ nga tshos byin rlabs gcig gnang rogs gnang*/ nga la brgyud pa'i byin rlabs gcig gnang rogs gnang*/ nga la lung gnang rogs gnang*/ nga la khrid gcig gnang rogs gnang zer nas zhu dgos yag de rang gis don dag shes bsdad pa dang rang gi go ba gtso bo bzhag gi mi 'dug /gtso bo 'di rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs yod med la brten nas phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag rtogs dgos kyi 'dug zer ba de red/

gzhan gyis brjod med lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla mas dus thabs bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis de gal chen po zhig chags bsdad kyi yod red/ nam mkha' gang gi gang la brten// nam mkha' de su la brten pa red/ rgyud bla ma las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ sa chu me rlung la sogs pa thams cad nam mkha' la brten gyi yod red de/ nam mkha' kho rang sa chu me rlung rnams la tshur brten gyi yod ma red/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' la phar brten gyi red pa/ 'o 'di nang bzhin gyis/ nam mkha' gang gis gang la brten// nam mkha' la bstan yag yod ma red/ phyag rgya chen po skad pa 'di// nam mkha'i rang bzhin blta bar gyis// gsungs pa red/ 'o na ga 'dras shig red zer na/ rang sems phyag rgya che la brten yul med// gsungs pa red/ sgom yang phar la mi bsgom zhing*/ yengs kyang tshur la mi g.yeng bar// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang nyid do// zer nas sa ra has gsungs yod red/ 'di nang bzhin byed nas/ sgom zer ba'i skabs su phar bsgom bzhag yag gang yang yod ma red/ g.yeng zer ba'i skabs su la/ tshur la g.yeng 'gro yag gang yang yod ma red/ sems ma bcos pa'i steng du lhod cing bzhag pa yin na/ rang sems phyag rgya chen po zer nas gsungs pa red 'dug /rang sems phyag rgya chen po la brten yul med zer ba red/ phyag rgya chen po la brten yul gang yang med pa red/ mar 'khor ba la brten dgos kyi ma red/ yar myang 'das la brten dgos yag yod ma red/ brten yag gang yang yod ma red/ sa la brten dgos kyi ma red/ khang pa la brten dgos kyi ma red/ rnam rtog bzang po la brten dgos kyi ma red rnam rtog ngan pa la brten dgos yod kyi ma red/ des na rang sems phyag rgya chen po zer ba de ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag pa de la phyag rgya chen po zer nas lab pa red/

yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhir gsungs pa bzhin/ gang shar rtog pa'i ngo bo so ma de// ma bcos de kar 'jog pa'i sgom chen la// bsgom bya blo dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs// gsungs 'dug /yengs pa med pa zer nas 'dug /ma g.yeng ba yin na yang dran pa'i bya ras zin bsdad pa/ 'o na ga 'dras 'dug zer nas lab dgos na/ dpe lkugs pas bu ram zos pa nang bzhin red/ lkugs pas bu ram za ba'i skabs su mngar mo yod red/ kho rang kho rang dpe ha las nas za sdod kyi yod red/ ga 'dras 'dug zer nas dri dang*/ lag pas brda ston na e drag /mig gis brda ston na e drag /khas brda ston na e drag /ngo ma ston yag mi 'dug a/ yin na yang khos bro ba myong sdod kyi yod red pa/ de 'dra po phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag de yang 'di 'dra po red gsungs pa red/ gang shar rtog pa'i ngo bo so ma de// ma bcos de ltar 'jog pa'i sgom chen la/ so ma zer ba de ma bcos pa red/ nga tsho ngan song la phyin yod red/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis bzo bcos btang yod ma red/ yar nga tsho thar pa la mang po phyin yod red/ thar pa'i yon tan gyis kyang bsgyur bcos btang yod ma red/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas pa'i gnas skabs la yang da lta'i sems can gyi rgyud la yod bsdad yag gi ngo bo ga re yod bsdad pa de ga rang red ma gtogs bzang du 'gro yag yod ma red/ 'o des na so ma zer ba 'di red/ ma bcos de kar 'jog pa zer na de ltar bzo bcos btang dgos kyi med pa red/ yag tu re ba dang ngan du dwogs pa/ rnam rtog mi yong ba'i re ba/ rnam rtog slebs yong bsam pa'i dwogs pa ste/ re dwogs gnyis 'dzin thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa de la rang sems phyag rgya chen po brten yul med gsungs pa red 'dug /rnam rtog la dgag sgrub ma byed pa red/ rnam rtog la rtsol sgrub ma byed pa/ rnam rtog la 'bad rtsol med pa/

rnam rtog skye na'ang skye bcug /rnam rtog de'i ngo bo la cog gis bzhag /lhod kyis glod/ rang babs su ma bcos par mnyam par gzhag na de la rang sems phyag rgya che la brten yul med gsungs pa red/ 16711680 da ma bcos pa'i ngang la 'jog tshul ni/ 00000000 00000000 ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /gsungs 'dug /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /gsungs pa 'di ji skad du/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i rnam rtog 'di// lhod kyis glod na grol bar 'gyur// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis da lta nga rang tsho'i rnam par shes pa tshogs drug la brten nas 'jug shes drug la 'gro yong dus rnam rtog 'di dpe lcags kyi 'jur nas tshur 'then bsdad pa nang bzhin gyis dka' las yod red/ rnam rtog gis bcings nas/ da lta bla ma dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas rang gi sems don ngo 'phrod yong dus de'i steng la ma bcos par bzhag yong dus de nas phyag rgya chen po ngo 'phrod yong dus lhod kyis glod yong ba red/ rang bzhin gyis mar 'bol ler 'gro/ bde 'bol ler 'gro/ bag yangs su 'gro/ des na/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /glod yong rgyu gang yang yod ma red/ 'di skabs la glod rgyu zhig yod nas glod gsungs pa ma red/ glod zer ba de da lta bar du 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas las dang nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi drwa ba de'i nang du bcing bsdad pa'i skabs su/ rnam rtog gi drwa ba 'di nas thar gyi yod ma red/ da lta 'di'i skabs su sgom brgyab yong dus rnam rtog gi ngo bo mthong yong dus rnam rtog glod zer nas ming btags pa red/ glod zer mkhan de rnam rtog gi ngo bo mthong tsam gcig la bzhag dgos kyi red ma gtogs/ rnam rtog spangs nas rnam rtog med pa'i gnas la glod zer ba'i skad cha ma red/ rnam rtog spang yag gang yang yod ma red/ lhag par du phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag 'di bla med rgyud dang 'brel ba yod pa yin dus/

dang du blang yag skad cha ma gtogs spangs zer ba'i tshig 'di yod ma red/ 'di'i skabs su gtso bo lam khyer gyi thog nas 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ lam du byed dgos kyi yod red/ snang ba lam khyer/ rmi lam lam khyer/ 'di la brten nas da lta nga rang tsho'i 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis/ gcod snang ba lam khyer nang la/ ma dmyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma yi dwags rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma dud 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma 'dod chags rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma zhe sdang rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma phrag dog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma gti mug rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma ngan 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zer nas yod red/ 'di tsho'i don ni ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du slebs yong dus phyag 'tshal dgos kyi yod red/ de ma gtogs de ga tsa 'dod chags la phyag 'tshal lo zer na khyad mtshar po red pa/ 'dod chags spang yag red ma gtogs phyag 'tshal yag ma red/ zhe sdang spangs yag red ma gtogs phyag 'tshal yag ma red/ yin na yang 'dod chags kyi ngo bo mthong*/ 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin mthong*/ 'dod chags kyi mtshan nyid shes/ zhe sdang gi ngo bo mthong*/ zhe sdang gi rang bzhin mthong*/ zhe sdang gi mtshan nyid shes/ 'dod chags kyi ngo bo de so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ zhe sdang gi ngo bo de me long gi ye shes/ nga rgyal gyi ngo bo de mnyam nyid ye shes te nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i ngo bo de ye shes lnga'i ngo bo yin pa shes yong dus de nas yar phyag 'tshal yong gi 'dug /de yang man ngag ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod de bzhag thub yag gcig dang rang sems phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo de bla ma'i man ngag dang 'grogs nas de la bzo bcos med par mnyam par bzhag thub yag gi thabs dang man ngag dam pa gcig dang 'grogs nas de'i steng du ngo 'phrod nas de nas phyag 'tshal dgos pa red ma gtogs/ kha nas 'dod chags zer mkhan de ngo bo sor rtog ye shes red/

de la phyag 'tshal lo zer ba tsam gyis phan gyi yod ma red/ zhe sdang gi ngo bo de mnyam nyid ye shes red da zer nas phyag 'tshal dgos kyi red zer ba tsam gyis phan gyi ma red/ gcig byas na zhe sdang che ru 'gro na'ang mi shes/ des phan gyi ma red pa/ des na gnad ka de byung na nyams myong los dgos/ gal srid nyams myong med pa yin na'ang de'i don yid la byed pa zer ba de zhe drag gal chen po red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma 'ongs pa'i lnga brgya tha ma'i dus la chos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don 'di tshul bzhin du nyams su len thub mkhan gcig byung na rab tu lta ci ste/ de ltar ma yin pa chos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la the tshom tsam za ba yin na 'khor ba mtha' med du byas pa yin zer nas gsungs 'dug /de 'dra'i bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i yon tan yod pa red/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zer ba de mdo'i tshig gcig red/ don dag la sngags kyi skabs su ga re bshad pa red/ yum chen mo zer nas ming btags kyi 'dug /'di gnyis tshogs yong ba de la mdo sngags mtshams sbyor gyi lta ba da lta 'di'i skabs su phyag rgya chen po'i nang bstan gyi yod red/ lhag par du dwags po rin po ches/ phyag rgya chen po 'di mdo lam nas bshad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sngags lugs nas bshad pa'i bde ba chen po gnyis mnyam du sbyor yong dus mdo sngags mtshams sbyor gyi lta ba mthun mong ma yin pa'i phyag rgya chen po zer nas dmigs bsal gyis gsungs/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag nyams su len yag la dbang bzhi'i rim pa sngon du ma 'gro na/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skye mi thub pa gcig gi lam gcig bzhag yod red/ dwags po rin po che la de mi dgos pa red/ sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag dam pa 'di phyag rgya chen po 'di'o// 'di nang la yod/

yin gcig min gnyis dbang bzhi'i rim pa sngon du 'gro nas de'i steng la nyams su len dgos yag gang yang yod ma red/ bla ma dam pa'i thabs dam pa'i man ngag dang 'grogs/ bla ma kho rang yang phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len dang nyams myong yod mkhan gcig gis khrid yong dus phar phyogs de sdig po che yin na'ang btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i thabs zab mo 'di nga tsho'i phyag rgya chen po la yod/ khyed rang tsho sa skya pa nang bzhin byed nas dbang bzhi'i rim pa dang bstun nas 'gro dgos yag med gsung yag gi brgyud pa bzang po de 'dra gcig kyang yod pa yin dus grol ma grol the tshom med pa red 'dug /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /zer ba de 'di red/

00000000 00000255 bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med// 00000000 00000000dper na btson khang nang la mi gcig lag pa bcings rkang pa bcings nas gzugs po 'gul yag med pa gcig bcings bzhag yod na/ bdun phrag gnyis tsam mtshams nas kho thag pa de nas phar grol yod na kho la bde ba chen po thob kyi red pa/ da nga btson khang nas thar song khrims khang nang nas thar song bsam nas sems la skyid po dang bde ba yong gi red pa/ 'di nang bzhin byed nas/ bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med// zer ba de gang zag tha mal pa mi sdig po che 'dra po zhig yin na'ang phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid 'di nyams su len na lta ci ste/ mtshan nyid la go ba tsam yod pa yin na'ang bde ba chen po yong gi red gsungs kyi yod red/ bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med// gsungs 'dug /dngos gnas drang gnas kyi da lta nga rang tshor las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang gis bcings/ khams gsum 'khor ba 'di yi nang la las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur// las dang nyon mongs pa'i lcags sgrog gis bcings bzhag pa 'di la/ spyir btang gi don yid la byed pa tsam zhig gis de ga tsam gyi phan yon yong gi yod na/ nga tshos tshul bzhin du nyams su len nas/ thos pa'i shes rab bskyed/ bsam pa'i shes rab bskyed/ sgom byung gi shes rab bskyed/ de'i nang nas sgom byung gi shes rab la brten nas bla ma la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/ bla ma la yid ches dang mos gus lhod yangs su ma song ba dang*/ de nas mos gus la thang lhod med pa gcig bskyed thub pa yin na de nas grol thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'di skabs su gtso bo 'di phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len skabs su rigs pa gcig pu yod pas phan gyi yod ma red/ thos pa'i shes rab/ bsam pa'i shes rab/ sgom pa'i shes rab che ba tsam gyis phan gyi yod ma red/ 'di skabs su la mos gus dam pa gcig dgos kyi yod red/

mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor gsungs pa bzhin// man ngag gter sgo 'byed pa'i bla ma la// rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgom chen la// bcos min mos gus skye bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs 'dug /mos gus de sgom gyi mgo nang bzhin gsungs 'dug /des na 'di skabs su phyag rgya chen po'i don dag 'di nyams su len yong dus srid pa'i drwa ba bcings bzhag pa khams gsum gyi srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug gis bcings bzhag pa 'di da lta'i phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gi nyams len yid la byed pa dang*/ de nas sgom rgyab pa dang tshul bzhin du nyams su len pa la brten nas grol yong ba red gsungs pa red/ rang gis bcings pa de rang gis grol ba red 'dug /de ma gtogs bcings mkhan nga rang byed dgrol mkhan gzhan dag gcig slebs ma dgos pa red/ sbrul mdud nam mkha' la bor ba nang bzhin dgos gsungs pa red/ sbrul gyi mdud pa 'di sus brgyab pa red/ kho rang kho rang brgyab kyi yod red/ sbrul gyi mdud pa bshig yag la nga rang 'gro dgos kyi ma red pa/ sbrul gyi mdud pa kho rang kho rang bshig thub kyi yod red/ des na sbrul mdud nam mkha' la bor ba de rang gis rang la bcings kyi yod red/ rang gis rang grol dgos kyi yod red/ sems kyi gnas lugs 'di rang la yod na'ang ngo ma shes pa red/ yod ma myong ba'i rang snang yul du 'khrul/ ma rig dbang gis rang rig bdag tu 'khrul/ de nas gnyis 'dzin dbang gis 'khor ba la bcing yong ba yin dus rang gis rang bcing song ba red ma gtogs/ su gcig gis kyang bcing med pa red/ des na 'o na sus grol yod red/ grol yag de rang gis grol ba red/ 'di yin zhes pa gang gis mtshon pa med// 'di min zhes bya gang gis bkag pa med// blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas// yang dag don gyi mtha' ni nges par shog /gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis yod med gnyis kyi mtshams las 'das pa'i blo 'das gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i yon tan 'di mthong yong dus rang gis rang grol ba la the tshom med gsungs 'dug

/phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag 'di la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas snying khungs rus pa'i steng nas nyams su len thub pa yin na/ grol ma grol the tshom med gsungs pa red/ sngon yang grol ba red deng sang ma grol ba ci yang yod ma red grol thub kyi red/00000000 16711680 da bcas bcos dang bral bas rang sor bzhag tshul ni/ 00000000 0000000000000255 dper na nam mkha'i dkyil bltas mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur// 00000000nam mkha'i dkyil la blta sdod pa'i skabs su dngos gnas gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa mthong yag gang yang yod ma red/ mthong ba 'gag 'gro yi red pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams la nga tshos nam mkha' la blta zer ba'i skabs su nam mkha' la blta bsdad pa red ma gtogs dngos gnas nam mkha' la blta yag gang yang yod ma red/ mthong ba 'gag 'gro yi red pa/ mthong zer ba'i skabs su nga tshos gzugs 'dra po gcig mthong*/ gcig gzugs mdzes po mthong*/ gzugs mi mdzes pa mthong*/ dngos po 'dra po la mthong zer gyi yod red pa/ nam mkha'i dkyil la blta ba'i skabs su mthong yong yag gang yang med pa red/ des na/ nam mkha'i dkyil bltas mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur// spros pa dang bral ba'i mtshan nyid 'di nam mkha' la dpe bzhag pa red pa/ spyir btang nga tshos nam mkha' zer nas bzhag dgos yag 'di ga re red zer na/ nga tsho 'jig rten gyi khams la dpe drag shos nam mkha' ma gtogs med pa red/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ mtha' thams cad las 'das pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad las 'das pa/ dpe dang don gyis mtshon ma thub pa de nam mkha' ma gtogs gang yang med pa red/ des na/ nam mkha'i dkyil bltas mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur// nam mkha'i dkyil la blta yong dus ngas 'di mthong song*/ ngas 'di rig song zer yag gang yang yod ma red pa/ des na/ nam mkha'i dkyil bltas mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur// spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/

mtshan nyid thams cad las 'das pa/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal thams cad las 'das pa yin pa yin dus/ dper na nam mkha'i dkyil bltas mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur/ 0000000000000255 de bzhin sems kyis sems la bltas byas na// 00000000chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'di rang gi sems nyid kyi dbyings/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid kyi dbyings yin par gsungs/ de la brten nas sa ra has/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro zhing*// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar mdzad pa yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// gsungs pa'i skabs su/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon zer yag de/ kun gyi sa bon ga re red/ mar 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad kyang sems nyid la brten nas yong gi yod/ yar mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyang rtsa ba sems nyid la brten nas yong gi yod/ des na sems nyid kyi ngo bo shes na mya ngan las 'das pa thob yag dang*/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo ma shes pa la brten nas 'khor ba/ 'khrul grol gnyis kyi sa mtshams 'di sems kyi rang so zin dang ma zin pa la thug song*/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su 'di rang red/ 'khrul grol gnyis kyi sa mtshams ga ba bzhag red zer na/ sems kyi rang ngo shes na grol ba red sems kyi rang ngo ma shes yong dus 'khor ba zer nas lab pa red/ thag ring po zhe drag gang yang med pa red/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed 'gro ba red pa/ rdzogs chen skabs la phar bltas 'khor ba tshur bltas myang 'das zer ba 'di red/ phar bltas na 'khor ba yin/ tshur bltas na myang 'das yin/ gsungs pa red/ phar bltas na zer yag de ga re red/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug 'di yul drug la zhen cing chags na 'khor ba yin gsungs pa red/ tshur bltas myang 'das yin zer yag de 'di 'dra'i rnam par shes pa 'jug shes kyi tshogs drug po 'di tshur bsdus nas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes gcig gi ngo bo la rtsal du bltas pa yin na myang 'das red/

gsungs pa red/ 'di tsho phar bltas 'khor ba tshur bltas myang 'das zer yag 'di/ sems kyi rang so zin ma zin gnyis la 'khrul grol gnyis kyi sa mtshams bzhag yod red/ zhe drag 'grel bshad mang po gang yang med pa red/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer nas rtags bkod pa 'di 'dra 'gro ma dgos pa red/ 'di 'dra 'gro na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/ la skor lung skor byed bsdad pas thag ring du 'gro ba red/ gang mtshams gcig nas tshig la mgo bo 'khor don gyi go ba brlag 'gro yi yod red/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes/ deng dus rang re'i blo gsar 'ga' zhig /snang ba ling ling 'di rang sar bzhag nas// dgag rgyu rwa can zhig 'tshol bar 'dug ste// a ma rgan mo 'di bros dwogs 'dug go/ gsungs 'dug /deng dus rang re'i blo gsar 'ga' zhig zer ba de ri bo dga' ldan pa kho rang tsho'i nang la yang snang ba ling ling 'di rang sar bzhag /dper na dkar yol 'di rang sa la bzhag dgos kyi 'dug lab kyi yod red/ yin na'ang 'o na stong pa nyid zer ba 'di ga re red/ 'di'i steng la med bsdad pa'i chos gcig yod red/ dgag rgyu rwa can zhig bden stong zer ba 'di zur du bris nas chos thams cad bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid gcig dgos kyi red ma gtogs/ snang ba 'di kho rang stong nyid ma red/ 'di la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i stong pa zer mkhan gcig dgos kyi yod red/ stong nyid 'di zur du phyed yong ba red/ 'di 'dra byed yong dus a ma rgan mo 'di bros dwogs 'dug go// a ma rgan mo 'di zer na ga re red/ yum chen mo brlag 'gro yi 'dug zer nas gsungs kyi yod red/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thag ring po red 'gro yi 'dug gsungs pa red/ tshig la mgo bo 'khor/ spros pas bcings pa 'di 'dra red 'gro ba red/ des na sems kyis sems la blta zer yag 'di nga tshos kyang sems la blta zer ba'i skabs su mig gis mig la blta ba 'dra po zhig dgos gsungs 'dug

/phyag chen nges don rgya mtsho'i nang la/ mig gis mig la blta zer dus mig gis mig la ga 'dra blta dgos red/ nga rang gi mig gis nga rang gi mig la blta yag yod ma red de yin na'ang blta ba 'dra po gcig gis blta dgos kyi yod red/ zhe drag gis u tshugs brgyab na yag po yod ma red/ mig gis mig la blta yag yod red pas yod ma red/ 'o 'di 'dra po byas nas blta dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'dis don dag ga re bstan gyi yod red zer na/ sems kyi sems la blta zer yong dus da ngas sems la blta yi yin zer nas tsog tsog 'dra po byas nas bsdad nas mig btsum nas blta dus gcig mthong rgyu yod na bsam bsam 'dra po zhig 'di mthong rgyu gang yang yod ma red/ mthong rgyu yod na tshang mas mthong bsdad kyi red pa/ mthong yag gang yang yod ma red/ mthong yag med pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ mthong ba med pa mthong ba dam pa 'di ni mchog go// 'di ni yon tan gyi mchog yin gsungs pa red/ blta yag med pa red sems kyis sems la ltos/ sems kyis sems la blta bya lta byed med pa'i tshul gyis blta dgos kyi yod red 'dug /blta bya'i yul las 'das pa/ lta byed kyi sems las 'das pa/ blta bya lta byed kyi spros pa thams cad las 'das pa'i ngo bo la ma bcos pa mnyam par bzhag na de la sems la blta zer nas lab pa red/ sems la blta zer yag 'di blta bya'i yul las 'das pa lta byed kyi sems las 'das pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi steng la ma bcos par dran shes zin pa'i steng nas dran pas bya ra byed nas ma yeng pa tsam zhig gis lhod kyis glod la mnyam par bzhag na/ 'di la sems kyis mthong zer nas lab pa red/ 'di ma gtogs dngos gnas drang gnas sems zer yag 'di gsal rig rig gcig yod/ 'di la blta mkhan gcig yod nas sems la blta zer ba 'di yong gi yod ma red/

00000000 00000255 rnam rtog tshogs 'gag bla med byang chub thob// 3/ 00000000rnam rtog tshogs thams cad 'gag de nas sems kyi sems la blta na ga re phan gyi red/ sems kyi sems la blta na sems kyi ngo bo mthong gi red/ sems la blta zer ba'i skabs su la nga rang tshos blta rgyu yul zhig yod de la blta mkhan gyi sems zhig yod nas blta ba'i skad cha ma red/ rang gi sems nyid mthong*/ rnam rtog tshogs 'gag bla med byang chub thob// sems kyis sems la blta na/ rnam rtog gi tshogs thams cad 'gag 'gro yi red/ rnam rtog gi tshogs thams cad 'gag zer ba'i skabs su sems la blta nas 'gag song zer ba'i skad cha ma red/ rnam rtog gi tshogs thams cad rang zhi nas 'gro yi red gsungs pa red/ dper na me chen po zhig 'bar yod na shing de zad 'gro ba'i skabs su me de rang bzhin gyis shi 'gro yi red pa/ me 'di shing ji tsam snon pa brgyab na shing ji tsam mang na me yang de tsam che ru 'gro ba nang bzhin gyi sems la rnam rtog gi 'du 'phro mang po zhig slebs yong dus rnam rtog gi rjes su 'brang nas rnam rtog snon ma mang po brgyab pa yin na rnam rtog mang 'gro yi red pa/ des na rnam rtog gi snon ma ma brgyab nas rnam rtog gcig shar na'ang shar du bcug /yin na'ang rnam rtog de la bzo bcos ma btang*/ rnam rtog de la dgag sgrub ma byed/ rnam rtog de rang sor bzhag bzhag na/ de nas rnam rtog gi tshogs de je nyung je nyung du 'gro ba red/ nam zhig la gnyen po'i stobs dam pas zin yong dus stobs dam pa zhig slebs yong dus rnam rtog ga tshod mang na'ang de tsam gyis rnal 'byor pa'i rtogs pa'i bogs 'don chags/ phyag rgya chen po'i sems kyi gnas lugs kyi grogs chags/ rnam rtog ga tshod mang ba de tsam gyis phyag rgya chen po de 'dra'i rnal 'byor pa de la nyams gong 'phel du 'gro/

rtogs pa gong 'phel du 'gro thub yag de yong gi yod red/ nags la ji tsam me chen po yod na rlung ji tsam chen po yod pa de tsam gyis rlung 'di grogs chags yong gi yod red pa/ 'di nang bzhin snang ba lam du 'khyer bsdad pa'i rnal 'byor pa la rtog pa btsan sa zin thub pa'i rnal 'byor pa la ji tsam rnam rtog mang na de tsam gyi rtogs pa'i bogs 'don chags thub pa red/ 'di skabs su rnam rtog gi tshogs 'gag zer ba 'di ga re red/ rnam rtog gi tshogs 'gag zer ba 'di rnam rtog gi tshogs rang zhi ru 'gro yi red gsungs pa red/ tshig 'di la go dgos kyi 'dug /rnam rtog rang zhir song ba zer ba 'di ga re red/ rnam rtog gi tshogs thams cad rang bzhin gyis zhi song ba red/ rnam rtog bkag ma dgos pa red/ rnam rtog bkag thub kyi ma red/ des na rnam rtog bkag zer nas rnam rtog tshogs 'gag zer yong dus rnam rtog bkag yag med pa red/ brag skya rdo rje rdzong gi skor tsho snga ma'i skabs ku thang gi sngags pa zhig la rje btsun mi las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ yid 'gyu byed 'di lcags kyi par bur bcug kyang mi thub pa zhig gda' ste// de la dran pa rang stong du shes pa'i jo bo rnal 'byor pa 'dra yod de// nga rang tsho'i rnam rtog 'di lcags kyi par bur gcig nang la blugs/ rlung cung zad gcig kyang thar sa med pa de'i nang la bzhag /rnam rtog 'di de'i nang la bcug tshar ba byas/ da phyi log la mda' dang mdung dang gri dang me mda' la sogs pa bzung bsdad mkhan de 'dra stong phrag stong phrag gis bsrung nas bsdad pa yin na'ang rnam rtog bkag thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ des bkag thub kyi ma red pa/ khyod rnam rtog skye chog gi ma red da zer nas lab pa yin na da dung rnam rtog mang du 'gro yi red ma gtogs dbang yod byed nas rnam rtog bkag thub kyi ma red pa/ rnam rtog la bkag thub yag med pa red/

dbu ma'i skabs la yin na'ang spyir btang gi nga tsho'i bden 'dzin 'di bkag yag cig gsungs kyi yod red/ yin na'ang bden 'dzin 'di bkag yag 'di yang bden med shes pa'i steng nas chos thams cad bden par med pa dang chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i steng nas chos thams cad bden par grub pa bkag yag cig red ma gtogs ched du gnyer nas snang ba 'di bkag gi mi 'dug /lhag par dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i skabs la yin na ched du gnyer nas bkag pa yin na nyes pa mang po yod gsungs pa red/ rnam rtog bkag gi yod ma red/ 'o na ga re bkag gi yod red zer na/ bkag zer ba 'di rang zhir song ba'i skad cha red/ 'di'i skabs su rnam rtog gi rang ngo mthong yong dus rnam rtog rang zhir song ba/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin shes yong dus rnam rtog gi chos nyid du grol ba/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin shes yong dus rnam rtog 'di sgom gyi grogs chags song ba/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin shes yong dus rnam rtog 'di sgom pa'i nyams shar song ba/ rnam rtog gi ngo bo shes yong dus rnam rtog 'di sgom pa'i rang bzhin du 'gro thub yag /'o 'di 'dras gsungs yong gi yod red 'dug /lam khyer 'dra po gsungs kyi yod red lam du 'khyer ba/ lam du 'khyer ba'ang rnal 'byor pa'i grogs su 'gro thub pa/ bla med byang chub thob thub pa/ de thub na rnam rtog gi tshogs 'di 'gag nas bla med byang chub thob kyi red gsungs pa red/00000000
