kho rang gi sems la gcig blta yong dus sems ngo 'phrod nas skad cig de nyid la khong rnal 'byor pa chags song ba red gsungs kyi 'dug /de lta bu sems kyis sems kyi ngo bo lta zer yong dus 'di 'dra yin pa red 'dug /des na 'di skabs su la sems sems sems zer ba'i skabs la spyir btang phyag chen skabs su sems ngo sprod pa'i skabs su da lta'i shes pa bzang po'i rnam rtog dang ngan pa'i rnam rtog gang yang dpyad rung ba'i gzhi zhig yod red pa 'di la sems zer nas lab pa red 'dug /'di ma gtogs sems kyi ngo bo gang red zer na/ rang bzhin gsal ba zer nas gcig red gnyis red zer nas 'di 'dra mang po bshad mi dgos pa red/ 'di bshad pa yin na tshig la 'gal du chags 'gro yi red pa/ tshig la zhen 'gro yi red/ 'di ma dgos pa red/ sems zer na gang red/ gcig dran bsdad mkhan 'di red/ rig bsdad yag 'di red/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gang red zer ba 'dra po/ sems kyi dbye ba gang red zer ba 'di tsho ma dgos pa red/ 7 mkhan tshul khrims rgya mtsho rin po che mchog gis mdzad pa'i sems sems byung bstan pa'i bstod pa nang la'ang yod pa mchod par brjod pa'i skabs la/ sems dang sems byung rgyu ba gzhi la dag /sems 'das rig stong don gyi 'jam dpal la// sems kyi 'khrul pa rang sar grol ba'i phyir// sems rig gnyis med ngang nas phyag 'tshal lo// gsungs 'dug /'di tsho dpe zab po yod pa red/ sems dang sems byung rgyu ba gzhi la dag /gsungs yong dus sems gtso sems kun 'gro lnga po dang 'khor sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'di/ sems dang sems byung rgyu ba gzhi la dag /zhes rang bzhin gnas rig la dgongs nas gsungs pa red 'dug /nga rang tshos ga tshod cig sems dang sems byung gi 'khrul grol mang po byed kyi yod na'ang gzhi kho rang gi steng nas thar pa red gsungs pa red 'dug

/gzhi la dag zer na/ dngos po dang rtsol sgrub la ltos ma dgos pa kho rang bzhin gyis sems 'di dag pa red gsungs pa 'dug /sems 'das rig stong don gyi 'jam dpal la// sems las 'das pa zer nas bshad yong dus sems rig gnyis su dbye ba phye yong ba red/ 'di'i skabs kyi sems 'di rnam rtog la go dgos pa red 'dug /'khor ba'i 'khrul gzhi sems 'di gtso bo gsungs yong ba red 'dug /da lta kun gzhi rnam par shes pa zer ba de la go rgyu yin pa red/ sems tsam pa'i skabs la yin na/ 'di 'dra'i sems 'das zer ba'i sems las 'das pa'i rang byung gi ye shes 'di la/ don gyi 'jam dpal la/ sems kyi 'khrul pa rang sar grol ba'i phyir// zer ba'i skabs su ma rtogs pa'i las dang po pa'i sems can rnams kyis sems rig gnyis med yin pa ngo ma shes yong dus sems dang rig pa shan phye/ sems dang rig pa shan phye yong dus sems zer ba'i skabs su ma dag pa'i gnas skabs la bshad/ rig pa zer ba'i skabs su dag pa'i gnas skabs su bshad yong dus/ 'di 'dra'i sems dang rig pa gnyis dbye ba med par sems rig dbye ba med pa ma rtogs pa'i gang zag la/ sems kyi 'khrul pa rang sar grol ba'i phyir// zer nas las dang po pa'i nyams len la bshad/ 'di bshad tshar ba'i rjes la/ phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs su'am nyams su len yong dus sam dngos gnas drang gnas kyi gnas lugs kyi steng la tshur sbyar yong dus sam/ yang na lta ba kho rang gi steng nas sgro 'dogs dpyad yong dus lta ba'i steng la tshur nges shes rnyed yag la thabs ga 'dra byed dgos red zer na/ sems rig gnyis med ngang nas phyag 'tshal lo// gsungs pa red/ sems dang rig pa gnyis su med pa'i ngang la phyag 'tshal dgos red gsungs 'dug /'o da 'di tsho'i gral 'di gcig pa red 'dug /mdor na rang sems snying po zer yong pa'i skabs su sems zer ba'i skabs su ma dag pa'i gnas skabs bshad/

snying po zer ba'i skabs su 'di'i ngo bo la go dgos pa red/ rnam rtog ngo bo chos skur gsungs pa bzhin// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis sems kyi snying po 'di yin dus sems kyi snying po 'di la nga tshos sems zer nas lab kyi yod red/ rig pa zer nas btags kyi yod/ de ga nang bzhin gyi rnam shes zer nas kyang btags kyi yod/ ming 'dra mi 'dra ba btags kyi yod red/ da lta nga rang tshos shes pa 'di la/ sems/ rig pa/ rnam shes zer nas ming mang po btags kyi yod red de ming brgya dang ming stong btags bsdad na'ang don gyi sems kyi gnas lugs 'di mtshon thub kyi ma red/ ji tsam ji tsam ming btags na'ang de tsam de tsam mgo bo 'khor yag dang rmongs 'gro yag ma gtogs dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi steng la ming 'dis mtshon thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ tshad ma'i skabs la yin na'ang spyir btang gi don rang mtshan gyi steng la sgra'i mtshon thub kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /zhen pa'i steng nas brjod yong dus bum pa zer ba'i skabs su don gyi bum pa la sems zhen nas bum pa'i byed las byed kyi yod red ma gtogs/ don rang mtshan gyi steng la bum pa zer nas ga tshod sbyar na'ang don rang mtshan de yi steng la bum pa'i tha snyad 'jug thub kyi med gsungs 'dug /'di tsho yang don dag 'di'i steng la sbyar na dpe yag po red 'dug /

de bzhin rang sems snying po kha dog dbyibs las 'das// rang sems snying po 'di sems dang rig pa dang rnam shes zer nas ga tshod cig byed na'ang sems zer yag 'di dngos po zlum zlum gcig kyang yod ma red/ sems zer ba'i skabs su nar nar gcig kyang yod ma red/ sems zer ba'i skabs su gru bzhi yang yod ma red/ sems zer ba'i skabs su sos ka'i kha dog 'dra po yod ma red/ sems zer ba'i skabs su kha dog la yang yod ma red/ sems zer ba 'di dbyibs la yang yod ma red/ sems zer ba 'di mtshan nyid la yang yod ma red/ gsungs pa red/ de bzhin nam mkha' kha dog dbyibs las 'das/ nam mkha' 'di kha dog dang dbyibs dang mtshan nyid la med pa nang bzhin da lta'i sems sems sems zer ba 'di yang kha nas brjod bsdad kyi yod red de/ don gyi steng la dngos po zlum zlum gru bzhi la sogs pa rnams kyi rnam pa la grub yod ma red/ kha dog kyang yod ma red/ dbyibs las kyang 'das pa red/ des na dbyibs las 'das yong dus thams cad ma grub pa red/ nam mkha' nang bzhin byed nas rang gi sems la/ nga rang tshos spyir btang dge ba sgrub pa'i skabs su la sems kyi ngo bo la dge ba 'gos 'gro yag gang yang med pa red la/ sdig pa ga tshod cig tshabs chen po bsags mtshams med lnga'i las 'dra po gcig sdig pa tshabs chen po bsags na'ang sems kyi ngo bo'am sems kyi gnas lugs la sdig pas gos rgyu med pa red/ sems kyi gnas lugs dge sdig las 'das pa red/ dge sdig gis ma gos pa red/ dge sdig bkag na'ang chos 'di 'gog mi 'gyur// gsungs yod red/ 'di la brten nas nga tshos sems can thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas yin/ gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di red pa/ sems can thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas yin zer ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di sems kyi gnas lugs kyi steng la bsam blo btang yong dus sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rang bzhin 'di skyon thams cad ye nas zad bsdad pa/

yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub bsdad pa yin gsungs pa red/ des na ji tsam ji tsam sems can de tsho nyon mongs pa shugs chen po chags nas nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du bskyod/ sdug bsngal khor mo yug tu bskyod na'ang sems kyi gnas lugs 'di la sdug tu 'gro yag med gsungs pa 'di red pa/ ji tsam ji tsam bzang po'i yon tan thams cad gong 'phel du btang*/ ji tsam ji tsam thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab kyis nyams len byed pa yin na'ang sems kyi yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro yag gang yang med gsungs pa red pa/ 'o na gang red zer na/ sems kyi gnas lugs gang yin pa 'di de ga nyid la blta yong dus 'di'i gnas lugs mthong na 'di nas sangs rgyas zer nas lab pa red/ 'di rang red 'dug /rgyud bla las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// gzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// gsungs 'dug /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ glo bur dag gis khams stong gi// rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid kyis// bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// gsungs pa red/ de yin dus bla na med pa'i chos kyis mi stong pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs 'di la/ bzang du sangs rgyas kyis kyang bsgyur mi thub/ ngan du sems can gyis kyang bskyod ma thub pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rang chas su yod bsdad pa de la gnyen pos bcos bsgyur la sogs pa gang yang byed ma dgos par ngo shes tsam gyis grol thub pa/ phar bltas 'khor ba dang tshur bltas myang 'das te tshogs drug gi rnam par shes pa 'di kha tshur ba skor nas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes gcig gi ngo bo la sbyar thub na de nas de ga rang la grol thub kyi yod red/ de ma gtogs tshogs drug gi rnam par shes pa 'dis 'jug shes drug gi yul la zhen pas bcings bsdad pa'i skabs su ji tsam ji tsam gnyen po bsten na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/

'khrul pa chags bsdad kyi yod red/ des na 'khrul grol gnyis kyi sa mtshams 'di rig pa btsan thabs su gnyen pos bcings thub dang mi thub pa la brten nas dbye ba yong gi yod pa nang bzhin gyis sems kyi rang bzhin zer mkhan 'di la kha dog dang dbyibs dang dkar nag la sogs pa gang gis kyang gos pa med pa yin dus/ ming gis steng nas ga tshod lab na'ang 'dra ming gis steng nas ga tshod bed spyod btang na'ang 'dra ming dang tshig gi tha snyad dang rjod byed dang brjod bya la sogs pa'i steng nas rang sems snying po 'di la mtshon thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red yin na'ang spyir btang gis/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// gsungs yong dus tshig 'dis/ ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// zer yong dus dpe nam mkha' bzhag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di gang red zer na/ dang por ma skyes pa/ bar du gang na'ang ma gnas pa/ mthar gang du'ang ma 'gag pa red/ des na skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i rgyu mtshan gcig la song nga tshos thun mong ba'i dpe la nam mkha' 'di go bde po dang go las sla po yod pa yin dus nam mkha' dpe la bzhag pa red 'dug /de ma gtogs spyir btang ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// zer dus nam mkha'i dpe'i steng la don 'di so sor rang rig pa'i ye shes mtshon thub kyi ma red/ mtshon thub kyi med pa red/ da 'o na ga 'dra red/ rang sems snying po 'di kha dog dang dbyibs las 'das pa yin na/ sems don gyi man ngag la nyams len byed ma byed gang yang mi 'dug zer na/ 'di byed dgos kyi yod red/ gang red zer na/ dge sdig dkar nag chos kyis gos mi 'gyur/ ༈ /dge sdig dkar nag gis gos kyi med pa dang*/ kha dog dang dbyibs las 'das pa'i rgyu mtshan yin pa 'di ha go dgos kyi yod red pa/ 'di ma gtogs de ga tsam gyis kha nas kha dog las 'das pa red dbyibs las 'das pa red zer nas lab bsdad pas phan gyi yod ma red/

kha dog las 'das pa'i tshul ga 'dra red/ dbyibs las 'das pa'i tshul ga 'dra red/ dge sdig dkar nag la sogs pa'i chos kyis gos ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di sems kyi snying po 'di la yon tan gyi khyad par can ga re 'dug zer nas brtag dpyad btang yong dus/ gzod sems kyi yon tan 'di la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab kyis nges shes rnyed/ gzhan gyis 'phrog tu mi thub pa'i spobs pa dang gzhan gyis 'phrog tu mi thub pa'i nges shes/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha' la phebs nas khyod kyi gnas lugs 'di nor song gsungs na'ang drang don du gsungs red ma gtogs nges don ma red bsam thub pa gcig gis 'di 'dra'i sems la nges shes gcig slebs yong dus de nas sems kyi gnas lugs mthong ba red gsungs pa red 'dug /yin na yang mtshon byed dpe gcig dgos kyi yod pa red/ dpe med na don mtshon thub kyi yod ma red/ ming yang dgos kyi red/ de'ang*/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na// 'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur// de bas rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir// mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad// gsungs 'dug /ming gdags pa dang dpe bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di so so skye bo rnams la rtog pa'i drwa ba mang pos bcings bsdad pa red/ rtog pa'i drwa ba 'di phar ba shig yag la gnas lugs kho rang kha thug la ngo sprad na 'di ha go thub kyi ma red/ rtogs thub kyi ma red/ yin na yang 'di mtshon par byed pa la dang po dpe'i sgo nas brda thabs du ma bstan nas yong dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug /nga tsho da lta sngags kyi skabs su yin na'ang rim gnyis las rdzogs rim 'di thad kar rtogs ma thub yong dus de la brten nas dang po bskyed rim 'di gsungs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di red 'dug /bskyed rim med pa la rdzogs rim yong gi med pa red/ thabs la ma brten par thabs byung gi 'brel ba yong gi ma red/

de yin dus sngags kyi skabs su dang po bskyed rim bshad/ bskyed rim la lha'i rnam grangs 'di tsho bshad/ gzhal yas khang gi lha/ de ga nang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor/ de nas sngags bzla ba gsung yig 'bru la sogs pa mdor na mngon byang lnga'i thog nas lha bskyed stangs dang dkyil 'khor bskyed stangs la sogs pa 'di tsho tshang ma gsung yag 'di tsho kun rdzob kyi drang don red/ lha zer ba 'di dngos gnas yod ma red de lha zhes pa med na'ang spyir btang rnam rtog ngan pa skye ba dang rnam rtog bzang po skye ba gnyis byas na/ rnam rtog bzang po skye ba gdams kyi red pa/ rnam rtog ngan pas da lta bar du 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas ma rig pa yis rgyu byas las nyon gnyis kyis rkyen byas nas de ga tsam zhig 'khor ba la nying mtshams sbyor nas 'gro ba rigs drug la ngan song gi sdug bsngal de ga tsam myong dgos yag 'di don med pa'i rnam rtog 'di 'dra byung ba red/ 'di 'dra rnam rtog 'di phar thad kar bshig yag la lam sang rdzogs rim 'dra po zhig bstan dgos na rnam rtog bshig thub kyi med pa red/ gang red zer na/ bag chags shin tu nas mthug drag pa yin pa dang*/ bag chags shin tu nas kyang yun ring ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di la brten nas yong thub kyi yod ma red/ len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra// sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab// bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes// 'di ni byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan/ zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang thad kar du bstan thub mi 'dug /gang red zer na/ len pa'i rnam shes 'di dpe phra bo yin pa red/ sa bon thams cad ni chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bab pa yin dus lam sang gcig gsungs bzhag pa yin na nga tshos de la bdag tu zhen nas bdag tu 'khrul 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa red/ des na lam sang rdzogs rim bstan ma thub pa yin dus rdzogs rim 'di skye yag la dang po bskyed rim bshad/

lha'i rnam grangs bshad/ lha'i rnam grangs 'dren pa 'di tsho bshad/ de nas lha'i kha dog la brten nas kha dog dkar po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di chos thams cad stong nyid kyis zin pa'i brda red zer yag 'dra po/ phyag g.yas pa la ral gri bsnams yag 'di srid pa'i drwa ba bcad pa'i brda red zer yag 'dra po/ g.yon pa la bdud rtsi bsnams yag 'di 'chi ba med pa 'chi med kyi btsan sa zin pa'i brda red zer yag 'dra po mang po gsungs bsdad kyi 'dug /'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig yongs su dag pa la thod phreng lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa la sogs pa phag mo'i skabs su 'di 'dra mang po gsungs kyi 'dug /de nang bzhin gtsang btsog gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa bshig yag ched du phag gi dbu 'dra po lha kho rang la dag pa dran pa bshad yong dus kha dog dbyibs dang kha dog phyag mtshan la sogs pa re re la yang kun rdzob re re la don dam re re sbyar nas gsungs kyi 'dug /'di ga re red zer na/ las dang po pa 'dis rdzogs rim la thad kar 'jug ma thub yong dus brda dang thabs dang lam gyi rim pa la brten nas 'khrid dgos kyi 'dug /de yin dus sems kyi snying po kha dog dbyibs las 'das pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di shes yag la dang po nga rang tshos mi rtag pa bshad/ de nas byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa bshad/ de ga nang bzhin gyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi nyams len 'di tsho re re bzhin du bshad yag de yang rtsa ba 'di sems kyi gnas lugs mtshon pa'i brda la gsungs pa red pa/ ma gi chos 'dul ba kā ri kā nas bzung ste ya gi gnyis med dus 'khor gyi bar du mdo sngags kyi chos tshul thams cad dang rgyud sde gong ma 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod pa 'di tsho'i sgang la slebs kyi yod red/ 'di ga re red zer na/ rang sems snying po gang yin pa 'di rtogs pa'i ched du slebs pa red 'dug /sems don rtogs pa'i ched du gsungs pa red/

de yin dus nam mkha' la dbyibs dang kha dog dkar nag ma grub pa 'di nang bzhin red/ rang gi sems nyid mthong na dge ba dang sdig pa gang gis kyang gnod pa mi bya/ phan ma btags/ sus kyang phan btags yod ma red/ sus kyang gnod skyel yod ma red/ 'das pa'i skabs su la'ang phan btags yod ma red/ ma 'ongs pa'i skabs su la'ang phan gdags kyi ma red/ da lta'ang 'dogs kyi yod ma red/ 'o na sangs rgyas zer yag 'di 'tshal dgos na/ sangs rgyas 'di zur du 'tshal 'ong yag gang yang yod ma red/ rang gi sems nyid rtogs pa las sangs rgyas gzhan na yod ma red pa/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zer yag 'di rang gi sems kyi steng nas sangs rgyas zer nas lab dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'gro zer ba'i skabs su thag ring po zhig la 'gro 'ong sa ci yang med pa red/ ga re red zer na sems kyi gnas lugs 'di rtogs na sangs rgyas red/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las gsungs pa nang bzhin/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// zer ba'i tshig 'dis skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// zer ba'i skabs su skad cig gcig gis sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs yong dus 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bye brag phyed yong ba red/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// zer ba'i skabs la skad cig gcig gis rang gi sems kyi gnas lugs 'di mthong yong dus rdzogs sangs rgyas song ba red/ zhe drag thag ring po med pa red/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'di yin dus sangs rgyas rang gi sems las rnyed pa ma gtogs zur du sangs rgyas zer yag 'di 'tshal dgos na rnyed yag med pa red/ dwags po rin po che la mi las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ lta ba yin par nged kyis sems la ltos// sems las gzhan du lta ba btsal ba na// gyad kyis nor 'tshol dang 'dra'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// gsung yag 'dra po 'di 'dras lta ba sgom pa spyod pa mar rim pa bzhin du gsungs 'dug

/de yin dus thams cad sems kyi steng nas yong gi yod red/ 'bras bu sems kyi steng nas yong dgos kyi yod red/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang gi skabs su dpe bshad pa'i skabs la/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med/ ces stong nyid kyi don dag bshad/ slar grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// zhes pa'i skabs su stong nyid yin na yang gsal stong 'du bral med pa yin par bshad/ de yin dus dang po/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// zer ba'i skabs la las dang po pa la gsungs pa red/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// zer ba'i skabs su blta bya gzhi sems kho rang med na'ang blta dgos kyi red gsungs pa'i skabs su las dang po pa'i lta ba byed/ sngags kyi skabs su/ sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// zer ba'i skabs su dbang po 'bring gi spyod pa bshad song*/ dbang po 'bring gi skabs su blta yong dus 'o na ga 'dra yong gi red zer na/ sems stong nyid red zer nas stong nyid kyi thog nas bshad/ grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// 'di dbang po yang rab kyi spyod pa ste 'di skabs su lam khyer gsungs pa red/ 'dod yon ma spang lam khyer bshad pa red/ nyon mongs ma spang lam khyer bshad pa red/ 'o da 'di 'dra'i thog nas lam khyer gsungs yong dus snang tsam nyid nas sems su 'dus// zer ba'i skabs su mtha' las 'das pa'i lta ba gsungs pa yin gsungs kyi 'dug /mtha' thams cad las 'das pa'i lta ba gsungs pa red/ sems can kun gyi sems nyid de// zer ba'i skabs su sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi gnas lugs bde ba chen pa bshad yong dus e waṃ zung 'jug ste dus 'khor skabs su yin na/ bde ba chen po dang stong pa chen po zung 'jug gi thog nas sbyar bar bshad bsdad kyi 'dug /de la/ sems can kun gyi sems nyid de// bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*// zer nas mar cha tshang sems ngo sprad yag gi man ngag gsung bsdad kyi 'dug

/dge sdig dkar nag chos kyis gos mi 'gyur// de yin dus bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo las gsungs yod red/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du ma btsal bar 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zer nas bcom ldan 'das khong rang gis rjes 'jug thams cad la mang po gsungs 'dug /sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin gsungs pa 'di da lta'i sems 'di ha go thub na sangs rgyas yin zer ba red/ 'di ma gtogs sems 'di phar bzhag nas sangs rgyas gcig gzhan du btsal dgos na med pa red/ 'bras bu gzhan du btsal dgos na med pa red/ rang gi sems 'di tshur bzhag 'bras bu gzhan du re dgos na yong gi med pa red/ sems kho rang la brten nas sangs rgyas yin pa rtogs thub kyi yod red/ rje btsun mi las/ sangs rgyas lag pa'i mthil na gda'// zer yag 'di red pa/ sangs rgyas lag pa'i mthil na gda'// gsungs pa lag pa nang la sangs rgyas 'dug zer nas gsungs pa ma red/ 'o na ga re red zer na/ shin tu thag nye drag pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas/ sangs rgyas lag pa'i mthil na gda'// gsungs pa red/ ngo shes ma shes gcig red/ khyed rang ngo ma shes nas lhag bsdad pa red ma gtogs ngo shes na sangs rgyas khyod rang mnyam du rtag par 'dug gsungs pa red pa/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du ma btsal bar 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// gsungs pa 'di tsho gcig pa red/00000000

16711680 da 'khor chos kyis sems kyi ngo bor ma gos pa'i tshul/ 00000000 0000000000000255 dper na gsal dwangs nyi ma'i snying po de// bskal pa stong gi mun pas sgrib mi 'gyur// de bzhin rang sems snying po 'od gsal de// bskal pa'i 'khor bas sgrib par mi nus so/ ༈ /6/ 00000000dper na gsal dwangs nyi ma'i snying po de/ ces nyi ma zer yag 'di gsal po yod pa/ 'jig rten gyi mun pa thams cad bsal thub pa red pa/ shin tu dwangs pa yod pa/ shin tu gsal po yod pa/ 'di 'dra'i gsal dwangs zer ba'i skabs su nyi ma'i yon tan bshad pa red pa/ nyi ma'i yon tan ga re red zer na/ gsal zhing dwangs pa red zer ba red/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od kyis gsal po bzos thub pa dang*/ de yang rnyog pa med pa dwangs thub yag red pa/ nyi ma kho rang la rnyog pa'i dri mas nam yang gos myong yod ma red/ ji tsam ji tsam thal ba lang ji tsam ji tsam rdul 'tshub ji tsam ji tsam sprin la sogs pa de 'dra'i btsog pa yod na'ang nyi ma la rdul dang sprin dang du ba la sogs pas gos thub kyi ma red/ 'di nyi ma'i yon tan yin pa red/ 'di 'dra'i gsal dwangs kyi yon tan 'di gdod ma nas gsal ba'i rang bzhin red ma gtogs nyi ma 'di dang po nag khung 'dra po gcig chags de nas rkyen la brten nas gsal po chags yong ba 'di 'dra ma red/ nyi ma 'di kho dang po nyid nas gdod ma nyid nas gsal po chags bsdad yod red/ gdod ma nyid nas gsal ba'i rang bzhin red/ gdod ma nyid nas dwangs pa'i rang bzhin red/ 'di 'dra yin dus ye gdod ma nas gsal ba'i rang bzhin yin pa la dwangs pa'i rang bzhin yin bsdad yag gi yon tan snying po 'di mun pa shin tu mthug po dper na bskal pa stong phrag mang po'i bar bsags bzhag pa'i mun pa gcig slebs yong na yang 'dis nyi ma la bsgrib thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /mun pa shin tu gnag pa bskal pa stong phrag mang po bar du bsags nas nyi ma la nag khung bzo yi yin/

da nyi ma'i 'od 'di med pa byed kyi yin zer nas lab pa yin na yang nyi ma'i 'od gsal ba skad cig ma 'di nam yang nyi ma'i gsal ba rnyog thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ ji tsam ji tsam bskal pa stong phrag mang po la bsags bzhag pa'i mun pa nyi ma'i 'od gsal ba 'di skad cig ma gcig red/ skad cig ma gcig la nyi ma'i 'od 'di shar yong dus 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mun pa thams cad bsal/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'od kyi snang ba dang 'od kyi gsal ba bskyed thub kyi red gsungs pa red 'dug /'di ma gtogs bskal pa stong phrag mang po la bsags bzhag pa'i mun pa 'dis nyi ma'i 'od 'di phar mog mog por byed thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ dpe 'di las sla po 'dug /bskal pa stong gi mun pas sgrib mi 'gyur// bskal pa stong gi mun pas nyi ma'i 'od 'di sgrib thub kyi ma red/ nyi ma'i yon tan 'di sgrib thub kyi ma red/ 00000000de bzhin rang sems snying po 'od gsal de// dpe de bzhin du rang sems snying po 'od gsal de/ sems kyi ngo bo 'od gsal 'di da lta tshad ma rnam 'grel nang gsungs pa ltar/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba// zhes gsungs 'dug /spyir btang mdo sems thun mong ba'i lugs kyi bstan bcos gcig red de/ yin na'ang 'di nang la spyir btang gi snying po'i lugs kyi tshig dang 'dra ba mang po gsungs kyi 'dug /'dra po zhe drag yod pa red/ des na rang gi sems kyi ngo bo 'od gsal ba 'di nyid skad cig ma nyid la rtogs la/ skad cig nyid la rtogs zer na skad cig gcig la rtogs nas gsungs pa red/ de bzhin rang sems snying po 'di skad cig ma gcig la rtogs na/ bskal pa'i 'khor bas sgrib par mi nus so// bskal pa la bsags bzhag pa'i sdig pa dang*/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags bzhag pa'i sdig pa/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags bzhag pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad kyang skad cig gcig la bsal thub kyi red gsungs pa red/

mdor na nga tshos sdig sgrib sbyong yag la lha rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang*/ de ga nang bzhin bde gshegs sum cu so lnga'i ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga /de ga nang bzhin gyi sngags kyi lugs su yin na sbyin sreg byed pa la sogs pa dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten bzheng yag la sogs pa nga rang tsho'i sdig sgrib sbyong yag gi thabs la rim pa mang po bsten gyi yod red de/ spyir btang sdig pa sbyang yag gi thabs la bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo dang sngags las gsungs tsam zhig red ma gtogs don du sdig sgrib 'di cha tshang sbyang thub kyi red zer yag gi 'gan 'di cha tshang yod ma red/ yin na yang yag shos 'di tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta bar du las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i sdig pa'i las mtshams med pa dang tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsags bzhag pa 'di tsho phar 'joms yag la thabs zab shos 'di ga re red zer nas dri yong dus thabs zab shos 'di sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa 'di rtogs thub na thabs zab shos 'di yin gsungs 'dug / de bzhin rang sems snying po 'od gsal de// bskal pa'i 'khor bas sgrib par mi nus so// zer ba'i skabs su bskal pa stong phrag mang po la dmyal ba la lan grangs mang po yi dwags la lan grangs mang po dud 'gro la lan grangs mang po/ de ga nang bzhin gyis lha dang mi dang lha ma yin la sogs pa 'gro ba rigs drug /skye gnas rnam pa bzhi/ lam rgyud lnga la sogs pa ga ba la phyin na'ang ga tshod cig sdig pa mang po bsags bzhag yod na'ang bskal pa stong phrag mang po la bsags bzhag pa'i sdig pa yod na'ang rang sems snying po 'od gsal 'di skad cig gcig gis rtogs na grol thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'di yis sdig pa 'di sbyang thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zer mkhan 'di yin pa red/

rgan mo'i mdzub tshug zer yag 'dra po dang*/ sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zer mkhan 'dra po dang*/ bya brgya 'ur ded kyi gdams ngag zer yag 'dra po de 'dra mang po 'dug /'di tsho kha thug kha thug ngo sprod yong dus sdig po che yin na'ang kho sems kyi gnad 'gag 'dra po zhig zin thub pa yin na grol 'gro yag red 'dug /bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i mun pas sgrib thub kyi ma red/ de bzhin du rang sems snying po 'od gsal 'di la/ bskal pa'i 'khor bas sgrib par mi nus so// gsungs 'dug /yang rgyud bla ma las/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug pa dang*// gnas skabs de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba'i don// rtag tu mi 'gyur yon tan dbyer med ni// don dam dbyings kyi dgongs don yin zhes bya/ zhes dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyis/ rin chen nam mkha' chu dag bzhin// rtag tu rang bzhin nyon mongs med// zer yag 'dra po da lung mang po yod red de tsho dpe 'dra po red 'dug /de bzhin rang sems snying po 'od gsal de// bskal pa'i 'khor bas sgrib par mi nus so// zer ba 'di dang*/ mdor na don dag 'di rang gi sems kyi snying po 'od gsal ba gang yin pa 'di da lta bar du ngo ma shes pa red gsungs pa red/ sems kyi snying po 'od gsal ba 'di nga rang la yod red pas zer na rang gi rgyud la rang chas su ye gdod ma nas yod red gsungs pa red/ ye gdod ma nas yod na'ang da lta shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi shangs pa'i phyag chen nang la yod red/ sla drag pas yid ma ches/ nye drag pas ngos ma zin/ gsungs pa nang bzhin sla drag nas yid ma ches pa red/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal zer yag 'di dpe dka' las khag po mgo yu 'khor dgos yag gang yang med pa red 'dug /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal zer yag 'di rang gi rgyud la yod pa yin dus 'di la do snang gcig sprad nas bla ma bzang po'i man ngag dang 'grogs nas sgom gyi yin na las sla po yod red/

de yin dus sla drag nas yid ma ches pa red gsungs pa red/ sla drag pas yid ma ches/ nyes drag pas ngos ma zin gsungs pa red/ thag nye song dus rang gi sems 'di rang la yod red pa/ thag nye drag dus ngos ma zin pa red/ ring ba'i shing sdong mthong thub kyi yod red de yin na yang nye drag pa'i mig gi spu ris mthong thub kyi mi 'dug /de nye drag nas mthong ma thub pa red/ 'o de yin dus sla drag pas yid ma ches/ nyes drag pas ngos ma zin/ gsungs pa red/ de nang bzhin gyi da lta 'di'i skabs la'ang gcig pa red/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin la dpe bzhag nas mdor na sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba 'di nga rang la yod na'ang ngo ma shes pa red/ 'di rtogs thub na ga 'dra rtogs dgos red zer na/ rtogs zer ba'i skabs su la sgom brgyab nas rtogs rgyu yod pa'i skad cha gang yang ma red/ ga re dgos red zer na/ spyir rang la tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta bar du sems rgyud la de 'dra po'i snying po'i 'od gsal ba 'di yod na'ang 'di la do snang chung chung byas/ chags sdang la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur/ de'i gzhan dbang du gyur yong dus nyon mongs pa 'di stobs che drag btsan drag 'di yis dbang du song nas sems kyi rang bzhin snying po 'od gsal ba 'di yod na'ang mthong thub kyi med pa red/ 'di sgrib 'gro ba red/ da lta dngos gnas drang gnas kyi las dang smon lam gyis 'phrad nas lam khyer gyi nyams len zab po 'di 'dra zhig byed yong dus 'di la do snang chung chung du ma song bar/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba gang yin pa 'di mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i gdams ngag dang*/ rang gi yang sngon gyi bsod nams kyi las 'phro sad nas de'i stobs kyis sems kyi rang bzhin snying po 'od gsal gang yin pa 'di ma nor ba ma 'khrul bar dam chos tshad ma las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis nyams len byed de'i steng du ngo 'phrod yong dus de nas bskal pa stong phrag mang po la bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad kyang skad cig gcig la byang 'gro yi red gsungs pa red 'dug

/go bde bo zhig bshad bzhag na mang po gang yang med pa red/ de bzhin rang sems snying po 'od gsal de// bskal pa'i 'khor bas sgrib par mi nus so/ ༈ /gsungs pa 'di ngo shes ma shes dang sgrib ma sgrib zhig la bzhag 'dug /ngo shes ma shes gcig red ma gtogs yod pa tsam gyis phan gyi ma red/ yod ni sems can thams cad la yang yod red pa/ yin na yang yod pa 'di shes dgos kyi yod red/ ma shes na da rung yang sgrib bsdad pa red/ de yang phyag chen smon lam las/ 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu sangs rgyas kyang*// ma rtogs dbang gis mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i sems can la// bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog /gsungs pa 'di 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu sangs rgyas zer yag 'di gang red/ 'gro ba'i rang bzhin 'di dus rtag tu rang bzhin snying po 'od gsal 'di las 'du 'bral yod ma red gsungs pa red/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal 'di dang 'du 'bral yod ma red/ mdog skyo ba thabs skyo ba rgyu chung ba dpal 'byor med mkhan sprang po 'di tsho la sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba 'di thabs chags zhig ma gtogs med/ rgyu che ba kha thabs che ba mi dpon po gzi brjid chen po 'di tsho la sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba 'di yag ga yod pa 'di 'dra yod ma red/ rigs mtho dman dang de ga nang bzhin skye ba bzang ngan dang dpal 'byor che chung la brten nas sems kyi rang bzhin snying po 'od gsal 'di yang yag sdug yong gi yod ma red/ 'o na ga re red zer na/ 'di la do snang zhig sprad ma sprad gcig red ma gtogs do snang sprad na sems 'di rtogs/ do snang ma sprad na 'khrul bsdad pa red 'dug / 16711680don de slar yang rgyas par bkral ba/ 0000000000000255 dper na nam mkha' stong par tha snyad rab btags kyang*// nam mkha' la ni 'di 'drar brjod du med//

de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang*// brjod pas 'dir 'drar grub ces tha snyad gdags gzhi med/ ༈ /7/ 00000000dper na nam mkha' stong par tha snyad rab btags kyang*// gsungs pa 'di/ nam mkha' stong pa la tha snyad mang po btags nas nam mkha' stong pa red zer yag 'dra po dang nam mkha' la dbyibs yod red zer yag 'dra po dbyibs 'di yang gru bzhi red zer yag 'dra po zlum po red 'dra po phywa le ba dang phywa le ba ma yin pa 'dra po red zer nas bshad bsdad pa yin na'ang nam mkha' 'di la grub kyi yod ma red/ nam mkha' mtshon thub kyi yod ma red/ da gin dpe zhu ba nang bzhin/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par gyis// de ltar chos mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas te// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin// zer nas dpe 'di ma gtogs gzhan dag rnyed thub kyi med pa red 'dug /kun mkhyen klong chen pas kyang gsungs yod red/ 'di don brjod la rgyal ba'i ljags kyang rdug /gsungs pa red/ sems kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa'i gnas lugs gang yin pa 'di 'dra zhig yod red zer nas sgra dang tshig dang brjod bya'i steng nas bshad dgos na bcom ldan 'das kyi ljags kyang rdug gi red gsungs pa red/ 'di nang bzhin gyi nam mkha' de'ang dbyibs gru bzhi zlum po la sogs pa gang du'ang ma grub pa red/ brjod du med pa red/ dper na 'di dang 'dra ba nam mkha' stong par tha snyad rab btags kyang*/ 00000000nam mkha' la ni 'di 'drar brjod du med// nam mkha' la mtshan nyid 'di dang 'di 'dra pos nam mkha' mtshon thub kyi red/ yon tan 'di dang 'di lta bu brjod na nam mkha' 'di mtshon thub kyi red/ de ga nang bzhin rang bzhin 'di dang 'di 'dra po zhig brjod nas nam mkha' mtshon thub kyi red zer na/ mtshon thub kyi yod ma red/

nam mkha' la ni 'di 'drar brjod du med/ thabs ga tshod byed na'ang nam mkha' mthong thub kyi med pa red/ ma brtag ma dpyad tsam la nam mkha' 'di lta bu zhig red zer nas sngon po yod pa gcig dang*/ go 'byed pa tsam la nam mkha' zer nas btags pa red pa/ 'di ma gtogs rig pas yang dag par dpyad nas nam mkha' 'di ga 'dra zhig 'dug zer nas yang skyar gcig brtag na/ nam mkha' mtshon mi thub pa red/ de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang*// 'di bzhin du sems kyi ngo bo la yang ming tsam du sems zer nas lab/ 'od gsal zer nas lab/ rig pa zer nas lab/ de ga nang bzhin 'khor 'das thams cad kyi sprul gzhi zer yag 'dra po red/ rdzogs rim 'dra po zhig bshad/ da ga re bshad bsdad na'ang mtshon thub kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang*// brjod pas 'dir 'drar grub ces tha snyad gdags gzhi med/ ming tsam zhig sems zhes brjod na'ang dbyibs dang ngo bo 'di lta bu zhig brjod du med pa'i phyir/ dbyibs dang ngo bo yod na brjod thub pa yin pa la/ dbyibs dang ngo bo 'di lta bu sems la ma grub pa'i phyir na/ ji tsam ji tsam mtshon byed kyi dpe bshad na'ang sems kyi gnas lugs 'di brjod mi thub pa/ bshad mi thub pa red gsungs pa red 'dug /'di gsung dgos yag gi rgyu mtshan 'di spyir btang sgom chen pa 'di tsho mang che ba zhig tha snyad la zhen pa chen po yod pa red/ tha snyad la zhen pa chen po yod dus rdzogs chen gyi chos skad gcig dang*/ phyag chen gyi chos skad zer yag 'dra po man ngag lugs kyi chos skad 'di tsho la zhen pa chen po yod pa yin dus/ sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa red 'dug zer yag 'dra po dang*/ sems ma bcos pa red 'dug zer yag 'dra po/ sems rang bab red 'dug zer yag 'dra po dang*/ bzhag na'ang sdod bsdad mkhan/ btang bzhag na'ang 'gro bsdad mkhan/ sems 'di dpe khyad mtshar 'dug zer nas mang po zhig bed spyod btang gi yod red/

de 'dra yin dus tshig 'di tsho la zhen po chen po byed na'ang sems la mtshon thub kyi ma red gsungs pa 'di red 'dug /tshig la snying po med par mtshon pa'i brda red 'dug go /sems la snying po mi zin par tshig la snying por bzung mi rung ba'i don dag bstan gyi 'dug /'di gal chen po red/ de 'dra yin dus da ga re dgos kyi red zer na/ nan tan nyams su blangs nas de la gom 'dris byed na sgom thub kyi red gsungs kyi yod red/ nan tan nyams su len nas de la gom zhing 'dris dgos kyi red/ gom zhing 'dris na bla med byang chub thob// gsungs pa nang bzhin gom 'dris byed dgos pa red/ gom 'dris ma byed na de ga tshig la zhen pa chen po byed bsdad pas phan gyi yod ma red/ tshig gis steng nas 'khor ba las grol thub kyi ma red/ tshig gi steng nas sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs thub kyi ma red/ rje btsun mi las gsungs pa nang bzhin/ lta ba stong pa'i ye shes de// kha lta rkyang par shor nyen gda'// don la nges shes ma skyes na// tshig gis bdag 'dzin grol ba med// gsungs pa red/ de nas kha'i lta bar shor ba'i nyen kha yod red/ 'di tsho khas sems kyi gnas lugs mtshon yag gi nyen kha yod red/ don la nges shes skye dgos pa red/ don la nges shes skye zer yag 'di yang las sla po zhig yod ma red/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta bar du las dang nyon mongs pas ji tsam ji tsam bag med du btang*/ ji tsam ji tsam bag chags shugs chen po'i dbang med du song yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus dper na nga rang tsho la tshe stod gcig la lo lnga drug tsam la yang chang rag 'thung bzhag pa 'di bcad shog zer na'ang dka' las khag po 'dug /tshe stod lo kha shas zhig la bag chags ngan pa bsags bzhag pa 'di bag chags 'di bcom dgos na dka' las khag po yod na 'khor ba la ni thog ma yod ma red/ thog ma med pa nas bzung ste da lta bar du lus lan grangs du ma blangs yod red/

de'i ring la nyon mongs pa la ni rtag par 'dris 'dris pa red/ rtag par goms goms pa red/ 'di 'dra zhig la lam sang gnas lugs rtogs dgos red zer na dka' las khag po yod pa red/ gnas lugs rtogs thub kyi yod ma red/ yin na yang goms shing 'dris nas snying stobs dang gcig brtson 'grus dang gnyis/ bla ma bzang po'i man ngag dang 'grogs nas rtag tu de'i ngang las ma 'da' ba stan thog gcig tu spang la be phur btab pa dper na rje btsun mi la ras pa dang rgyal ba rgod tshang pa nang bzhin nyams len byed na yong thub kyi yod red/ gang red zer na/ sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal 'di rang la 'du 'bral med pa yod red/ 'di la rtsad bdar bcad goms 'dris byed nas brtson 'grus byed nas shes thub yag gi thabs shes byed kyi yin na rtogs thub yag 'di chos nyid yin pa red/ chos nyid kyi rtsal red/ rtogs mi thub pa ma red/ rtogs thub yag yod pa red/ rtogs ma thub zer yag 'di brtson 'grus la rag las kyi red ma gtogs brtson 'grus med na yong gi ma red/ brtson 'grus dang shes rab yag po zhig yod na rtogs thub yag yin pa 'di chos nyid yin pa red/ chos nyid kyi rang rtsal yin pa red/ chos nyid kyi gnas tshul yin pa red/ de yin dus 'od gsal zer yag 'di tha snyad dang tshig la zhen pa ma yin pa/ don gyi steng la goms shing 'dris nas de la snang chung ma song bar nyams len gnang dgos gsungs pa red 'dug /nyams su len dgos red gsungs pa red/ nyams len byed dgos pa red gsungs pa red 'dug /sems rgyud la sbyar dgos pa yin pa red/

0000000000000255 de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// chos rnams thams cad de ru ma 'dus med// 00000000de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// de ltar zer na dpe gong du mang po bshad yod red pa/ dpe 'di'i steng du mtshon yong dus sems kyi rang bzhin 'di gdod nas ma grub pa/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'di gdod nas kha dog dang dbyibs las 'das pa/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'di gdod nas mtshan nyid cir yang ma grub pa/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'di gdod nas stong nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pa/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'di gdod nas gsal stong zung 'jug yin pa/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'di gdod nas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba yin pa shes dgos kyi red gsungs pa red 'dug /gdod nas zer yong dus gdod zer ba'i skabs la rdzogs chen skabs su la ka dag zer nas bshad kyi yod red/ ngo bo ka nas dag pa zer ba 'di ye nas dag pa zer ba dang gcig pa red/ ka dag zer yag dang da lta 'di'i skabs su gdod nas zer yag 'di tsho gcig pa red/ don dag snying po 'di dbyibs dang kha dog dang mtshan nyid la sogs pa gang du'ang ma grub pa 'di lta bu'i sems 'di chos thams cad kyi ngo bo yin gsungs pa red 'dug /sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// gsungs pa 'di dpe nam mkha' de zhe drag gal chen po red 'dug /de las lhag pa'i dpe med pa red/ mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin// gsungs 'dug /dpe gzhan dag la sbyar na bsnyad ma thub pa red/ dpe yag shos 'di nam mkha' yin pa red/ gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// gsungs yong dus 'di la go rgyu chen po yod red/ dang po nam mkha' 'dra po ma yin pa mtshan nyid la grub bsdad pa/ dang po nam mkha' 'dra po ma yin pa dbyibs dang kha dog la grub bsdad pa/ dang po nam mkha' 'dra po ma yin pa rang bzhin nyid kyis grub bsdad pa 'dra po zhig la go ba len na sgom log zer nas lab pa red/

'di sgom yag po yong gi yod ma red/ 'o na ga re red zer na/ gdod nas zer ba'i skabs su gnyen po la brten ma dgos pa/ rkyen gyis bshig ma thub pa/ rang gi rang cha gang yin pa 'di 'pho gyur dri ma dang bral ba yin zer bas na gdod nas gsungs pa red 'dug /'di gsung yong dus 'ga' zhig bsam pa'i nang la bla ma gcig la bsten/ bla ma'i man ngag zhu/ de nas de'i steng du sgom brgyab yong dus gdams ngag la bsten nas sems don ngo 'phrod yong dus sems 'di phar 'bal le 'bol le 'dra po zhig red nas/ 'thor rdzas brgyab yong dus phar gtor bzhag pa nang bzhin 'di 'dra bshad yong gi 'dug bsam na ma 'grig pa red/ dbu ma 'jug pa nang la yang*/ gal te rang gi mtshan nyid brten 'gyur na// de la skur bas dngos po 'jig pa'i phyir// stong nyid dngos po 'jig pa'i rgyur 'gyur na// de ni rigs min de phyir dngos yod min// zer nas chos thams cad 'di don dam pa la stong nyid ma yin zer na skyon yin gsungs 'dug /'di tsho gcig pa red 'dug /don dam pa la stong nyid ma yin pa gnyen po la brten nas stong nyid bsgom pas chos thams cad bdag med par gsungs pa yin na/ stong nyid dngos po 'jig pa'i rgyur gyur song ba red zer nas gsungs pa red/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag dngos po 'jig rgyur gyi thal ba/ don dam pa la skye ba mi khegs pa'i thal ba// tha snyad bden pa rigs pas dpyad bzod kyi thal ba la sogs pa'i thal ba mang po dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la dpal ldan zla ba grags pas legs ldan 'byed la btang yod red/ 'o 'di nang bzhin gcig pa red/ 'di yin dus gnyen po gang rkyen la brten nas sems kyi gnas tshul 'di gzhi nas nam mkha' mthong ba 'dra po 'di 'dra la go yi yod ma red/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas zer ba 'dra po/

'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu// gsungs pa 'dra po/ bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab// gsungs pa 'dra po 'di tsho tshang ma gcig pa red 'dug /sems kyi rang bzhin 'di ye gdod ma nas nam mkha' dang 'dra ba yin pa/ ye gdod ma nas sangs rgyas yin pa/ ye gdod ma nas skyon thams cad zad pa yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ chos nyid kun tu bzang po zer yag 'di rdzogs chen skabs su yang spang bya spangs ma dgos pa/ yon tan la gsar du slob ma dgos pa/ ye gdod ma nas grol bsdad pa zhig la kun tu bzang po zer nas gsungs bsdad kyi 'dug /'o 'di la yang kha shas kyis don dag ha ma go ba yin dus kun tu bzang po zer yag 'di ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas zer nas dang po ya gi gnam nas mar rdo zag pa nang bzhin byed nas slebs yong ba zhig la bsam gyi red zer nas lab kyi yod red/ 'di'i don dag 'di ma rtogs pa red/ 'di yin dus kun tu bzang po zer yag 'di ya gi spyi gtsug sgang la bsdad sdod mkhan 'di bshad kyi yod ma red/ rang gi sems rgyud la yod sdod pa'i kun tu bzang po 'di gsungs kyi yod red/ sa man+ta bha dra zer nas saṃskrita nang la dus kun tu bzang po zer yag 'di sems kho rang kun tu bzang po yin yin pa red pa/ sems kho rang dus kun tu nas bzang po yin yin pa red/ dus rgyun du nas bzang po yin pa red/ dus rgyun du nas skyon zad pa yin pa red/ dus rgyun du nas yon tan thams cad 'di ye nas rdzogs pa yin pa red/ de la brten nas kun tu bzang po zer nas lab pa red pa/ kun tu zer ba'i tshig 'di la/ dus gsum dus med rtogs pa po// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis dus gsum med par bstan pa red/ 'das pa zer yag 'di yang yod ma red/ ma 'ongs pa zer mkhan 'di yang yod ma red/ da lta ba zer mkhan 'di yang yod ma red/ dus gsum zer mkhan 'di blo rnam rtog gis btags pa red ma gtogs/

don la dus gsum zer mkhan yod ma red/ de yin dus dus med pa 'di dus thams cad kyi nang la mchog tu gyur pa yin zer ba la brten nas kun tu zer ba 'di red/ mar 'khor ba la song na'ang sems 'di bzang po chags bsdad kyi yod red/ yar mtho ris la song na'ang sems 'di bzang po red/ ji tsam ji tsam 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug shugs chen po yod na'ang sems 'di bzang po red/ ji tsam ji tsam nyon mongs pa dang 'grogs yong na'ang sems 'di bzang po red ma gtogs nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i skabs su sems 'di ngan pa chags/ nyon mongs dang grol yong dus sems 'di bzang po chags song ba 'di 'dra go rgyu yod ma red/ de med pa'i phyir na kun tu zer yag 'di rgyun chad med pa'i brda red pa/ khor mo yug tu de nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu lam ji lta bu zhig gi steng nas bgrod/ sa lam ji lta bu zhig gi steng nas bgrod/ gnyen po ga 'dra zhig gi steng nas 'das lam gyi yon tan ci 'dra po zhig gis thog nas nyams su blangs kyi yod na'ang sems kyi rang bzhin 'di bzang po yin pa'i phyir na kun tu bzang po zer nas lab pa red/ 'di 'dra'i sems kun tu bzang po yin bsdad mkhan 'di la spang bya thams cad ye nas zad pa/ yon tan thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa yin zer yag 'di la go rgyu 'dug /'di go thub kyi red/ de nas dwogs pa yod ma red the tshom za dgos yag med pa red/ 'di la brten nas/ sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// gsungs pa'i gdod nas zer ba 'di red/ sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs phyir// rang bzhin dri med de ni gnyis med de// sangs rgyas rigs la de 'bras nyer btags phyir// 'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po can du gsungs// ces rgyud bla ma'i skabs su gsungs pa nang bzhin dpe 'di tsho dang gcig pa red 'dug

/dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med// dri med sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal ba'i mdzad// zer yag 'dra po da 'di tsho tshang ma gcig pa yin pa red/ sems kyi rang bzhin ye gdod ma nas sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yin par gsungs pa red 'dug /zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po'i mgur gyi nang la yang*/ dus da lta'i snang rig gsal tsam 'di// chos kun rdzob bden pa'i rang ngo yin// 'di ma bcos rang gi gnad shes na// don dam pa'i bden pa'ang 'di kho na/ zhes pa ltar/ gnad 'di sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba gsal stong zung 'jug yin pa 'di'i gnas tshul de yang ye gdod ma nas yin bsdad pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di shes na/ gnad shes pa red/ chos tha snyad mkhan gyis bden gnyis de// lung rigs pa mang yang gnad ma go// zer ba 'di dpe cha ba yis de go thub kyi mi 'dug gsungs 'dug /chos tha snyad mkhan gyis bden gnyis de// lung rigs pa mang yang gnad ma go// zer na lung dang rigs pa ga tshod brgya stong mang po ga tshod bgrang bsdad pa yin na'ang kha nas bshad bsdad pa red ma gtogs 'dis mi thub pa red/ yin na yang sgom chen pa de tshos kho sgom thog nas ngo 'phrod yong ba yin dus gnad ka 'di'i steng la tag tag slebs thub kyi yod pa red 'dug /de yin dus sgom 'di zab shos yin pa red/ 'khor ba las grol yag gi dngos gnas drang gnas dngos rgyu 'di sgom yin pa red/ brgyud rgyu 'di thos bsam gnyis red 'dug /dngos rgyu sgom gyi thog nas grol dgos kyi red ma gtogs thos pas grol thub kyi ma red/ chos rnams thams cad de ru ma 'dus med// sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// zer dus gdod nas nam mkha' dang 'dra ba/ gdod nas dbyibs dang kha dog las 'das pa/ gdod nas mtshan nyid las 'das pa yin dus/ sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// 'di 'dra'i nam mkha' dang 'dra ba yin pa sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' dang 'dra ba 'di gdod nas spros pa kun dang bral ba'i gnas lugs 'di ngo 'phrod yong dus/

chos rnams thams cad de ru ma 'dus med// 'di lta bu'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo 'di ga ba la go dgos red zer na/ 'di lta bu'i sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba 'di la chos thams cad kyi ngo bo yin gsungs pa red/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos thams cad kyi grogs/ chos thams cad kyi skyel sa/ sgom chen thams cad kyi 'bras bu/ sgom brgyab pa'i 'bras bu 'di red/ chos thams cad kyi zad sa zer na'ang 'di red/ chos thams cad kyi 'bras bu yang 'di yin pa red/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bo yang 'di yin pa red/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yang 'di yin pa red/ chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid kyang 'di yin pa red/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs kyang 'di yin pa red/ chos thams cad kyi lam yang 'di yin pa red/ chos thams cad kyi don dam yang 'di yin pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'di 'dra ba'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo dang don dam 'di 'dra yin pa 'di yin pa ha go yong dus/ 'o na ga 'dra byed nas bslab dgos kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra'i sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' dang 'dra ba yin pa 'di ga 'dra byed nas ha go yi red/ rtsod pa brgyab nas shes kyi red pas/ sgom brgyab nas shes kyi red pas/ yin gcig min gnyis bla ma gcig la rtag par gshib bsdad dgos kyi red pas/ khang chung gcig nang la 'dzul/ sgo sge'u khung cha tshang brgyab nas nag khung byas nas bsdad bsdad nas mthong gi red pas/ yang min na khang pa thog rtseg dgu sgang la 'dzag nas rlung bsil po 'dra po zhig nang bsdad nas sgom brgyab na mthong gi red pas/ lam ga 'dra gcig la brten nas shes kyi red/ gnyen po ga 'dra gcig la brten nas shes kyi red/ rkyen ga 'dra gcig gis brten nas rtogs kyi red/ zer nas bshad yong na/ 16711680 lus ngag yid gsum nyams su len tshul bstan pa/ 00000000 00000255 lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs rnal 'byor dal bar sdod//

00000000gsungs 'dug /'di'i skabs su skye thabs gsungs kyi yod red/ sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs rtogs thabs 'di gsungs kyi yod red/ 'di mthun mong gi rtogs thabs red/ mthun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs thabs ma red/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs rnal 'byor dal bar sdod// ngag gi smra brjod med de grags stong brag cha 'dra// gsungs 'dug /'di rtogs par byed pa'i thabs la/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs rnal 'byor dal bar sdod// gsungs 'dug /yar yar 'gro mar mar 'gro gcig red gnyis red zer nas gzugs po 'di 'gul skyod mang po brgyab bsdad na yag po yod ma red gsungs pa red/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs gsungs pa 'di spyir btang gi ga re red/ lus kyi zer ba 'di gzugs po la gsungs kyi yod red pa/ yin na yang lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs zer ba'i skabs su spyir btang 'gro ma bsdad zer ba'i skad cha ma red/ ga re red zer na 'jig rten gyi bya ba 'di ma byed gsungs pa red/ 'gro chags nyal 'dug zer yag 'di spyir btang nga tsho'i chos kyi bar chad byed mkhan gtso bo 'dra po zhig red pa/ ga dus yin na'ang 'gro bsdad yag 'di yang yag po med pa red/ 'gro bdud rkang la zhugs zer na 'gro dus rkang pa la bdud kyis 'jus yong dus de nas 'gro gin bsdad pa ma gtogs bsdad yag rtsa nas med pa chags kyi yod pa red/ smra bdud lce la zhugs/ zer yag 'di bshad nas bsdad yag red ma gtogs rtsa nas bsdad tshugs med pa chags yong gi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus 'gro chags nyal 'dug spyod lam ga 'dra shig yin na'ang 'di thongs gsungs 'dug /spyod lam 'di gal chen po ma red gsungs pa red/ rnal 'byor dal bar sdod/ dal bar sdod zer na nyal sdod zer ba'i skad cha ma red/ ga re red zer na/ 'gro chags nyal 'dug dang 'jig rten gyi thog nas dgra 'dul yag gnyen skyong yag la sogs pa mdor na chags sdang dang srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas thams cad skye thabs kyi lam la ma byed gsungs pa red 'dug

/rnal 'byor dal bar sdod/ zer ba'i skabs la dal bar zer na ga re red/ sems lhod po byed nas bsdad/ lus dal po byed nas bsdad na sgom mnyam bzhag gi steng nas skye yi red gsungs pa red 'dug /spyir btang gi lus shin sbyang gi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas sems shin sbyang gi ting nge 'dzin skye dgos yag red zer nas bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin nang la mang po gsungs 'dug /lus shin sbyang gi ting nge 'dzin yag po med na sems shin sbyang gi ting nge 'dzin yag po skye thub kyi ma red/ spyir btang sems shin sbyang 'di dang po bsten/ de la brten nas lus shin sbyang 'di rjes su gsungs kyi yod red/ lam gyi rim pa'i skabs su yin na yang nyams su len pa'i skabs su dang po lus shin sbyang 'di yag po sngon du ma song na/ sems shin sbyang yag po yong thub kyi yod ma red/ mthun mong du bshad pa yin na yang dper na lus yag po drang na rtsa drang rtsa drang na rlung drang rlung drang na sems drang zer nas bshad kyi 'dug /'di lta bu'i lus sems la 'brel ba chen po yod pa yin dus lus kyi bya ba 'di zhe drag gal chen po yin pa red/ 'gro chags nyal 'dug kho na byed bsdad pa yin na/ 'di ni sems la rang dbang med pa chags kyi red pa/ de 'dra yin dus/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs rnal 'byor dal bar sdod// zer ba'i skabs su ri khrod la slebs dgos kyi yod red/ ri khrod 'dra po mi med pa'i lung pa la slebs dgos pa red/ rje btsun mi las gsungs pa nang bzhin/ nga na ba la dri mi med pa dang*/ shi na ngu mi med pa ru/ ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// rnal 'byor bsam pa rdzogs pa yin// gsungs 'dug /'o 'di lta bu gnas nges med la bsdad dgos pa red/ ri khrod la bsdad dgos pa red/ spros bcas kyi tsam tsob mi ldang bar// spros med kyi lo 'dab rgyas par shog /sgrub khang du yid gnyis mi skye bar// nyams rtogs kyi 'bras bu smin par shog

/gsungs 'dug /sgrub khang du yid gnyis mi skye bar// gsungs pa 'di ga re red zer na/ 'o ga 'dra byed nas sgrub khang nang la nyams dang rtogs pa skye yong mi yong nyams gong 'phel du 'gro yong mi yong 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad rang la skye yong mi yong bsam pa 'dra po the tshom byed rgyu yod ma red gsungs 'dug /na na na thog nas sangs rgyas thub yag /tsha na tsha thog nas sangs rgyas thub yag /gnod pa bskyal na gnod pa'i steng nas nyams nga med pa byas nas thog rdzis byed nas grol thub pa gcig byed dgos red gsungs 'dug /nyams nga'i go skabs gang yang med pa byed nas 'di 'dra po/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs rnal 'byor dal bar sdod// gsungs pa 'di gnas ri khrod la brten nas bsdad dgos pa red/ yul ngan spangs pas nyon mongs rim gyis 'grib// rnam g.yeng med pas dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel// rig pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skye// dben pa bsten pa rgyal sras lag len yin// zer nas rgyal sras lag len nang la 'dug /yul ngan spangs pas nyon mongs rim gyis 'grib// zer ba'i yul ngan pa zer yag 'di lus kyi bya ba 'di tsho yar 'gro mar 'gro dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshong 'dra 'di 'dra'i las ka rkyang rkyang byed bsdad pa yin na/ 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i bya ba chags 'gro yi red pa/ 'di tsho la yul ngan gsungs pa red/ yul ngan gyi nyon mongs spangs yong dus nyon mongs rang bzhin gyis 'grib yong ba red/ nyon mongs rang bzhin gyis thul du 'gro ba red/ nyon mongs kha thug la lam sang sbyong thub kyi ma red/ yin na yang nyon mongs 'di je chung je chung du 'gro ba red 'dug /rnam g.yeng med pas dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel// de nas lus kyi bya ba'i rnam g.yeng med yong dus gnyen thug yag 'dra po dgra thul yag 'dra po cha tshang med yong dus rnam g.yeng med pa red/

rnam g.yeng med yong dus rang gi dge sbyor 'di gong 'phel du 'gro thub kyi red/ 'phel ba'i go skabs 'di ma gtogs med pa red/ rig pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skye// de nas sems rig pa dwangs yong ba red/ chags sdang gnyi ga'i rnam rtog med yong dus chags sdang gnyis skye sa'i gzhi med yong dus sems 'di rig pa dwangs yong ba red/ rig pa dwangs yong dus phyag rgya chen po zer ba 'dra po rdzogs pa chen po zer ba 'dra po 'di 'dra'i mtshan ldan bla mas bstan yong ba'i gdam ngag 'di tsho 'dra po zab pa dang rgya che ba dang mthun mong ma yin pa yin pa dang nges shes drang yong dus lam gong ma gong ma la rtogs pa skye 'dod kyi blo skye/ lam gong ma gong ma la slob sbyong byed/ de la brten nas 'bras bu thob thub yag gi nges shes skye yong ba red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus/ rigs pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skye// dben pa bsten pa rgyal sras lag len yin// gsungs pa red/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs rnal 'byor dal bar sdod// zer nas dal bar sdod gsungs 'dug /dal bar sdod zer yag 'di sgom yag po brgyab dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ sgom brgyab nas lus tsha gi tshi gi ma byed par rje btsun mi la ras pa nang bzhin spang la be phur btab pa ltar nga de ring nas bzung ste grong yul du mi 'bab/ gal srid nyams rtogs khyad par can zhig ma skyes kyi bar du grong yul la 'bab na nga chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyis srog chod cig gsungs nas 'di lta bu'i dam bca' byed kyi 'dug /'o 'di lta bu rtogs pa ma thob kyi bar du yin pa red/ spyir btang gi rtogs pa mchog thob pa zer yag 'di gdul bya gang zag thams cad la 'gro yi red de yin na yang rang gis nyams len la btsan sa zin na 'grig gi yod red/ nyams len la btsan sa zhig zin nas de'i rjes su rtogs pa thob dgos kyi 'dug

/nyams len la btsan sa zin zer na ga re red/ da lta nga rang gi phyag rgya chen po dang rdzogs pa chen po nyams len ga re byed kyi yod pa 'di dngos gnas drang gnas khungs dang ldan pa/ de la brgyud pa bzang po yod pa/ de 'dra po'i yon tan 'dis rang gi rgyud bcos thub pa/ 'di 'dra'i nyams len zhig slebs na rang gi nyams len gyi btsan sa zin pa red/ de'i steng nas yang tog tsam rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi gang zag gzhan dag la bsten yong dus rtogs pa thob ste phyag rgya chen po phyin ci ma log pa yang dag par rtogs pa yin gsungs 'dug /'o 'di 'dra yin dus nyams len la btsan sa ma zin gyi bar du lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs rnal 'byor dal bar sdod// gsungs pa red/

00000000 00000255 ngag gi smra brjod med de grag stong brag cha 'dra// 00000000khyod yag po red zer nas bstod ra yang yong gi red/ khyod sdug cag red zer nas smad ra yang yong gi red/ mdor na dga' sdug yag ngan gyi ca co mang po yong gi red pa/ sgra mang po yong gi red/ sgra thams cad chos kyi dbyings brag cha lta bu red bsam nas mnyam par bzhag dgos red gsungs 'dug /sgra thams cad grag stong 'dra po la bsam blo btang dgos kyi yod pa red/ brag cha nang bzhin grag gi yod red de grag na'ang stong pa yin gsungs 'dug /grag stong zer nas sgra grag ni grag bsdad pa zhig la grag pa yin na'ang ngo bo stong pa yin pa dper na brag cha nang bzhin/ phar la wa ye zer na tshur yang wa ye zer yong gi yod red de yin na'ang 'di stong pa red pa/ 'di nang bzhin/ ngag gi smra brjod med de grag stong brag cha 'dra// gsungs pa red/ 00000000 00000255 yid la ci yang mi bsam la zla'i chos la ltos// 00000000yid la ci yang mi bsam pa/ la bzla ba'i chos la ltos/ zer ba 'di 'bras bu'i chos la ltos gsungs pa red/ gnas lugs kyi chos zer gyi yod red/ mtshams mtshams la rdzogs chen gyi tshig kyang slebs kyi 'dug /la zla'i chos zer na/ la bzla ba zer na 'bras bu la bzla ba/ 'bras bu la bzla ba zer na 'bras bu la slebs tshar ba zer gyi yod red/ la bzla ba zer ba'i skabs su slebs pa'i tshig red/ mthar phyin pa'i tshig red/ mthar phyin pa'i tshig dang don gyi ngo bo nyid kyi tshig red/ yid la ci yang mi bsam la zla'i chos la ltos// lus kyis 'gro 'dug gi spyod lam la sogs pa g.yug shog /ngag nas kha ton bzlas brjod la sogs pa 'di 'dra'i rigs mang po gang yang byed dgos kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /kha ton bzlas brjod la sogs pa byed na yong gi yod ma red/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su// lus ngag gi rtsol ba ma byed cig

/mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// gsungs 'dug /phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i dus su lus kyis spyod lam 'gro 'dug mang po byed yag 'dra po dang*/ phyag 'tshal yag la sogs pa dang*/ ngag gi sgo nas kha ton bzlas brjod la sogs pa mang po byed bsdad pa yin na 'di mi yong ba red/ 'di byed bsdad pa yin na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes de yal yag gi nyen kha yod gsungs song*/ yid la ci yang mi bsam la zla'i chos la ltos// yid la ci yang mi bsam/ zer ba'i skabs su la bsam rgyu zhig yod nas 'di bsam yag bkag shog zer ba'i skad cha red mi 'dug /yid la bsam bya sems byed las 'das pa red/ 'di tsho zhe drag gal chen po red/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs zer ba'i skabs su lus kyi bya ba zhig byed rgyu yod de byed mi chog par btsan po byas nas bkag bzhag pa'i skad cha ma red/ ngag la smra brjod thams cad kyang grag stong nang bzhin red zer nas btsan po dbang yod byas nas ngo sprod byed pa red mi 'dug /don la lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa'i bya byed thams cad las 'das pa zhig dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug /phyag chen smon lam las/ bzang zhen nyams kyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol// ngan rtog 'khrul pa rang bzhin dbyings su dag /tha mal shes pa spang blang bral thob med// spros bral chos nyid bden pa rtogs par shog /zer ba'i smon lam zhig yod pa/ da 'di'i skabs la yang yong gi yod pa red/ bzang po la zhen pa'i nyams kyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol/ ngan pa la rtog pa ngan rtog gi 'khrul pa yang rang bzhin gyis dbyings su dag /bzang zhen dang ngan rtog gnyis 'di phar brlag tshar na/ bzang po'i zhen pa dang ngan pa'i rnam rtog zer yag 'di chags sdang gi rnam rtog red pa/ chags sdang gi rnam rtog gnyis po brlag song na shul na ga re lhag gi red/ de nas tha mal shes pa zhig ma gtogs lhag gi mi 'dug /tha mal shes pa zer na ga re red/

ma bcos pa'i shes pa red/ ma bcos pa'i shes pa zer yag 'di ga 'dra zhig yod red zer na/ mthong ni mthong bsdad pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byed mi thub pa/ dpe lkugs pas bu ram zos pa nang bzhin yin gsungs song*/ lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa dang lkugs pas bu ram zos pa nang bzhin yin gsungs pa red/ 'o 'di 'dra po mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed spyod lam la sogs pa gang yang snying por ma bzung nas lus kyi bya ba thams cad thongs / dal bar sdod/ zer ba'i skabs su lus tsog tsog sdod gsungs pa red pa/ lus dal po byed nas sdod gsungs pa red/ ngag gi smra brjod med de grag stong brag cha 'dra// zhes gal srid smra brjod la sogs pa grag song na yang nga rang gis sgra grag na'ang sgra grag stong nang bzhin rtogs dgos kyi red/ phyi nas nga rang la bzang po'i bstod ra dang ngan pa'i skyon la sogs pa ga re brjod na'ang 'di tsho tshang ma tshig red tha snyad red ma gtogs don la yod ma red/ grag stong brag cha nang bzhin red bsam nas 'di'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /yid la bzang po'i yon tan yang shar gyi red/ ngan pa'i rnam rtog kyang shar gyi red de/ bzang zhen ngan rtog ga re shar song na'ang 'di la ma blta ba byed/ 'di la snying po med par shes nas ma bcos pa'i shes pa tha mal gyi shes pa 'di rang gi ngo bo 'di skyongs gsungs pa red 'dug /la zla'i chos zer na rdzogs pa chen po dang phyag rgya chen po'i chos 'dra po la ltos gsungs pa red/ ltos zer ba'i skabs la 'di'i ngang la ma bcos par mnyam par zhog gsungs pa red 'dug /ltos zer ba'i skabs la mig gis lta zer ba'i skad cha ma red/ ltos zer ba 'di 'di'i ngang la ma bcos pa'am 'di'i ngang la 'du 'a bral med par sdod gsungs pa red/ bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa/ brjod pa'i tha snyad las 'das pa/ lus kyis 'gro 'dug la sogs pa'i spyod lam las 'das pa/

'di gsungs kyi 'dug /lus kyi spyod lam las 'das pa/ ngag gi smra brjod las 'das pa/ yid kyi bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo gang yin pa 'di la/ la zla'i chos la ltos gsungs pa red/ 0000000000000255 lus la snying po med pa smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra// 00000000smyug ma'i sdong po zer mkhan 'di nang stong pa red pa/ phyi log la gcig yod red ma gtogs nang phug stong pa red/ de nang bzhin lus la snying po yod ma red/ smyug ma'i sdong po nang bzhin red/ ke la'i sdong po nang bzhin red gsungs pa red/ snying po med zer yag 'di yang lus la snying po zhig yod nas med zer nas btsog blta bcug pa'i skad cha ma red pa/ rigs pas brtag na ha go yi red gsungs pa red/ spyod 'jug las gsungs pa nang bzhin/ so dang skra sen bdag ma yin// bdag ni rus pa khrag ma yin// snabs min bad kan ma yin te// chu ser dang ni rnag kyang min// bdag ni zhag dang rngul min te// glo mchin dag kyang bdag ma yin// nang khrol gzhan yang bdag min te// bdag ni phyi sa gcin ma yin// sha dang pags pa bdag min te// drod dang rlung yang bdag ma yin// bu ga bdag min rnam kun tu// rnam shes drug kyang bdag ma yin// zer nas lus snying po yod ma red zer nas shes rab le'u nang la dpe ga tshod mang po gsungs 'dug /sna lus red pas/ mig lus red pas/ rna ba lus red pas/ rus pa lus red pas/ pags pa lus red pas/ khrag lus red pas/ zer nas re re bzhin du 'dug /kha na ma tho dngos med la// bdag dang sems can dbang byas shing*// sprul pa bzhin du nga med par// yid 'di rtag tu gzung bar bya// spyod 'jug shes bzhin le'u nang la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i dngos po la bdag dang sems can thams cad dbang du byas shing*/ nga zer yag 'di yang lus kyi cha shas 'di tsho la rim pa bzhin du dpyad yong dus snying po med par bsam blo btang nas sprul pa bzhin du nga med par// nga zer mkhan 'di yang sprul pa nang bzhin sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu dri za'i grong khyer lta bu red gsungs 'dug

/des na snying po med pa/ rigs pa drug cu pa'i nang la yang yod red/ stong nyid bdun bcu pa'i nang la yang 'di tsho dpe gsal po yod red/ 'di tsho stong nyid sgom rim red pa/ stong nyid sgom rim 'di tsho'i nang la yod red/ rig pa drug cu par/ gnas med dmigs pa yod ma yin// rtsa ba med cing gnas pa med// ma rig rgyu las shin tu byung*// thog ma dbus mtha' rnam par spang*// chu shing bzhin du snying po med// dri za'i grong khyer 'dra ba ste// rmong pa'i grong khyer mi zad pa'i// 'gro ba sgyu ma bzhin du snang*/ zer ba 'dra po 'di tsho'i steng nas 'gro yi yod red/ lus la snying po med pa smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra// de ga nang bzhin gyi dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la shing rta rnam bdun gyi rigs pa la brten nas gang zag gi bdag med gsungs pa 'di tsho tshang ma lus la snying po med pa smyug ma'i sdong po'i steng nas 'gro yi yod red/ de ma gtogs de ga tsam rigs pas sgrub bsdad pa'i skad cha gcig pu ma red/ nyams len gyi steng nas 'gro dgos kyi yod red pa/ dbu ma yang nyams len gyi steng nas 'gro dgos kyi red pa/ phyag rdzogs dbu gsum 'di tshig khag khag red ma gtogs don dag gcig pa yin gsungs kyi yod red pa/ gsungs kyi yod na gcig gis gcig la grogs byed dgos kyi yod red/ shing rta rnam bdun gyi rigs pa 'di tshos 'di 'dra rang gsungs kyi yod red/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ gzugs yod nyid na sems med ma 'dzin cig /sems yod nyid na'ang gzugs med ma 'dzin cig /de dag shes rab tshul mdor sangs rgyas kyis// mtshungs par spangs shes mngon pa'i chos las gsungs// gsungs pa 'dra po 'di tsho thams cad kyis lus la snying po med pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po gsungs bsdad kyi 'dug /so la sogs pa'i yan lag la snying po med pa/ nyan thos pa'i skabs su la yang gang zag gi bdag med pa 'di la'ang gang zag rang mtshan gyis ma grub pa zer ba 'dra po dang*/

gang zag mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa zer ba 'dra po dang*/ gang zag rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod kyis stong pa zer ba 'di tsho thams cad kyang lam gyis thog nas rim pa ma 'dra ba bshad pa red ma gtogs 'di 'dra'i lus la snying po med pa rang ngo sprod byed bsdad kyi yod red/ lus la snying po med pa smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra// lus la snying po med zer nas brjod kyi yod red de don gyi ngo bo la smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra po red zer nas bshad yong dus lus la snying po yod pa dang med pa gnyis ka las 'das pa bsam blo btang dgos kyi yod pa red pa/ 'di yang zhe drag gal chen po red// lus la snying po med zer mkhan 'di dang po snying po yod pa zhig byas/ 'di snying po yod pa 'di phar bkag nas snying po med pa zhig gi thog na slebs pa red bsam na/ 'di ldog pa ngos 'dzin 'dra po byas nas bsam blo gtang rgyu med pa red/ snying po med zer ba 'di yang don dag 'di la yag po blta na snying po yod pa dang snying po med pa gnyis ka las ma grub pa red/ snying po yod pa las kyang 'das pa red/ snying po med pa las kyang 'das pa red/ spyir btang nga tshos tha snyad tsam bed spyod btang ba'i skabs la/ snying po yod pa 'di bkag yong dus snying po med pa la slebs yag 'di 'jig rten gyi 'gro stangs zhig red pa/ yod pa bkag nas med pa slebs yag 'di/ yin na yang 'di tsho lam sbyang ba'i gang zag la 'di 'dra bshad kyi yod red ma gtogs dngos gnas drang gnas kyi sgom gyi steng la slebs yong dus 'di 'dra bshad rgyu med pa red/ 'di 'dra byas na 'di ni 'bras bu thob thub kyi ma red pa/ yod zer mkhan 'di yang rnam rtog gi sgro btags pa gcig red/ med zer mkhan 'di yang rnam rtog gis sgro btags pa gcig red ma gtogs don gyi steng la yod pa yang yod ma red/ don gyi steng la med pa'ang yod ma red/

yod pa'ang btags chos red/ med pa'ang btags chos red/ yod med gnyi ga yang gcig gi gcig la ltos gzhi ltos chos 'dra po zhig red ma gtogs yod pa dang med pa'i chos gnyis yod ma red/ de yin dus snying po med zer yong dus nga tshos snying po yod par bzung ba la brten nas da lta bar du snying po yod par bzung che ba'i skyon la brten nas 'di'i bzlog thabs la snying po med zer nas ma gsung rang gsung red pa/ 'di ma gtogs gsung yag yod ma red/ don la snying po med pa de yang mthar thug red zer na 'grig gi yod ma red/ yod med gnyis ka las 'das dgos kyi yod red/ bsod nams ma yin dang por bzlog /bar du bdag ni bzlog pa dang*// tha mar lta zhi kun bzlog pa// gang shes 'di ni mkhas pa yin// zer nas ar+yā dā+e ba'i dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i nang la yod red/ bsod nams ma yin pa dang po bzlog pa'i thabs la las yod red/ rgyu 'bras yod red/ skye ba snga phyi yod red/ khyod rang sdig pa spong dgos kyi red/ dge ba bsgrub dgos kyi red/ sa lam bgrod dgos kyi red/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya sogs la nyams len byed dgos kyi red zer nas mang po gsungs bsdad yag 'di bsod nams ma yin pa bzlog pa'i thabs la dang po bcom ldan 'das kyis lus yod par gsungs pa red/ gang zag yod par gsungs yod red/ phung po yod par gsungs yod red/ las bsags pa kun la yod/ 'bras bu myong ba kun la yang yod zer nas cha tshang gsungs 'dug /'di tsho tshang ma bsod nams ma yin pa dang po bzlog pa'i thabs la gsungs kyi yod red/ 'di nas rim pa gnyis pa'i skabs la slebs yong ba'i skabs la dbang po dang shes rab tog tsam mchog red yong dus bar du bdag bzlog pa'i skabs su chos thams cad bdag med pa yin/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa med/ gang zag gi bdag gis kyang stong*/ chos kyi bdag gis kyang stong nas bdag yod bsam pa 'di yod ma red/

chos thams cad bdag med pa yin zer nas bdag bkag nas bdag med pa'i steng du slebs song*/ stong nyid bcu drug gi rigs pa 'di tshos bdag med pa sgrub song*/ 'di skabs la dbang po dang shes rab tog tsam mchog tu gyur pa'i skabs su slebs pa red pa/ shin tu mthar thug pa'i skabs su sgom pa'i don dam rnam par nges pa kho na red/ shin tu mthar thug pa 'di blo gros mi zad par bstan pa'i mdo sde dgongs pa ltar du byed na/ gzungs dbang gi zhus pa'i mdo'i lugs la nor bu dri ma rim sbyong gi thog nas dpe 'di tsho bshad yong dus shin tu mthar thug pa la ga re bzhag pa red zer na/ sgom pa'i don dam rnam nges red/ sgom pa'i don dam rnam par nges pa'i skabs su/ tha mar lta zhi kun bzlog pa// zer yag gi lta ba kun las bral ba 'di red/ lta ba kun bral gyi nyams len 'di red/ lta ba thams cad las 'das pa/ lta ba thams cad las bzlog zer ba'i skabs su yod pa med pa gnyis ka gnyis min la sogs pa mtha' thams cad las 'das pa la go dgos kyi 'dug /'di'i skabs su mgon po klu sgrub kyi rtsa ba shes rab mchod brjod nang bzhin red/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// gsungs 'dug /spros pa nyer zhi/ zer ba'i skabs su spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba 'di ga re red/ yod pa med pa'i spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba red/ spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// smra ba rnams kyi dam pa zer ba'i skabs su smra ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa 'di stong nyid kyi chos 'di gtso bo yin gsungs kyi yod red pa/

bcom ldan 'das kyis chos mang po gsungs yod red zer gyi yod red/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ dam pa 'di yin zer ba red/ dam pa ga re red/ mtha' bzhi dang spros pa thams cad las 'das pa 'di yin gsungs pa red 'dug /'di'i skabs la'ang*/ yul dang ngo bo tha snyad ma grub pa yin pa song tsang snying po med gsungs pa red// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag yod red de/ yin na yang spros pa'i mtha' zer ba 'di ga 'dra zhig la go dgos kyi yod red/ yod pa med pa gnyis ka gnyis min gyi spros pa'i mtha' zer nas go dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs yod pa gcig pu spros pa la bzhag /med pa 'di spros med la bsam blo btang na yang mi 'grig pa red/ spros pa zer mkhan 'di kho bcings bsdad pa 'di red/ spros pa la phra rags mang po yong gi red/ spros pa phra rags mang po ga re yod na'ang khos bcings bsdad pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i don dag la sgrog na gser gyi thag pas sgrog pa dang lcags kyi thag pas sgrog pa gnyis la khyad med ces mi la ras pas gsungs yod/ gser gyi thag pas sgrog pa dang lcags kyi thag pas sgrog pa la khyad med gsungs pa'i skabs su gser gyi thag pas sgrog pa 'di ga re red/ stong nyid la zhen pa skye ba 'di la gsungs pa red 'dug /stong nyid dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul thams cad bsam mi khyab pa'i spyod yul red bsam nas bsdad pa yin na/ 'di gser gyi thag pas sgrog pa red/ bsdam bzhag gi yod red/ skyid po yod ma red pa/ lcags kyi thag pas sgrog na'ang skyid po yod ma red/ nga la gser gyi thag pas sgrog song skyid pa la bsam pa 'dra po yod ma red/ sgrog na gser gyi thag pas sgrog pa dang lcags kyi thag pas sgrog pa gnyis la khyad med pa nang bzhin gyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par byed pa la sgrib pa'i rtsa ba 'di spros pa la zhen pa dang spros med la zhen pa gnyis ka gcig pa yin gsungs pa red 'dug

/spros bral las lhag lta yod na// lta de spros pa can du 'gyur// zer nas sa paṇa gyis gsungs 'dug /spros bral las lhag pa'i lta ba med/ spros bral las lhag pa'i lta ba zer ba'i skabs su spros med red pa/ spros bral la zhen song na gsungs pa red/ spros bral la zhen song na 'di yang spros pa chags 'gro yi red gsungs pa red/ sman dug tu 'gyur ba nang bzhin red 'dug /sman dug tu gyur pa 'dra po chags 'gro ba red/

/'di min zhes bya gang gis bkag pa med// ga re byed nas yin zer nas lab ma thub pa red/ ga re byed nas yin pa la mtshon ma thub pa red/ ga re byed nas min pa la sgrub mi thub pa red zer na/ blo las 'das pa red gsungs pa red/ blo 'das gdod ma'i chos nyid yin/ zhes rdza dpal sprul rin po che'i tshig gsum gnad rdeg nang la yod red// blo las 'das pa gdod ma'i chos nyid/ gzhi'i yod tshul/ lam gyi bzhugs tshul/ 'bras bu'i bzhugs tshul ma nor ba 'di yin pa red/ 'di 'dra'i ma nor ba 'di yin pa yin dus gtad so med gsungs pa red/ blo las 'das pa yin dus gtad so med pa red/ blo las ma 'das na gtad so yod red pa/ blo'i nang du yod/ rnam rtog gi drwa ba'i nang la btum/ kun rtog gi drwa bas bcings bsdad pa'i nang la gtad so yod red/ 'di bzang po 'di ngan pa/ 'di yul 'di yul can/ 'di spang bya 'di blang bya zer yag 'di 'dzin pa 'di'i mtshan ma'i byed las cha tshang yong thub kyi yod red/ yin na yang 'di mthar thug pa ma red/ so so'i skye bo rnams ni rtog pas bcings// mi rtog rnal 'byor pa ni grol 'gyur bas// zhes dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin/ so so'i skye bo rnams ni rtog pas bcings// zer dus so so skye bo zer ba'i tha snyad 'di gang gi steng la yong gi yod red zer na/ rnam rtog gi drwa bas bcings bsdad pa yin dus so so skye bo lab pa red/ tha mal pa zer nas lab pa red/ 'khrul ba'i gnas skabs zer nas lab pa red 'dug /mi rtog rnal 'byor pa ni grol 'gyur bas// rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas bsdad mkhan 'di su red/ yul dang yul can gyi spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi yi dbyings la ma bcos pa'am tshul bzhin du gnas bsdad mkhan 'di la rnal 'byor pa zer nas lab pa red/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyis sems kyi gnas lugs mthong yong dus grol 'gro yi red gsungs 'dug

/'di yin dus dngos po'i gnas lugs dbang btsan po byed nas bshad yong dus chos thams cad kyi yin lugs phyin ci ma log pa/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang 'brel nas rang gi mos gus phur tshugs su byed nas glo snying brang gsum 'di bla ma dkon mchog la gtad nas yang dag pa'i don la dad pa dang mos gus nges shes yag po zhig yod nas de'i steng nas sgom bsdad pa yin na/ rtog rnams log par gyur pa gang yin pa// zer 'dug /rtog rnams log par gyur pa zhes rnam rtog rnams log par gyur pa red/ rnam rtog log yong ba red/ rnam rtog zad 'gro ba red/ rnam rtog zad sar 'khyol ba red/ chod nyid kyi gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus/ 'di 'dra'i rnam rtog zad sar 'khyol ba dang*/ rnam rtog mtha' la thug pa dang*/ rnam rtog zad 'gro yag dang*/ rnam rtog chos nyid kyi steng du grol thub yag gi rgyu mtshan 'di ga re red zer na/ rnam par dpyad pa'i 'bras bur mkhas rnams gsungs// zhes gsungs 'dug /tshul bzhin du yang dag par legs par dpyad pa dang*/ tshul bzhin du yang dag par dpyad pa dang*/ tshul bzhin du legs par rnam par dag pa dpyad pa'i 'bras bu la rnam rtog las 'das pa'i chos nyid kyi dbyings la slebs thub yag 'di yong gi yod red zer nas/ mkhas rnams gsungs/ zhes mkhas pa thams cad kyi gsungs red gsungs 'dug /dbu ma la 'jug pa 'di spyir btang tshig gi steng nas lta ba rten 'byung kho na 'grel bsdad kyi yod red de/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag dang rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag la sbyar yong dus kyang dbu ma 'di zab po red 'dug /don gyi steng nas sbyar yong dus spyir btang dbu ma la 'jug pa zer yong dus don gyi steng la sbyar yag zhig red pa/ ma gtogs tshig khag khag 'khyer yag 'di ma red/ yin na yang deng sang rtsod pa'i chos 'dra po chags 'dug /dbu ma la 'jug pa zer yong dus lam sang gcig dam bca' bsdad/

gcig yar lang nas rtsod bsdad yag 'dra po byed nas bsam blo btang nas 'gro sdod kyi yod red pa/ dngos gnas bsam blo btang ba yin na/ don dam zhig chags bsdad kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus sems la gtad so med zer yag 'di 'dra zhig la brten nas slebs yong ba red ma gtogs de ga kha nas sems la gtad so yod ma red zer na 'grig gi yod ma red/ sems la gtad so med pa la dang po thos pa'i shes rab/ sems la gtad so med pa'i rgyu mtshan la bar du bsam pa'i shes rab/ 'di gnyis la brten nas nges shes yag po zhig rnyed tshar dus de'i steng nas tha mar sgom pas rnam par grol dgos kyi yod red/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang 'brel/ de nas gnas dben pa'i ri khrod la bsdad/ 'gro 'dug gi spyod lam thams cad 'di gar thod thod du btang*/ de nas yul gang la'ang ma chags/ de nas gnyen dang grogs ri dwags de tsho dang 'grogs/ de nas mi med lung stong brag phug la bsgom yong dus nyams gong 'phel du song*/ de nas rtogs pa la dbang btsan po chags/ 'di 'dra chags yong dus/ sgom pa'i don du rnam par nges zhes sgom pas grol thub pa chags pa red/ 'di 'dra la brten nas sems la gtad so med yong dus grub thob thams cad kyis phyag zhabs kyi rjes bzhag yag 'dra po dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba la sogs pa dang*/ chu la nya nang bzhin 'dzul 'gro yag 'dra po dang*/ brag skam po la zang thal du phebs bsdad yag 'dra po 'di tsho thams cad kyang 'di 'dra'i sems la gtad so med pa'i gnas lugs 'di rtogs yong dus rdzu 'phrul bstan thub pa red 'dug /rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung bstan thub kyi yod pa red/ rje btsun chung du ma song g.yag rwa che ru ma song ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di tsho yang sems la gtad so med pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas byung ba red ma gtogs de ga nga rang tshos rje btsun chung du ma song g.yag rwa che ru ma song zer nas skad cha bshad na'ang rna bar 'gro yi ma red pa/

yin na yang gnas lugs zhig gi steng la slebs yong dus rna bar ma 'gro na'ang rgyu mtshan yang dag mngon sum zhig chags bsdad kyi yod red/ rang bzhin zhig red bsdad kyi yod red/ rje btsun mi las/ rdzu 'phrul ngas bstan rgyu ma byung sems can thams cad kyis bstan gyi 'dug gsungs pa red/ ngas dngos po'i gnas tshul gang yin pa de yin pa la ngo sprod pa yin/ rdzu 'phrul sems can thams cad kyis bstan gyi 'dug /min pa zhig la yin pa bzo/ yin pa zhig la min pa bzo yong dus sems can thams cad kyis red ma gtogs nga ma red gsungs 'dug /'di dngos gnas drang gnas rang gi rang ngo la 'di dag pa red/ 'di 'dra yin pa red/ sems la gtad so med zer yag 'di/ mdor na 'dus byas kyi chos la zhen pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas nga rang tshos sgom brgyab yag dang*/ 'dus byas kyi chos la zhen pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas dge ba bsgrub rgyu// 'dus byas kyi chos la zhen pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag yag la sogs pas phan gyi yod ma red/ 'di la brten nas phyag rgya chen po rtogs thub kyi med pa red/ 'di 'dra spangs dgos kyi yod pa red/ 'dus byas kyi chos la chags song na phan gyi yod ma red/ phyag rgya chen po rtogs yag la ga re dgos kyi yod red zer na/ sngon ma'i las 'phro sad pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ de yi steng nas dngos gnas drang gnas kyi snying khungs rus pa'i steng nas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus zhig dang*/ de'i steng la rang gi mos gus de dang 'brel ba'i steng nas nam nyin mtshan zung 'brel gyi steng nas brtson pa chen po'i rgyun bsten nas sems kyi gnas lugs kho rang steng la nges shes yag po 'drong nas ma bcos pa'i sgom gyi steng la slebs thub na/ de nas phyag rgya chen po rtogs thub pa red 'dug /ma gtogs zag bcas kyi dge ba bsgrub pas phan gyi yod ma red/

nga rang tshos phyag rgya chen po rtogs yag don dag yin zer nas phyag 'tshal ba la ched du gnyer ba dang / dka' thub kyi nyams len byed yag la sogs pa dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyis zag bcas kyi dge sbyor ga tshod bsgrub pa yin na'ang 'dis brgyud rgyu byed kyi red/ brgyud nas rgyu byed kyi red ma gtogs dngos rgyu byed thub kyi yod ma red/ dngos rgyu 'di ga re red zer na/ bla ma'i man ngag 'di blo la shar yag dang*/ de nas sgom phur tshugs su brgyab nas snying khung rus pa'i steng nas brtson pa drag po bsten dgos yag 'di red 'dug /'di la brten nas/ sems la gtad so med na phyag rgya chen po yin/ yid byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che// mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma chen po yin// 'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya// gcig shes kun don rtogs pa'i gdengs thob shog /gsungs 'dug /yid byed bral ba zer ba'i skabs su yid la byed pa dang bral ba/ yid la byed pa dang bral zer ba'i skabs su 'di phyag rgya chen po yin nam min nam/ 'di rdzogs pa chen po yin nam min nam/ 'di rtogs pa yin nam min nam/ 'di gnas lugs yin nam min nam bsam pa'i sems la yid la byed pa yod na phan gyi yod ma red/ yid la byed tshar na sems la gtad so yod tshar ba red/ yid la byed pa dang bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya chen po yin gsungs song*/ de yin dus/ sems la gtad so med na phyag rgya chen po yin// gsungs yag 'di red/ 'di 'dra'i sems la gtad so med pa'i phyag rgya chen po 'di ngo shes tshar na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/
