de la goms shing 'dris na bla med byang chub 'thob// goms zhing 'dris zer nas lab pa red/ goms zer ba'i skabs su la sgom pa red pa/ sgom pa ma yin goms pa yin// goms pa klong du gyur ba yin// gsungs pa red/ gnas lugs la btsan sa bzung na sgom zer nas lab kyi yod red de/ spyir btang nga tsho'i 'jig rten pa'i bya ba zhig yin na'ang goms tshar na dka' las zhe drag brgyab ma dgos par kho rang bzhin gyis las ka 'di las sla po byed nas sgrub thub kyi 'dug /las ka gang yin na'ang red/ ri mo bris pa la goms tshar dus khong ri mo la mkhas pa chags 'gro yi red pa/ de ga nang bzhin gyi khang pa bzo ba'i las ka byed yag 'dra po dang*/ me tog gi ldum rwa la las ka byed yag la goms pa yin na kho 'di la rang bzhin gyis dka' las med par bzo thub kyi 'dug /'di 'dra po gnas lugs kyi thog la btsan sa zin yong dus de yi steng nas nyams len ga re yod na'ang 'di la goms 'gro yi yod pa red/ de la sgom zer nas lab pa red pa/ yin na yang 'di 'dra'i rtogs pa mchog thob tshar na'ang rtogs pa btsan sa zin tshar na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/ bla na med pa'i yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang rin po che mthar thug pa 'di ma 'thob kyi bar du 'dris dgos red gsungs pa red/ ga 'dra 'dris dgos pa red/ yang nas yang du don yid la byed pa'am/ yang nas yang du don 'di'i steng du ma bral ba/ mnyam bzhag gis chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs kyi steng la btsan sa zin thub na yang mtshams mtshams la rjes thob kyi skabs la spyod lam lod du red 'gro yag gi nyen kha yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus rjes thob kyi skabs su 'gro 'dug gi spyod pa mi la skad cha bshad yag dang*/ kha lag za yag 'dra po dang*/ de min pa'i bya spyod gang dang gang yin na yang mnyam bzhag gi tshul dang ma bral ba go yag 'di gal chen po red 'dug

/yid la byed pa'i skabs su spyir btang mnyam rje gnyis 'dres tshar na skad cha khag khag red ma gtogs mnyam rje gnyis 'dres yag 'di sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs la ma gtogs yong gi yod ma red/ mnyam rjes so sor yod pa'i skabs su yang mnyam bzhag gi rtsis 'di rjes thob dang ma bral ba zhig dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug /mnyam bzhag gi rtsis dang ma bral ba'i steng nas rjes thob kyis 'jig rten gyi spyod lam thams cad byed thub pa yin na/ gang mtshams shig la de bsgom yong dus mnyam rjes gnyis gnyis med la 'dres thub kyi yod pa red/ de yin dus mnyam rjes gnyis ma 'dres kyi bar du 'dris dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'dres zer ba 'di yang nas yang du de la nan tan byed dgos pa 'di la 'dres gsungs pa red 'dug /ma gtogs rtogs pa mchog zhig thob tshar ba dang da 'dis blo bde po byung da 'grig song bsam na 'di phan gyi ma red/ de la goms shing 'dris na bla med byang chub 'thob/ ༈ /bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob kyi red gsungs pa red/00000000 16711680 da ni snying po'i don de zhe 'dod dang bcas pa'i lta sgom spyod pas mthong mi nus par bstan pa ni/ 0000000000000255 sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang*// 'dul ba mdo sde sde snod la sogs pa// rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis ni// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur// zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong bsgribs/ ༈ /10/ 00000000zhes tshig rkang lnga yod red/ spyir btang bcom ldan 'das kyis mthun mong dang mthun mong ma yin pa'i bka'/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang bod gangs can ljongs la phebs bsdad pa'i mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po yod red/ la la ni dbang po rab yod red/ la la ni dngos gnas mthun mong gi rtags sprul pa'i yon tan la sogs pa yod bsdad mkhan/ 'ga' shas yi dam gyi lhas rjes su 'dzin bsdad mkhan/

la la ni rigs pa'i gnas lnga la sogs pa thogs pa med par mkhyen bsdad mkhan/ spyir btang gi rang rang so so'i rnam dpyod dang nyams len gyi btsan sa 'dra po 'di zin stangs la khyad par 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod red/ yin na yang de dag gi dgongs pa ji ltar longs pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i bstan bcos 'di bsam gyi mi khyab pa mang po yod red pa/ de 'dra yin dus bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs bzhag pa'i bka' dang rjes 'jug mkhas pas brtsams bzhag pa'i bstan bcos/ de ga nang bzhin spyir bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la mdo dang sngags zer nas gnyis yong gi yod red pa/ sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang*/ sngags su smra dang 'bras bu'i theg pa la gsang sngags zer nas lab pa red/ rgyu'i theg pa la phar phyin zer nas lab kyi yod red/ 'dis theg pa dang 'dir theg pa zer nas gnyis yod red/ 'dis theg pa zer na rgyu'i phar phyin red/ de la brten nas phar phyin zer nas ming btags/ 'dir theg pa zer na 'bras bu la bshad pa yin pa/ sngags kyi theg pa la gsungs kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' thams cad tshur bsdus na mdo sngags gnyis la ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med pa red pa/ de yin dus bka' bstan bcos zer nas bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis yod red/ de ni sngags zer ba'i skabs su la gsang sngags la go yi yod red/ gsang sngags la gsar rnying lugs gnyis yod red pa/ sngags gsar ma'i lugs zer mkhan gcig yod red/ sngags rnying ma'i lugs zer nas mang po yong gi yod red/ 'di tsho gras la skad cha mang po yod red/ spyir btang lo rgyus kyi nang la mang che ba bshad kyi yod red pa/ de 'dra yin dus sngags su gsar rnying gnyis dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyi theg pa che chung gi rnam gzhag mang po yod red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa che chung gi rnam gzhag mang po yod red/ de nas phyis su rjes 'jug mkhas pa thams cad kyis bstan bcos brtsams dus grub mtha' bzhi'i nang du bsdus nas gsungs pa red pa/

sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis la spyir btang khyad par yod ma red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gang dang gang yin na'ang dngos dang shugs nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam las grol yag zhig red ma gtogs 'di ma yin pa'i chos gcig kyang yod ma red/ yin na yang spyir btang gi dbang po yang rab dbang po mchog dman gyi dbye ba la brten nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su gsungs pa yin pa red/ dbang po tog tsam dman pa yin pa thams cad la rgyu yi phar phyin theg pa gsungs/ de nas dbang po shin tu rnon po thams cad la sngags kyi theg pa gsungs pa red pa/ de 'dra yin dus de gnyis kyi bar la/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zer ba'i skabs su don gcig na yang zer dus sngags dang phar phyin gnyis don gcig pa red gsungs pa red/ dper na mtshan gzhi zhig bzhag pa yin na/ byang chub kyi sems la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang don dam byang chub kyi sems gnyis bshad kyi yod pa red/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang don dam byang chub kyi sems gnyis ka mdo'i skabs su la'ang bshad kyi yod red/ sngags kyi skabs su la'ang bshad kyi yod red/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la ma brten par gsang sngags nyams len byed yag yod ma red/ don dam byang chub sems la ma brten pas gsang sngags bla med kyi nyams len byed yag yod ma red/ sngags kho rang nang la yang rgyud sde gong 'og gi thog nas bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la sogs pa dbye grangs mang po yong gi yod red de/ de thams cad la yang lha bsten pa'i skabs su lha grogs po'i tshul du bsten pa dang*/ lha rgyal po'i tshul du bsten pa/ lha 'bangs kyi tshul du bsten pa sogs spyir btang lha sgrub stangs kyi khyad par la'ang mang po 'gro yi yod red/

'di 'dra la brten nas rgyud sde gong 'og sngags kho rang nang la yang dbang po mchog dman la brten nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud sde gong 'og la khyad par mang po gsungs yod red/ spyir mthun mong sngags kyi theg pa'i thog nas bshad yong dus sngags kyi nang la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi nyams len dang*/ don dam pa la lta ba thams cad las 'das pa'i gnas lugs kyi spros bral gyi lta ba gnyis po 'di zung 'jug gi thog nas nyams len byed yag 'di sngags mthun mong gi bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ theg pa chen po zhig yin nas bzung ste 'di 'dra'i nyams len 'di lta ba rnam dag zhig dang ma 'brel bar theg pa chen po'i chos bshad yag med pa red/ theg pa chen po zer nas bshad dus/ theg pa chen po nang la rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis bshad yong dus gsang sngags dang mdo zer nas gnyis bshad kyi yod red pa/ de 'dra yin dus gsang sngags kyi nang la byang chub kyi sems la kun rdzob la brten pa'i byang chub sems dang*/ don dam la brten pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis po 'di nges par du dgos kyi yod red/ 'di med pa la yong gi yod ma red/ khyad par du gsang sngags bla med kyi nyams len gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa ltar du byed pa yin na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes de kho na nyid kyi gnas tshul 'di gtso bor bstan pa pha ma gnyis med dus 'khor nang la gsungs kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus mdo'i skabs su spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang po mchog dman thams cad la stabs gcig tu go bde po byed nas bdag med pa gcig gsungs kyi yod red pa/ tshig 'di yag tu btang na khrid yig 'di tsho dang sbrags yong dus sems ngo zer nas 'chad bsdad kyi 'dug /'di yang gtso bo theg pa 'og ma ltar du byed pa yin na bdag med pa zer yag gi don dag 'di thabs khyad par tog tsam zhig yag tu btang*/

lam gyi nyams len tog tsam zab tu btang yong dus de la sems kyi ngo bo bshad kyi 'dug /stong nyid zer nas bshad kyi yod red/ stong nyid de la yang zab tu btang yong dus sems kyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid/ sngags su bde ba chen po zer yag 'dra po mang du btang gi 'dug /de tsho yang gnas lugs kho rang la spyir btang gi shes rab mchog dman dang sbyar yong dus zab tu zab tu btang ba red 'on kyang tshig gi khyad par mang po 'gro yi yod pa red ma gtogs don gyi mtshon bya don gcig ma gtogs khag khag yod ma red/ sngags su ngo shes dgos pa'i gnas lugs 'di red/ mdo'i skabs su ngo shes dgos yag gi sems kyi gnas lugs 'di red/ mthun mong theg pa la shes yag gi gnas lugs 'di tsho la khag khag yod ma red gnas lugs gcig red/ yin na yang gnas lugs 'di mtshon byed kyi thabs la dbang po mchog dman dang 'khri yong dus thabs kyi rim pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs kyi rim pa mang po gsungs pa red pa/ rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i nang la/ dang po bye brag smra ba dang*/ de'i rjes su mdo sde pa/ de rjes rnal 'byor spyod pa dang*/ de'i rjes su dbu ma bstan/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ de rjes kyai yi rdo rje bstan/ 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// gsungs 'dug /des na bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gi bye brag smra ba nas bzung ste ya gi kyai yi rdo rje'i bar du cha tshang ga re byed nas bstan pa red zer na/ de kho na nyid kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ched du skas kyi rim pa lta bu bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs yod pa red/ 'di skabs su/ sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang*// gsungs pa 'di'i skabs la sngags gsar rnying gi rnam gzhag dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyi mdo'i skabs su pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ de la yang 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa ste sde snod gsum gsungs kyi yod red pa/

chos 'dul ba/ chos mdo sde/ chos mngon pa zer nas sde snod gsum gsungs kyi yod red/ 'di tsho'i nang nas/ rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis ni// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur// de yin dus phyag rgya chen po rtogs yag la/ sngags la slob sbyong byed pa tsam dang*/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i thog nas sngags la slob sbyong byed pa tsam dang*/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i thog nas mdo yi nyams len byed pa dang*/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i thog nas 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa la sogs pa'i rang rang so so'i gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' la slob sbyong byed pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i blos rang rang gi gzhung gi grub pa'i mtha' yis ji tsam ji tsam slob sbyong byed/ ji tsam ji tsam nyams len byed na'ang 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ gang red zer na/ grub pa'i mtha' zer yag 'di rang rang so so'i bsam blo zhig btang*/ rnam rtog gis bcos nas tshad bzo bzhag pa 'di la grub mtha' zer gyi yod red pa/ de 'dra yin dus 'di tsho'i gras de spyir btang gi 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong yag la phan gyi red pas zer na phan gyi red gsungs pa red/ yin na'ang mthong mi 'gyur zer bas dngos su mthong bar byed pa'i rgyu byed kyi ma red gsungs kyi yod red/ tshig 'di tog tsam dbye ba phye dgos kyi 'dug /'di 'dra ma byas na/ 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa dang sngags kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i rgyu'i theg pa dang 'bras bu'i theg pa 'di tsho'i gras phyag rgya chen po mthong thub kyi ma red zer na ha cang thal drag pa red pa/ yin na yang 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur// gsungs pa 'di ga 'dra byed nas mthong thub kyi ma red zer na/ dngos rgyu byed kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ dngos su mthong bar byed thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ 'di yong dgos kyi yod red/

mdor na bka' bstan bcos de bzhin gsang sngags la gsar rnying la sogs pa thams cad kyis don dam pa'i de nyid du khong du chub thub kyi ma red/ ga re red zer na/ grub mtha' zer yag 'di tsho blo'i zhen pa yod red/ grub mtha' yin na blo yi zhen pa yod red pa/ dper na bye brag smra bas ga tshod rtsod kyi yod red/ mdo sde pas ga tshod rtsod kyi yod red/ sems tsam pas ga tshod rtsod kyi yod red/ sems tsam pa'i nang la yang rnam rdzun pa dang rnam bden pa gnyis yong gi yod red/ rnam bden pa la yin na'ang sgo nga phyed tshal ba/ rnam shes grangs mnyam pa/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa gsum yong gi yod/ rnam rdzun pa la dri bcas rnam rdzun pa dang dri med rnam rdzun pa gnyis yong gi yod/ de nas dbu ma pa nang la'ang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa dang*/ 'jig rten grags bde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa/ de'i rtsa ba la rang rgyud pa dang thal 'gyur ba gnyis yong gi yod red/ de nas yar 'gro na rang stong dang gzhan stong gnyis yong gi yod red/ tshang ma rang rang so so'i grub mtha' zer yag 'di rigs pas brtags dpyad btang*/ de nas rnam rtog gis bcos/ gcig la skyon yod pa 'di phar bkag /gcig la yon tan yod pa 'di tshur bsgrub/ 'di 'dra byed nas dgag sgrub rkyang rkyang gcig gi nang la lta grub zer nas 'gro bsdad kyi yod red/ lta ba dang grub mtha' zer yag 'di yi steng nas 'gro gi yod pa red/ 'di 'dra'i sems kyi rnam par rtog pa bcos ma dang bcas pa'i rang rang so so'i grub mtha'i blos bcos pa'i 'dul ba mdo sde dang sngags pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshos 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong ba'i grogs byed kyi yod red de dngos su phyag rgya chen po mthong yag la grogs byed thub kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /dngos su 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs yag la khong tshos dngos rgyu byed thub kyi ma red/

ga re byed nas yul dngos su byed mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di/ grub mtha' la chags bsdad kyi yod red/ nga bye brag smra ba yin/ nga mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' bshad mkhan yin/ nga sems tsam pa bshad mkhan yin/ nga dbu ma bshad mkhan yin zer yong dus rang rang so so'i lta grub de tshor chags pa yod red/ gang chags pa dang bcas pa yin na 'khor ba'i rgyu red/ gnas lugs kyi steng nas bshad yong dus gang chags pa dang bcas pa de 'khor ba'i rgyu red ma gtogs 'khor ba las grol ba'i lam yong gi yod ma red/ khyad par du phyag rgya chen po zer yag 'di thabs dang man ngag la brten nas rtogs dgos kyi yod pa yin dus rnam rtog gi bcas bcos mang po byed pa yin na nga tshos phyag rgya chen po rtogs thub kyi ma red/ rje btsun mi las/ phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su// lus ngag gi rtsol ba ma byed cig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes de yal yag nyen kha yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus 'khor ba la yang nas yang du 'khor bar byed pa'i rgyu byed pa ma gtogs 'khor ba la grol ba'i rgyu byed kyi med pa yin dus phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i grogs su yang 'gyur thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /da dung yang 'di la go ba gcig yod red/ ga re yod red zer na/ 'dul ba dang mdo sde la sogs pa dang sngags su smra ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tsho la rang rang so so'i gzhung gi lta grub thams cad la sems nang zhen pa med pa dang sems la chags pa med pa byed nas nyams su len thub na/ phyag rgya chen po mthong nas grol thub kyi red gsungs kyi yod red/ 'di skabs su bkag yag ga re bkag gi 'dug zer na/ rang rang so so'i lta ba bshad pa'i skabs la gzhung zer nas bshad/ grub pa'i mtha' zer yag 'di lta ba 'di la brten nas grub mtha' re re bzo yi yod red pa/

de yin dus rang rang gzhung zer ba'i gzhung 'di lta ba la bshad/ rnam rtog gi bcos pa'i lta ba/ 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i lta ba 'di'i steng nas mtha' bcad bzhag pa'i tshad gcig yod red/ khas len gyi 'dzin mtshams gcig yod red/ de la grub mtha' zer nas lab pa red/ khas len gyi 'dzin mtshams 'di grub mtha' red/ 'di 'dra'i grub pa'i mtha' 'dul ba la zhen/ bye brag smra ba la zhen/ mdo sde pa la zhen/ theg pa chen po la zhen/ mdo la zhen/ sngags la zhen pa'i rang rang so so'i grub mtha' dang rang rang so so'i lta grub la zhen cing de la 'dzin pa dang bcas pa yin na de yis phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i grogs su 'gyur thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /rgyud gsang ba snying po las/ ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog /zhes gsungs yong dus ma rtogs pa'i skyon yong gi yod red/ grub mtha' zer nas bshad tshar ba'i rjes la grub mtha' la ma rtogs pa'i skyon zhig slebs kyi red pa/ grub mtha' zer ba la gcig zhugs tshar song na gal srid tog tsam rtogs pa de yang log par rtog pa yong gi yod red/ ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang cung zad rtogs pa la sogs pa mang po 'dug /the tshom za ba yang yong gi yod red/ phyogs rtogs yang dag nyid ma rtogs// don dam de la the tshom za// zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi don dam pa'i gnas tshul la the tshom za yag mang po zhig chags bsdad kyi yod red/ dper na/ dpe gcig bzhag pa yin na/ 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa gsum gcig po la slob sbyong byed pa yin na'ang sde snod gsum gyi steng nas thad kar sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs thub kyi yod ma red pa/ 'di la brten nas rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis/ mdo lam gcig pu la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi ma red/ sngags lam la yin cig min gnyis slob dgos gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di la brten nas yong gi yod red/ mdo lam gcig pur brten nas sangs mi rgya ba zhal gyis bzhes pa red/

sngags lam snon pa rgyag dgos kyi yod red/ sngags lam la ma brten par mdo lam gcig pur brten nas yong thub kyi yod ma red/ sdom gsum rnam nges nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi/ gsang chen smin grol lam mchog ma brten par// thob par min zhes rdzogs sangs rgyas des gsungs// zhes gsungs 'dug /gsang chen smin grol gyi lam la ma brten par zhes smin byed kyi dbang*/ grol byed kyi khrid/ rgyab rten lung dang bcas par ma brten par raṃ bla ma'i man ngag dang 'brel nas nyams su ma blangs na mdo gcig pu'i lta grub kyi steng nas sems kyi zhen pa dang bcas nas lta grub kyi 'dzin mtshams dang bcas pa'i steng nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob thub kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /de 'dra yin dus mdo lam gcig pu brten nas sangs rgyas kyi red ma red zer yag 'di la rtsod pa yod red/ yin na yang phal che ba zhig gis mdo lam gcig pu la brten nas sangs mi rgya ba zhal gyis bzhes pa red/ yun ring du 'gor ba red/ de yang sangs mi rgya zer yag 'di rtsa ba nyid nas sangs mi rgya zer gyi yod ma red/ yin na yang sngags lam la ltos na'am sngags lam nas ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul dang sngags lam nas ji ltar myur ba'i tshul dang bstun na mdo lam nas sangs rgyas kyi ma red zer nas lab na'ang 'grig gi red gsungs pa red/ da lta thar rgyan gyi nang la rigs chad pa zer yag 'di yang gtan nas sangs rgyas ma thob pa min/ yin na yang 'khor ba la yun ring du 'gor ba la brten nas rigs chad zer nas gsungs pa yin zer yag zhig 'dug pa de dang gcig pa yin pa red/ de yin dus phyogs su rtogs pa yang dag pa nyid ma rtogs pa/ ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang 'di 'dra la brten nas/ don dam de la the tshom za// zer nas rgyud gsang ba snying po'i nang la gsungs yod red/ de'i don ni grub mtha' dang lta grub kyi zhen pa dang khas len gyi grub mtha'i 'dzin mtshams dang bcas pa'i steng nas don dam de la the tshom za yi red ma gtogs sgro 'dogs chod thub kyi ma red gsungs 'dug

/'di lta bu'i dgongs pa la brten nas grub mtha' so so la zhen cing grub mtha' so so'i gnad don ngo ma 'di gang yin pa de ma rtogs par 'khrul nas phyag rgya chen po rtogs thub kyi yod ma red/ lta grub tsam po ba de tshos spyir btang 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal tog tsam mar nyung du 'gro yag dang*/ sdug bsngal mngon gyur ba de tsho chung du chung du 'gro yag la phan gyi yod srid pa red ma gtogs dngos su phyag rgya chen po rtogs yag la gang yang phan gyi yod ma red gsungs 'dug /de'i phyir na/ so so rang rang gi grub mtha' la chags rgyu yod ma red zhen rgyu yod ma red/ grub mtha' la zhen cing chags pa'i steng nas phyag rgya chen po rtogs thub kyi ma red/ phyag rgya chen po 'dir rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kho nas spyod dgos pa red ma gtogs rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pas spyod thub kyi med pa yin dus rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la brten nas phyag rgya chen po rtogs/ rnam rtog dang bcas pa'i steng nas phyag rgya chen po rnyed mi thub pa red/ de la brten nas grub mtha' la ma zhen gsungs 'dug /de la brten nas lta grub la ma zhen/ de la brten nas khas len gyi 'dzin mtshams ma byed gsungs pa red/ nga la khas len med pa na// nga ni skyon med kho na yin// gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di yang 'di yi steng nas yong gi 'dug ma gtogs khas len med zer yag 'di khas len rgyu zhig yod nas khas ma len pa yin na lkugs pa'i u tshugs red pa/ don la khas len rgyu dang khas len bya dang len byed med pa red/ khas len rgyu dang khas len bya dang len byed med pa yin dus/ nga la khas len med pa na// nga ni skyon med kho na yin// gsungs pa 'di de yi steng nas 'gro yi yod red/ ༈ rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis ni// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur// ga re red zer na/

zhe 'dod byung bas grub mtha' la zhe 'dod yod red/ grub mtha' la khas len gyi 'dzin mtshams yod red/ grub mtha' la nga 'am kho nga'i zer yag 'dir dmigs kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus grub mtha' la zhen cing chags pa 'am grub mtha'i lta ba'i khas len gyi 'dzin mtshams kyi zhe 'dod 'di byung yong dus de nas 'od gsal 'di bsgribs kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'od gsal mthong thub kyi yod ma red bsgribs pa red/ 'od gsal med pa ma red/ 'od gsal rang gi sems la yod red/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// zer mkhan gyi 'od gsal 'di ye gdod ma nas 'od gsal red de yin na yang mthong thub kyi yod ma red bsgribs bsdad kyi yod red/ rgyud bla mar/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la// sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser// sa la gter dang smyug sogs 'bras chung dang*// gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni// bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang*// sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar// glo bur nyon mongs dri mas bsgribs pa yi// sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di gnas// zhes gsungs yag 'di dri ma dgu dang dpe dgu dang don dgu'i thog nas gsungs pa red/ dpe dgu dang don dgu rkyang rkyang gsungs yong dus rgyud bla ma nang la sems can thams cad sangs rgyas yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad/ de la glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa'i tshul bshad/ de la gnyen po bsten nas spangs bya rtsad nas zad dgos stangs brten nas 'bras bu yang dag par thob pa'i tshul de tsho re re byed nas sbyar nas gsungs 'dug /dpe re re la don re re sbyar nas rgyas bshad yod red/ de 'dra yin dus grub mtha' so so la zhen cing chags na phyag rgya chen po rtogs kyi ma red/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid khong du chud thub kyi ma red/ de la brten nas zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong bsgribs gsungs pa red/

༈ /spyir btang 'dul ba mdo sde sde snod nang dang pha rol phyin pa tsam zhig ma yin par zhe 'dod ga re yin na yang bsgribs bsdad kyi yod red/ zhe 'dod zhig yod tshar na phyag rgya chen po la bsgribs bsdad kyi yod red/ phyag rgya chen po zer mkhan 'di zhe 'dod las 'das pa red/ zhe 'dod las 'das dgos kyi yod red pa/ zhen pa med pa'i bde chen rgyun chad med// mtshan 'dzin med pas 'od gsal sgrib g.yog bral// blo las 'das pas mi rtog lhun gyis grub// rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog /gsungs 'dug /nyams myong rgyun chad med pa 'ong pa la bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum de yin gcig min gnyis dgos kyi 'dug /bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum skye yag la zhen pa spong dgos pa dang gcig /mtshan 'dzin spong dgos pa dang gnyis/ blo las 'das dgos pa dang gsum de yin gcig min gnyis bzhag dgos kyi 'dug /zhen pa spong dgos pa zer yag 'di grub mtha'i zhen pa spong dgos pa la gsungs kyi yod red de'i skabs la/ zhen pa med pa'i bde chen rgyun chad med// grub mtha' dang lta grub la sogs pa'i zhen pa spong dgos pa/ mtshan 'dzin med pas 'od gsal sgrib g.yog bral// lhag par du ting nge 'dzin dang nang gi nyams len gyi steng la slebs yong dus nang gi bde gsal mi rtog pa bsam nas mtshan 'dzin byed rgyu yod ma red gsungs 'dug /blo las 'das pa'i mi rtog lhun gyis grub// blo las 'das tshar ba'i phyir na rnam par mi rtog pa/ blo las 'das pas mi rtog lhun gyis grub// zer yag 'di red/ rdzogs chen gyi skabs la chos nyid mngon sum/ nyams gong 'phel/ rig pa tshad phebs/ chos zad blo 'das zer nas bzhi bshad kyi yod red/ de yin dus chos nyid mngon sum gzigs pas lta ba mthon por gyur/ chos nyid mngon sum du gzigs yong dus chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa stong nyid yang dag pa gzigs yong dus/

chos nyid mngon sum gzigs pas lta ba mtho ba red 'dug /rig pa tshad phebs zer yag 'di rdzogs chen skabs su rig pa zer yag dang phyag rgya chen po'i skabs la sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos pa zer yag 'di gcig pa yin pa red/ rig pa 'di tshad la phebs yong dus sgom pa zab yong ba red/ lta ba bzang ba chos nyid mngon sum gzigs pa/ sgom pa bzang ba rig pa tshad la phebs pa/ nyams kyi snang ba thams cad gong du 'phel yong dus sgom pa bzang yong ba red/ lta ba bzang ba/ sgom pa bzang ba/ spyod pa bzang ba red 'dug /chos zad blo las 'das pa/ 'di gsum de yag po yong dus chos nyid mngon sum/ nyams gong 'phel/ rig pa tshad phebs gsum 'di mthar phyin yong dus chos zad blo las 'das pa yin gsungs pa red/ chos zad blo las 'das zer yag 'di dang*/ 'di yi skabs su phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs mthong zer yag 'di gcig pa red/ chos zad blo las 'das pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su sems kyi de nyid ma nor bar mthong ba de gnyis gcig pa red/ da ga res bsgribs kyi yod red zer na/ sgribs pa 'di zhen pas bsgribs kyi yod red/ mtshan ma med par ma rtogs par// khyod kyis mthar pa med par gsungs// de phyir khyod kyis theg chen du/ de ni tshang bar bstan pa lags// gsungs 'dug /mtshan ma med par ma rtogs pa la khyod kyi thar pa med par gsungs yod red/ 'di thar pa de thar pa mtshan nyid pa la gsungs pa red/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba nang la/ yul can stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'am gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par yang dag par rtogs pa'i shes rab de la brten nas gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pa gang yin pa 'di/ yul can stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba de thar pa mtshan nyid pa thob pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba yin gsungs 'dug /de tsho gcig pa red/ zhe 'dod thams cad ma bral na phan gyi ma red/

zhe 'dod thams cad dang bral dgos kyi yod red/ spyod 'jug shes rab le'u las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa// de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas// dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi// zhes gsungs 'dug /'di dang dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la/ shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa// bsregs pas zhi de rgyal rnams chos sku ste// de tshe skye ba med cing 'gag pa med// sems 'gag pa de sku yi mngon sum mdzad// gsungs pa 'di tsho gcig pa red/ gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus spros pa las 'das pa/ dmigs pa las 'das pa/ dmigs pa'i yid byed las 'das pa/ dmigs pa'i mtshan ma'i 'ching ba las 'das pa zhig dgos kyi 'dug /dmigs pa'i mtshan ma'i 'ching pa las ma 'das/ dmigs pa'i spros pa las ma 'das na gnas lugs mthong gi ma red gsungs/ phyag rgya chen po zer yag de dngos gnas drang gnas sngon yang bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po zhig bsags/ tshe 'di la yin na yang bla ma dam pa la mos gus phur tshugs su 'debs nas las 'phro sad pa gcig dang bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa gcig la brten nas skye dgos pa yin dus de la rnam rtog dang 'phro 'du la sogs pa tha na rnam rtog phra ba zhig skyes pa yin na'ang sgribs 'gro ba yin pa red/ des 'bras bu thob mi thub pa yin pa red/ phar phyin gyi lam shes skabs la/ rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra// gsungs 'dug /de yi don ni mthar thug gi 'bras bu la sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa red bsam pa'i zhen pa chung ngu zhig byung ba yin na yang de yang chags pa phra mo yin gsungs 'dug /lam gyi gegs yin pa red/ lam gyi skyon yin pa red/ de la brten nas zhe 'dod zer mkhan zhig slebs tshar na rang rang so so'i lta ba la zhen na'ang 'dra 'dug /grub mtha' la zhen na'ang 'dra 'dug

/lam la zhen na'ang 'dra 'dug /bla ma la zhen na'ang 'dra 'dug /man ngag la zhen na'ang 'dra 'dug /sgom gyi nyams la zhen na'ang 'dra 'dug /rtogs pa la zhen na'ang 'dra 'dug tshang ma zhe 'dod red gsungs pa red/ 'di bsgom na bsgribs kyi yod red/ 'di bsgom na phan gyi yod ma red/ 'od gsal snga ma tog tsam mthong ba de yang slar yang sgribs 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod red/ 'od gsal gsar du mthong ba'am 'od gsal slar yang mthong yag la sgribs kyi red/ 'od gsal sngar yod zin pa de yang phar sgribs 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus dus rtag tu ma bcos rang bab so ma zer ba'i phyag rgya chen po la tshig de tsho zab shos red pa/ ma bcos par zhog /rang bab tu zhog /so mar zhog /gnas lugs steng du zhog /de yang bag yangs su zhog /gu yangs su zhog /rig pa gnad la bkar nas zhog zer ba 'dra de tsho mang po 'dug /bzhag thabs de tsho rim pa mang po gsungs yod pa red/ 'o de 'dra'i thog la bzhag yong dus zhe 'dod de rang bzhin gyis yal 'gro ba red/ zhe 'dod de brlag song na 'od gsal de ma mthong ba'i thabs med pa red/ 'od gsal de sus bsgribs pa red zer na/ zhe 'dod kyis bsgribs pa yin dus 'od gsal de mthong dgos na zhe 'dod las grol dgos kyi yod pa red/ zhe 'dod las grol na phyag rgya chen po mthong thub kyi red gsungs pa red 'dug /mdor na tshig 'di yi don dag de rang rang so so'i grub mtha' dang lta grub la zhen cing chags par byed na phyag rgya chen po rtogs kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /phyag rgya chen po rtogs par byed pa la grub mtha' dang lta grub la zhen rgyu yod ma red/ ma zhen na phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i grogs chags thub kyi red/ zhen na phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i grogs chags thub kyi ma red/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid rtogs nas de khong du chud yag la grub mtha' la ma chags grub mtha' la ma zhen gsungs pa red/

00000000 00000255 rtog pa'i srung sdom dam tshig don las nyams// 00000000gsungs pa red/ 'di skabs su tshig ga 'dra shig yin na yang thams cad 'dzin pa dang zhen pa bkag gnang bsdad kyi 'dug /'dzin pa dang zhen pa bkag zer ba'i tshig 'dis 'dzin pa dang zhen pa 'di skyon yin pa la gsungs kyi 'dug /'dzin pa dang zhen pa zhig yod tshar na de la brten nas gnas lugs la rtsab nas thag nye ru 'gro thub kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /thag ring po chags 'gro yi yod pa red/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyis theg mchog mdzod kyi nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ deng sang a tir rloms pa'i skye 'gro dag /'gyu 'phro rtog tshogs byang chub sems yin lo// rmongs pa de kun mun pa'i klong nyid du// rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don las ring*// zhes gsungs 'dug /rnam rtog 'gyu ba/ rnam rtog 'phro ba/ rtog pa thams cad de byang chub kyi sems kyi grogs red zer nas bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra'i rdzogs chen a ti'i yo ga la rlom nas zhen bsdad mkhan thams cad kyis rnam rtog 'khrul rtog thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi grogs red zer bshad bsdad kyi 'dug /de tsho rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don las ring zer nas gsungs 'dug /rdzogs pa chen po'i don las thag ring po chags tshar ba red gsungs pa red/ 'di dang gcig pa red/ da lta 'di'i skabs su rtog pa zhig yod nas bzung ste phyag rgya chen po'i don las ring bar gsungs bsdad kyi 'dug /rtog pa'i srung sdom dam tshig don las nyams// mthun mong 'jig rten pa'i snang ngo la bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag dgos kyi red/ tshogs gsog gi rten la nga tshos phyag 'tshal dgos kyi red/ sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra bzhag dgos kyi red/ yi dam lha yi sku 'dra bzhag dgos kyi red/ de ga nang bzhin maṇ+ḍal phul dgos kyi red/ skor ba 'gro dgos kyi red/

sbyin pa gtang dgos kyi red zer nas mang po zhig yod pa rnams mthun mong theg pa ltar du bshad pa yin na/ 'di 'dra po'i nyams len de tsho'i gras spyir btang dgos kyi yod red/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog /zer nas mgon po klu grub kyis smon lam gnang yong dus mdor na dmigs bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs la brten nas gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis 'grub pa dang*/ dmigs med ye shes kyi tshogs la brten nas chos sku 'grub bsdad yag zhig gang ltar mthar thug gi sku gsum po thob pa la bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis sngon du nges par du 'gro dgos yag 'di mgon po klu grub kyis gsal po gsungs yod red/ de nges par du dgos kyi yod red/ mdo tsam du ma zad sngags la yang dgos kyi yod red/ yin na yang skyon gcig ga nas yong gi yod red zer na/ 'jig rten pa'i snang ngo la de 'dra'i bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag pa'i steng la de 'dra zhig bsgrub na nga tsho sangs rgyas kyi red zer/ de 'dra zhig byed na nga tshos sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob kyi red zer yag de 'dzin pa dang bcas pa zhig chags 'gro yi yod red/ re ba chen po yod pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la re ba yod red/ yag dag pa'i mtha' la re ba yod red/ yang dag pa'i 'bras bu la re ba yod red/ gang re ba dang bcas pa dang gang yid la byed pa dang bcas pa dang gang mos pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas nyams len byed yag 'di snying po'i don yid la mi byed pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i don zab po de lta bu zhig rtogs thub pa'i thabs byed thub kyi red pas zer na byed thub kyi ma red gsungs kyi yod pa red/ dper na sngags la cha bzhag pa yin na mdo'i skabs su sdom pa bsrung yag yod red/ chos 'dul ba'i nang la dge bsnyen dang dge tshul dge slong la sogs pa rang rang so so'i bslab pa dang mthun pa'i sdom pa srung stangs shig yod red/

byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod nang la yin na yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya tshad med pa dang mtha' yas pa/ mdor na mdo sde byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi le'u'i nang du rgyas pa gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dpa' la byang sdom bsrung yag dpe mang po yod red/ sngags kyi skabs su yin na rtsa ba sdom pa yang yod red la gtso bo de sngags kyi dam tshig shugs chen po bshad yod/ dam tshig de la yang rgyud sde gong 'og la brten nas dam tshig la yang zab zhan mang po yong gi yod la rgyud sde 'og ma 'og ma las rgyud sde gong ma gong ma la sogs pa bla med rgyud sde'i nang la dam tshig sa ya phrag la sogs pa mang po gsungs/ lhag par du dbang zhu yag la sogs pa dang sngags bzla ba/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor la sogs pa thams cad yid la byed nas bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim ste rim gnyis la brten nas nyams len byed yag la dam tshig zab po bsrung gi yod red/ mdor na rtog pa'i srung sdom mdo nas 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa'i skabs su sdom pa bsrung stangs dang*/ sngags kyi skabs su dam tshig bsrung yag de tsho'i gras de rtog pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas sdom pa bsrung ba dang rtog pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas dam tshig bsrung yag de phyag rgya chen po'i don las nyams pa yin gsungs 'dug /spyir gsang sngags nas dam tshig bsrung yag dang mdo'i skabs su sdom pa bsrung yag de tsho thar pa dang po'i mchog thob pa'i rgyu la 'gro gi red pas zer na 'gro gi red/00000000 16711680 da ni yid byed dang bral bas gnas lugs rtogs shing srid zhi las 'das nus par bstan pa ni/ 00000000 0000000000000255 yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral// 00000000yid la mi byed pa'i chos 'khor red/ do ha'i nang la yid la mi byed pa'i chos 'khor gsungs kyi yod red/ lhag par du rje btsun mar pa lho brag gis rgyal ba mai tri pa dang nā ro pa gnyis bsten nas yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor mang che ba de rgyal ba mai tri pa nas mar brgyud pa yin pa red/

rgyal ba mai tri pa nas mar rje btsun mar pa lho brag la brgyud pa red/ de lta bu'i yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de ga 'dra zhig la zer gyi yod red zer na/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len de ga rang red/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len de yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor yin pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas sngon yang snyan rgyud zer ba'i skabs su gang zag slob ma dbang po dang shes rab skal pa mchog dang ldan pa thams cad la dmigs bsal gyis snyan nas snyan du mar brgyud pa ma gtogs yi ge nang 'bri yi yod ma red/ yi ge la bzhag bzhag na snying po'i don brlag yag nyen kha yod red/ byin rlabs yal bar dwogs pa red/ snying po'i don de tsho gang zag dbang po yang rab thams cad la snyan nas snyan du mar brgyud nas rna bar brda thabs dang man ngag gi tshul du gsungs nas dpe gsang ba dam po gnang nas bsrung bsdad pa yin dus snying po'i don yid la mi byed pa zer 'dogs kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i snying po de yid la mi byed pa'i nyams len byed yag la rtog pa dang 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas zhen pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas sngags kyi dam tshig bsrung yag dang*/ de bzhin 'dul ba dang theg pa chen po'i mdo sde'i skabs su sdom pa bsrung yag de tsho'i gras 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas srung sdom byed yag dang 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas dam tshig bsrung ba de tsho snying po'i don las nyams pa yin gsungs pa red/ 'di'i don de phyag rgya chen po'i snying po'i don la gsungs kyi yod red/ snying po'i don zer mkhan de ga ba la gsungs kyi yod red zer na yid la mi byed pa'i don la gsungs kyi yod red/ yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de la snying po'i don gsungs kyi yod red/ yid la mi byed pa'am snying po zer na gcig pa red/ mdor na yid la mi byed zer yag de yid zer ba'i skabs su 'di skabs la yid de rnam rtog la go gi yod red/

rnam rtog gi yul du mi byed pa gsungs 'dug /go bde po byed nas bshad na rnam rtog gi yul du ma gyur pa'am rnam rtog gi dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i yul du ma gyur pa gsungs kyi yod red/ yid la mi byed pa zer yag de gang zhen pa dang bcas pa dang gang 'dzin pa dang bcas pa yod na de la yid la byed pa chags 'gro gi yod red/ gang 'dzin pa dang bral ba dang gang zhen pa dang bral ba yin na de la yid la mi byed pa gsungs kyi yod red/ yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral// gnas lugs ngo ma de ga 'dra zhig chags bsdad kyi yod red zer na spyir btang nga tshos dus rgyun du dge ba bsgrub sdig pa spangs zer yag de 'jig rten pa'i thog nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la sogs pa yong gi yod red de phyag rgya chen po'i skabs la de yang spang dgos pa red 'dug /phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i skabs la dge sgrub sdig spang zer yag de yang 'dzin pa dang bcas pa chags bsdad rgyu yod pa yin dus de mi dgos pa yin pa red/ 'o na ga re red/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs de ji tsam rtogs tshar na'ang kun rdzob kyi rgyu 'bras la de tsam gyis rtsis bkur che ru 'gro gi red zer gyi 'dug /de ga re red zer na 'di rten 'brel chos nyid kyi rol pa red/ ji tsam ji tsam phyag rgya chen po'i don la nges shes skye na kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor la de tsam de tsam rang bzhin gyis rtsa ba chen po brtsi nas 'gro gi yod red/ dmigs bsal yin gcig min gnyis da ngas brtsi dgos kyi yod da zer nas rnam rtog dang bcas pa yong dgos kyi mi 'dug /de yong dgos kyi yod ma red la nga rang tsho'i gnyen po de yid la byed yag gi ched du 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i sdom pa bsrung yag dang*/ 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas dge rtsa bsgrub yag dang*/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas dge rtsa bsgrub yag la sogs pa de tshos phan gyi ma red gsungs pa red 'dug

/des phan gyi ma red/ 'dzin pa dang bcas pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa yin na sangs rgyas kyi red zer gyi yod red de sangs rgyas kyi yod med gang shes te yin na yang phyag rgya chen po yid la mi byed pa'i don dag la des phan gyi ma red/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag yag la yang ye shes kyi tshogs dang sbrel nas 'gro dgos par gsungs pa red/ ye shes kyi tshogs dang sbrel nas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag dgos pa red ma gtogs 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas 'jig rten pa'i snang ngor grags pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag pa'i bya ba des gnyen po yid la mi byed pa de sgrub thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral// zhe 'dod kun dang bral zer ba'i skabs la zhen pa dang 'dod pa kun dang bral ba gsungs pa red/ 'di'i skabs la tshig gnyis 'dug /zhe 'dod zer ba'i skabs la spyir btang nga tshos phal skad nas bshad na zhe nas 'dod pa lab pa red pa/ yin na yang 'di skabs su 'dra yi yod ma red/ zhe zer ba'i skabs su 'dzin pa rags pa la bshad kyi yod red/ 'dod zer ba'i skabs su 'dzin pa phra ba la gsungs kyi yod red/ zhe zer ba'i skabs su shin tu nas kyang 'dzin pa rags pa la bshad kyi yod red/ shin tu nas kyang 'dzin pa rags pa de ga ba red/ mthun mong gi nga rang tsho 'jig rten pa'i dngos po la zhen pa de la zhe gsungs kyi yod red/ 'dod zer ba de thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu ru 'gro ba'i dge ba'i las la 'dzin pa yod na de la 'dod pa gsungs kyi yod red/ tog tsam phra ru 'gro ba red/ zhen pa rags pa de la zhe zer nas mthun mong 'jig rten pa'i chos la go 'dod zer ba'i skabs su thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu ru 'gro ba'i dge tshogs la 'dzin pa yod na 'dod pa zer nas gsungs kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus zhe nas 'dod pa kun dang bral ba/

zhe nas 'dod pa kun dang bral ba'i mtha' la mi gnas na zer ba'i skabs su 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas na gsungs dgos kyi yod red/ de zer dus ga re zer gyi yod red/ mtha' la mi gnas na zer dus 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa gsungs kyi yod red pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa yin na/ ga re go rgyu yod red/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du ma ro gcig pa rtogs pa red/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa red/ chos thams cad ro gcig pa rtogs yong dus mtha' la mi gnas gsungs pa red/ 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas na chos thams cad mnyam nyid ro gcig pa rtogs kyi red gsungs pa red/ phyag rgya chen po mnyam nyid ro gcig pa rtogs pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po mnyam nyid rtse gcig tu rtogs yong dus sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur/ ༈ zhe 'dod kun dang bral zer ba'i skabs su zhe 'dod de phyag rgya chen po'i snying po'i don yid la mi byed pa'i steng du slebs yong dus zhe 'dod thams cad rang zhi ru 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ rang zhi ru 'gro ba'am rang bzhin yal 'gro gi red zer ba red/ dper na ga 'dra red zer na dpe bzhag gi 'dug / 0000000000000255 rang byung rang zhi chu yi pa tra 'dra// 00000000gsungs pa red/ rang gi sems la rnam par rtog pa ga tshod cig byung na'ang gnyen po la brten nas rnam rtog de spangs mi dgos pa dper na mtsho chen po la rlung gis bskyod yong dus rlung gis skabs skabs mtsho'i ri mo 'dra mi 'dra bzo yi 'dug /rlung gi stobs kyis rlung gi 'gro stangs kyi khyad par la brten nas chu nang la ri mo 'dra mi 'dra yong gi red de yin na yang snga ma snga ma'i ri mo de yong gin yong gin la phyi ma phyi ma'i ri mo yal 'gro gi red ma gtogs ri mo bsdad sdod kyi ma red/

pa tra zer yag de saṃskrita'i skad red/ ri mo zer gyi yod red/ chu yi ri mo 'dra po red gsungs pa red/ chu yi pa tra 'dra zer na rang byung rang zhi ri mo de ga ba nas byung ba red chu'i nang nas byung ba red/ ga bar brlag 'gro gi red/ chu'i nang la rang brlag 'gro gi red/ de rba rlabs dang gcig pa red pa/ rba rlabs de ga nas byung ba red/ rgya mtsho'i klong nas byung ba red/ thim yang rgya mtsho'i klong du phar thim 'gro gi red/ rba rlabs de yod pa'i skabs su yang rba rlabs de rgya mtsho dang ma bral ba red/ rba rlabs de'ang rgya mtsho rang red ma gtogs rgya mtsho las tha dad yod ma red/ yin na yang rgya mtsho'i rtsal dang rgya mtsho'i rol pa de rba rlabs slebs yong ba red pa/ de la nga tsho 'jig skrag skye ba red/ rba rlabs de rgya mtsho'i rtsal red ma gtogs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs de mar zhi 'gro dus rgya mtsho sngo thing thing de rang red/ yin na yang rkyen 'du byed kyi rtsol ba rlung la brten nas rlung shugs chen po brgyab yong dus rba rlabs slebs yong gi yod red/ de nang bzhin rba rlabs dang 'dra ba'i nga rang tsho'i rnam rtog bzang po dang ngan pa'i 'du shes rnam par shes pa tshogs drug gi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i kun rtog thams cad la rba rlabs zer nas lab kyi 'dug /kun rtog gi rba rlabs de ga nas byung ba red/ rba rlabs de yang yid la mi byed pa'i gnas lugs la brten nas yong ba red 'dug /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs la brten nas yong gi yod red rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs la brten nas yong gi yod red/ gnas lugs chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin la brten nas yong gi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus rnam rtog ga tshod cig byung ba yin na'ang rnam rtog gi ngo bo ngo ma shes shing rnam rtog la 'dzin pa dam po zhugs yong dus gcig yul la zhen gcig yul can la zhen/

de nas rang snang la yul du 'khrul/ rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul/ de nas gnyis 'dzin 'go tshugs song*/ de la rigs pas brtag shes na rigs pas dpyad shes na mnyam pa nyid chos sku'i grogs su 'gyur dgos kyi yod na/ rang gi yid la byung ba'i rnam rtog ga tshod cig byung ba thams cad de chos sku'i grogs yin pa la rtogs dgos pa dang*/ sems la rnam par rtog pa thams cad de rang byung rang zhir rtogs thub dgos kyi red gsungs 'dug /rang byung rang zhi chu yi pa tra 'dra// rang byung rang zhi chu yi pa tra 'dra po rtogs thub yin na/ rnal 'byor pa de la rnam rtog thams cad de chos nyid kyi yo lang chags yong gi yod red/ chos nyid kyi yo lang dang chos nyid kyi grogs chags yong gi yod red/ gong du zhus pa nang bzhin nags la me chen po shor yong dus rlung chen po de me'i grogs su 'gro gi yod red pa/ ji tsam ji tsam rlung shugs chen po yod na'ang de tsam de tsam me shugs che ru 'gro yong dus nags thams cad bsreg thub kyi yod red/ de nang bzhin rnal 'byor pa la rang byung rang zhi chu yi pa tra dang 'dra ba rnam rtog gi byung tshor thams cad byung yang chos nyid kyi klong las byung thim yang chos nyid kyi klong la phar thim thub yag gi de 'dra'i nges shes brtan po zhig byung thub na/ ji tsam ji tsam rnal 'byor pa la rnam rtog mang na de tsam de tsam chos nyid kyi grogs chags thub kyi red/ chos nyid kyi yo lang chags pa red/ chos nyid kyi 'bab stegs chags pa red/ chos nyid kyi bogs 'don chags yong ba red/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa la rnam rtog yod dgos kyi yod red/ rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul yin// rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul yin par ngo shes yong dus rnam rtog de chos nyid kyi grogs chags dge sbyor gyi grogs chags 'gro ba red 'dug /'o de lta bu red gsungs 'dug

/rnam par rtog pa gang 'khrul na'ang dper na rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis bskyod na pa tra 'byung gi red la yin na'ang pa tra 'byung gin 'byung gin la yal 'gro yag gi skabs dang mtshungs pa bzhin du sems kyi rnam par rtog pa yang gcig gi rting la gcig 'byung gi yod red de/ phyi ma skye gin skye gin la snga ma snga ma 'gag 'gro gi 'dug ma gtogs rnam rtog snga ma thams cad hrag hrag byed nas bsdad na rnam rtog phyi ma skye sa'i go skabs de bkag gi red pa/ 'on kyang de yong gi mi 'dug /rnam rtog phyi ma phyi ma skye gin skye gin rnam rtog snga ma snga ma 'gag 'gro gi yod red/ rtsa ba rang gi sems red ma gtogs gzhan gang yang yod ma red/ de yi ngang las ma g.yos ba red/ de nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag dgos pa red/ de la brten nas/

0000000000000255 mi gnas mi dmigs don las mi 'da' na// 00000000gsungs pa red/ don ga 'dra zhig gi steng la bsdad dgos pa red zer na/ mi gnas pa mi dmigs pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ mi gnas zer yag de gang red/ yul gang du'ang mi gnas pa yul can blo gang gis kyang mi dmigs pa zer nas lab dgos kyi yod red/ yul gang du'ang mi gnas pa zer na/ yul de ga ba yod red yul de ga ba yin na'ang yod ma red/ gzugs ga ba 'dug /gzugs rnyed kyi ma red/ sgra ga ba 'dug /sgra gang du'ang gnas yod ma red/ dri ga ba 'dug /dri gang du'ang gnas yod ma red/ ro ga ba 'dug /ro gang du'ang gnas yod ma red/ reg bya ga ba 'dug /reg bya gang du'ang gnas yod ma red/ chos ga ba 'dug /chos gang du'ang gnas yod ma red/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya/ chos thams cad gang du'ang mi gnas la/ gal srid yod du chug kyang blo yis mthong dgos kyi yod red/ blo gang gis mthong gi red zer na/ mthong mkhan gyi blos brtag yong dus mthong mkhan gyi blo yang mi dmigs pa red/ 'das pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad ni 'gag zin pa red/ ma 'ongs pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad ni skye rgyu red/ da lta ba'i shes pa skad cig ma des mthong gi red zer yag de yang brda tsam dang rnam par rtog pas btags bzhag pa red ma gtogs skad cig ma zer yag de yang yod ma red pa/ skad cig ma ga ba yod red/ skad cig ma zer nas lab bzhag pa red ma gtogs de yang snga phyi gnyis la phra ba phra ba la dpyad pa yin na/ 'das pa la phyogs pa'i skad cig ma dang ma 'ongs pa la phyogs ba'i skad cig ma gcig red/ da lta ba yang skad cig ma ma red/ de 'dra yin dus yul gang du'ang mi gnas yul can blo gang gis kyang mi dmigs pa'i don las mi 'da' na/ de 'dra'i don nam de 'dra'i gnas lugs kyi steng la btsan sa zin nas de 'dra'i gnas lugs kyi ngang nas phar 'da' ma thub na/

dam tshig yin gsungs pa red/ 'di tshig de yar bcad dgos red/ mi gnas mi dmigs don las mi 'da' na// dam tshig /zer nas lab pa red/ sngags kyi skabs su dam tshig yag shos de yin gsungs 'dug /spyir btang sngags kyi skabs su kun rig gi cho ga'i nang du/ sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya// sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni// nam yang bya ba ma yin no// dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spangs// dus kun du ni byang chub sems// snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang*/ lha dang bla ma'ang de bzhin no/ sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang*// bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya// zer nas dam tshig mang po zhig bshad bsdad kyi 'dug /de bzhin du bde mchog 'khor lo'i rgyud sde la sogs pa dang*/ ma hā ma ya dang gdan bzhi dang de tsho'i steng la lha so so la brten nas las bzhi sgrub stangs dang de la brten nas dam tshig sgrub stangs de tsho so so gsungs kyi yod red/ yin na yang snying po don gyi chos skor de bshad yong dus mdo sngags thams cad mtshams sbyor gyi lta ba yin pa yin dus de'i steng nas dam tshig gsungs stangs de zab pa zhig gsungs yong gi 'dug /chu brgya zam 'og tu 'dus pa'i dpe ltar chu klung brgya tham pa yod na'ang zam pa gcig gi 'og nas 'gro dgos kyi red pa/ de bzhin lha gtso 'khor gyi grangs mang nyung dang 'brel ba'i bskyed pa lha/ skyed byed sngags/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po la sogs pa mang po yod red/ de tsho la brten nas lha so so la dam tshig mi 'dra ba mang po yod na'ang chu brgya zam 'og tu 'dus pa bzhin zam pa gcig de ga re red zer na/ snying po'i don yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de kho na la brten nas 'gro dgos kyi yod/ de la brten nas phyag rgya chen po de la yang mdo sngags mtshams sbyor gyi lta ba yin gsungs pa 'di red pa/ mdo'i skabs su yin na rgyud bla ma'i gzhung dang bstun nas gsungs kyi yod red/

bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde gang la brten nas gsungs kyi yod red zer na/ nges don gyi mdo sde nyi shu rtsa gcig yod red/ mya ngan las 'das pa che chung gnyis/ rnga bo che'i mdo/ sprin chen po'i mdo/ mdo ting 'dzin gyi rgyal po la sogs pa de thams cad don dam pa'i snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor gyi mdo sde sha stag yin pa red/ rgyud bla ma 'dra po cha bzhag pa yin na'ang spyir mdo sde'i khongs su 'gro yi yod red/ 'di phyag rgya chen po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de'i khungs gtug sa red/ sngags kyi skabs su yin na ni/ spyir bla med rgyud sde phal che ba de yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de'i khungs gtug sa gcig pu yin pa red/ rgyal ba mai tri pas/ yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor la de kho na nyid bcu pa lta bu mang po gsungs yod red/ khyad par du pha ma gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo de yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor khungs gtug sa sngags bla med kyi rgyud sde nang la yag shos dang zab shos de yin pa red/ dus 'khor skabs ye shes le'u la gtso bo gtugs yod pa red pa/ 'o da de tsho red/ de bzhin du rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nang la yin na yang de ga rang red/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*// 'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*// lhan cig skye dga'i rang bzhin nga*// zhes gsungs pa de tsho thams cad kyang gtso bo de snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor gyi nang la 'gro bsdad kyi yod pa red/ mi gnas mi dmigs don las mi 'da' na// dam tshig yin gsungs pa red/ yul gang du'ang mi gnas yul can blo gang gis kyang mi dmigs pa/ de la brten nas rje btsun mi la ras pas nga'i bla ma rje btsun mar pa lho brag gis snang ba yul du ma grub/ snang ba thams cad sems su thag bcad/

snang mkhan gyi sems ma grub/ sems stong nyid du thag bcad/ gsal ba'i sems yang bden grub med par sems stong pa la ngo sprod/ stong pa de yang stong pa stong rkyang ma yin par stong pa lhun grub tu ngo sprod/ lhun grub kyi yon tan ngo shes pas rang grol bzhi yi steng nas gsungs 'dug /snang ba sems/ sems stong pa/ stong pa lhun grub/ lhun grub rang grol zer nas ngo sprod bzhi'i thog nas gsungs kyi yod red/ de tsho tshang ma don dag 'di rang red 'dug /yul gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ yul can gang du'ang mi dmigs pa/ mdo sde rgyan gyi nang la yang*/ sems las gzhan med pa ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de min ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// gsungs pa de tsho tshang ma'i don dag de rang red/ de yin dus mi gnas pa mi dmigs pa'i don las mi 'da' na/ 0000000000000255 dam tshig mi 'da' mun pa'i sgron me yin// 11/ 00000000dam tshig yin gsungs pa red/ ga re'i dam tshig yin zer na/ sngags kyi dam tshig yag shos de yin gsungs pa red/ dam tshig zab shos de red/ de 'dra'i mi gnas mi dmigs don la gnas thub na/ dam tshig ched du bsrung ma dgos pa red/ rje btsun mi la ras pas nges don rdzogs pa lnga ldan nang la gsungs 'dug /rten kun nas grub pa'i dkon mchog gsum// de ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs// de la gsol ba 'debs kyang ma dgos so// ngag bzlas brjod dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ de tsho tshang ma gcig pa red 'dug /rten kun nas grub pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum de ye gdod ma nas rang chas su yod gsungs 'dug /don dam pa'i dkon mchog gsum po de rang rgyud la yod pa de ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs gsungs 'dug /de kho na nyid yid la mi byed pa'i gnas lugs kyi ngang du rdzogs bsdad yod red gsungs pa red/

don dam pa'i dkon mchog gsum po de khag khag med gsungs pa red/ de yin dus de la gsol ba 'debs kyang mi dgos so/ spyir btang nga tshos dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs dgos kyi yod ma red zer na kha shob tsha po chags 'gro gi red pa/ yin na yang snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor don dam pa'i gnas tshul dbang btsan por bshad yong dus de ma bcos pa rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs pa de rje btsun mi las gzigs pa red ma gtogs ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs yod red gsol ba btab dgos kyi ma red zer na 'di 'grig gi ma red/ yin na yang de la nges shes shig dgos kyi yod red/ de la rtogs pa'i gdeng zhig dgos kyi yod red/ rtogs pa'i gdeng dang nges shes dri ma med pa zhig yod song na de ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs pa de la don dam pa'i spobs pa zhig slebs thub kyi yod red/ de la gsol ba btab ma dgos pa red// ngag bzlas brjod dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor bde// kha ton 'don mi dgos pa red/ gsol 'debs 'don mi dgos pa red/ bla ma rgyang 'bod skad brgyab nas 'don mi dgos pa yin pa red/ don dam par gsol ba btab btab pa yin pa red 'dug /sngags kyi skabs su dam tshig mang po bsrung dgos yag de tsho re re bzhin du bsrung dgos na dka' las khag po red pa/ lha la ga tshod ga tshod yod red/ dper na bya rgyud gcig po la yang lha ga tshod yod red de thams cad kyi dam tshig bsrung dgos na dka' las khag po red/ cha tshang bsrung thub kyi ma red pa/ de yin tsang snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor chos sku mnyam nyid grogs su 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs kyi chos thams cad kyi sgron me/ gnas lugs thams cad kyi bab so/ lam thams cad kyi skyel sa/ chos nyid kyi zad sa gcig ma gtogs med pa de snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos 'khor de kho na nyid bcu pa las gsungs pa nang bzhin yong gi yod red/

de 'dra po'i steng nas dngos gnas drang gnas kyi sgom pa'i don dam rnam par nges pa'i steng la gnas thub na/ dam tshig zab shos yin gsungs 'dug /mi 'da' mun pa'i sgron me yin/ ༈ /dam tshig de yar bcad/ yang mi 'da' zer ba'i skabs su mar bcad dgos pa red/ de 'dra po'i dam tshig gi steng la gnas thub na dam tshig de nyams kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ mi 'da' zer nas 'dug /dam tshig de las phar 'da' thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ 'di la dam tshig zer nas sbyar dgos kyi red/ ga re red zer na spyir btang nga tshos lha bsgrub nas dam tshig bsrung dgos na mtshams mtshams la dam tshig nyams srid kyi red pa/ dper na nyi ma re re la kha ton sgom bzlas de tsho chad med byed zer na yang mtshams mtshams la dka' las khag po red/ brjed 'gro gi red pa/ dam tshig chung chung zhig nyams tshar ba red/ de 'dra po yong gi red/ dam tshig rtsa ltung bcu bzhi la sogs de tsho bshad yong dus de tsho nyams yag la tog tsam dka' las khag po yod red/ de lta bu snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor steng nas mi gnas mi dmigs rang byung rang zhi chu yi pa tra 'dra po yid la mi byed pa zhe 'dod kun dang bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs thub na dam tshig nyams yag med pa red/ bag med pa'i spyod pa yong na yang gnod pa skyel thub kyi ma red/ sems de g.yeng song na'ang gnod pa skyel thub kyi ma red pa/ mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs tshar yong dus dam tshig de las phar nam yang 'da' thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ sngags nas bshad pa'i 'gal 'das nyams ral zer nas mang po zhig bshad bsdad kyi yod pa de tsho yong yag nyen kha med pa red/ de med na yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de'i nyams len med de'i spobs pa'i gdeng med na ngas dam tshig bsrung gi yod bsam na'ang dam tshig bsrung gi yod bsam pa des dam tshig nyams 'gro gi yod pa red/

de yin dus dam tshig bsrung gi yod zer na'ang phan gyi mi 'dug /don la bsrung mtshams 'das pa rtogs na dam tshig zab shos yin zhing de la mun pa'i sgron me yin gsung pa red/ mun nag nang la sgron me btegs pa bzhin de'i skabs su sgron me zer ba de chos thams cad kyi sgron me de don dam pa khong du chud pa de la gsungs pa red 'dug /don dam pa'i gnas tshul de la sgron me zer nas gsungs kyi yod red/ mun pa zer mkhan de ga re la bshad kyi yod red zer nas 'dzin pa dang bcas pa de la mun pa gsungs kyi yod red/ gong du bshad pa nang bzhin zhe 'dod zer nas 'dug pa de red/ spyir 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa bye brag tu thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la 'dzin pa phra mo yod pa ste mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam thams cad la zhe 'dod yod bsdad pa de la mun pa gsungs pa red/ de'i skabs su mun pa zer yag de yang ma rig pa la go rgyu yod ma red/ ma rig pa zer yag de mthun mong gi skad cha zhig red pa/ 'di'i skabs su mun pa de bye brag pa zhig la go dgos kyi yod pa yin dus bye brag pa de thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob yag la mthar thug gi 'bras bu bla na med pa rang gi rgyud la skye yag de la 'dzin zhen dang bcas pa bde ba dang gsal ba dang mi rtog pa'i nyams la sogs pa'i zhen pa ga re yod pa yin na'ang lam gyi yon tan la sogs pa la zhen pa ga re yod na'ang de la mun pa gsungs pa red/ de 'dra'i mun pa phar bsal bar byed pa la sgron me dgos kyi red pa/ dper na smag med pa gtang yag la sgron me de spar dgos kyi yod pa de nang bzhin gyis de 'dra'i mun pa de phar bsal yag la sgron me lta bu de don dam pa khong du chud pa yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de yin gsungs pa red/ dper na mun pa la sgron me btegs pa bzhin du zhe 'dod kun dang bral ba de don dam pa'i sgron me yin pa dang*/

zhen pa yod pa dang 'dzin pa yod pa de mun pa yin gsungs pa red 'dug /yid la bya rgyu zhig yod tshar na de thams cad mun pa chags tshar ba red/ 00000255 zhe 'dod kun bral mtha' la mi gnas na// sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur/ ༈ /12/ 00000000spyir btang nga tshos 'khor ba zer yag de spang bya la zhen pa zhig yod red/ myang 'das zer yag de la blang bya la zhen pa zhig yod red/ de nas yar sngags kyi skabs su lha la zhen pa yod red/ lha'i dkyil 'khor la zhen pa yod red/ lha'i bzlas brjod la zhen pa yod red/ bzlas brjod grangs mang nyung gi zhen pa yod red/ de ga nang bzhin bla ma la zhen pa yod red/ bla ma'i gdams ngag la zhen pa yod red/ bla ma'i byin rlabs la zhen pa yod red/ de 'dra'i lha dang bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa dang gang la yang zhen pa yod na de mi 'grig pa red/ chags pa dang zhen pa zer mkhan de spang dgos kyi yod red/ bzang po'i chags pa yang spang dgos kyi yod red/ ngan pa'i chags pa yang spang dgos kyi yod red/ rje btsun mi las/ 'jur bur bcings pa'i rnam rtog de// lhod kyis glod na grol bar 'gyur// gsungs pa nang bzhin 'jur bur bcings pa'i rnam rtog de bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog cha tshang la gsungs kyi yod red/ zhe 'dod kun bral mtha' la mi gnas na// zer na chags pa dang zhen pa'i sems kun dang bral zhing mtha' rnam pa gnyis la mi gnas na zhes mtha' rnam pa gnyis ga re red/ yod pa'i mtha' dang med pa'i mtha'/ yang na 'khor ba'i mtha' dang myang 'das kyi mtha'/ mdor na mtha' gnyis yod nas bzung ste gegs red/ zhe 'dod kun dang bral ba'i mtha' gnyis la mi gnas na/ sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur// gsungs pa red/ sde snod la tshe gcig la sbyang pa byed dgos yag med red gsungs pa red/ rje btsun mi las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ snang srid dpe cha bltas bltas nas// yig nag dpe cha blta ma myong*// gsungs 'dug

/snang srid thams cad dpe cha la gzigs pa yin gsungs pa red/ rdo gcig yod na yang gdams ngag la shar 'gro ba red/ byi'u gcig 'phur na yang nyams len red 'gro ba red/ me gcig 'bar na yang nyams len du red 'gro ba red/ chu gcig 'bab kyi yod na'ang de nyams len du 'gro ba red/ de yin dus snang ba brda yi bla ma zer nas bshad kyi 'dug /spyir btang snang ba brda yi bla ma dang chos nyid don dam gyi bla ma zer gnyis bshad kyi yod red/ snang ba brda yi bla ma zer yag de tshur mthong gi ri rwa ba khang pa khyim yul gyi bkod pa shing sa rdo 'ja' tshon nas bzung ste cha tshang khong gi bla ma yin gsungs pa red pa/ de tsho re re'i steng nas gdams ngag sna re re de re re'i steng nas gdams ngag gi tshul re re byung song gsungs pa red/ de yin dus snang ba brda yi bla ma snang srid thams cad bla ma'i rnam pa la shar yong dus yig nag gi dpe cha blta ma myong gsungs 'dug /yin gcig min gnyis dpe cha blo la 'dzin nas sbyang ma myong ba red/ rtsa ba blo la 'dzin gzugs po g.yug dka' las brgyab de 'dra byed ma myong ba red/ sde snod la mi tshe hril por sbyang na'ang don dam pa'i gnas tshul de phyin ci ma log par rtogs ma thub na gang yang phan gyi ma red/ shi ba'i skabs su tha mal pa rang red gang yang phan gyi yod ma red/ mkhas pa ga tshod cig yin zer na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/ grub thob ga tshod cig yin zer na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/ ga tshod cig gi sgom chen pa yin zer na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/ gtso bo che shos de ga re red zer na sems don la phan pa'i man ngag de tshul bzhin du rgyud la sbyar thub dgos kyi 'dug /blo sbyong don bdun ma las gsungs pa nang bzhin/ dpang po gnyis kyis gtso bor bzung*/ zhes rang gi dpang po de gtso bor bzung dgos kyi 'dug /'di ga re red zer na gtso bo sems don gyi man ngag gi steng nas 'gro dgos kyi yod red/

sems don gyi man ngag de ra 'phrod pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ de byung na/ sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur// gsungs pa red/ sde snod kyi chos thams cad mi tshe la sbyang na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/ dge bshes shig gis mi la ras pa la/ spyir tshad ma'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par mngon sum dang rjes dpag gi mtshan nyid/ 'gal rtags dang 'brel rtags/ snang la ma nges pa'i rtags kyi grub mtha' rnams zhog zer nas zhus pa red/ de zhus pa'i skabs su rje btsun mi la ras pas/ bdag gzhan kun la gnod pa sman log nad du song ba dang*/ chos log sdig tu song ba de 'dra mi shes te/ snang ba thams cad sems su thag chod/ sems 'od gsal stong pa la ngo lkog med par yid ches pas rjes su dpag dgos kyi chos gcig kyang med/ 'gal 'brel dang snang la ma nges pa'i rtags dgos na 'gal 'brel gyi rtags yang dag de ngas bzhag dgos kyi mi 'dug khyod rang gis bzhag bzhag pa red 'dug /ston pa'i shes rgyud dam pa'i chos dang 'gal bas 'gal rtags yang dag yin/ khyod rang gi spyod lam gyi las ka gang byas pa thams cad chos dang 'gal bsdad kyi 'dug pas 'gal rtags yang dag red/ khyed rang gis chos byed tshad thams cad 'gal rtags de ka nyon mongs pa dang 'brel 'dug pas 'brel rtags yang dag yin zhing*/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa de che ru che ru song spyod pa de rtsub tu rtsub tu song ba de chos pa'i gzugs brnyan du snang la 'gal 'brel gnyis ka'i rtags tshang ba de snang la ma nges pa'i rtags yin no gsungs pa red/ de 'dra po red/ sde snod la mi tshe gcig sbyang na'ang phan gyi yod ma red/ rkyen gcig la thug yong dus sa la 'gril yong gi yod red/ nyams len gyi gnad la brten nas bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang 'grogs nas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas rje btsun mi la ras pas bla ma mar pa la ji ltar bsten pa dang*/

paṇa chen nā ro pas tai lo pa la ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul de 'dra pos nyams su len gyi yin na gdams ngag la the tshom yod ma red/ gdams ngag la nor 'gro yag med pa red/ dpe cha mkhas pa zhig gis dpe cha brtsam bzhag pa de la nyams su len pa yin na nor srid yag yod pa red/ lam nor yag nyen kha yod red/ zab mo'i gnad la myong ba mthar thug pa zhig skyes tshar mkhan zhig gis rang gis gsol ba ji ltar btab pa'i tshul la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas gdams ngag bsten yong dus nor ba med pa red 'dug /gdams ngag la the tshom za ma dgos pa red/ man ngag gzhan la 'gram chu mi ldang ngo*// gsungs pa de man ngag gzhan dang 'gram chu ldang dgos kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ shing tog ku shu mthong yong dus 'gram chu ldang gi red/ de 'dra po byed nas man ngag gzhan la 'gram chu ldang dgos kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ dpal sprul rin po che'i tshig gsum gnad brdeg nang la gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel/ zhes gsungs yod/ de 'dra'i sems kyi gnas lugs mthong tshar dus sems gnas pa dang 'gyu ba gnyis kyi bar lag de 'gyel 'gro ba yin gsungs pa red/ da lta nga tsho'i gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel yod ma red/ gnas 'gyu'i bar lag yod red/ dang po sems gnas zer ba'i skabs su gnas pa dang*// gnas pa'i mtshams nas 'gyu zer ba'i skabs shig /de nas rig zer ba'i skabs su rig pa'i mtshams shig yod red pa/ man ngag snying po'i lugs la nyams len mthar thug pa zhig slebs yong dus gnas 'gyu rig gsum thams cad de gcig red/ gnas 'gyu rig gsum thams cad de byung yang chos nyid kyis klong las byung*/ 'phro yang chos nyid kyis klong nas 'phro/ 'gag kyang chos nyid kyi klong du 'gag 'gro dus gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel song ba red pa/ gnas bzhin du 'phro chog pa 'phro bzhin du gnas pa/ shar bas gnas pa la ma gnod gnas pas shar ba la ma gnod pa/

gnas pa dang shar ba gang byung na'ang de thams cad de chos nyid kyi yo lang red/ kha nas bshad na rdzogs yag yod ma red/ yin na yang gnad 'gag 'dra po zhig gi steng la slebs yong dus thams cad gcig pa red bsdad kyi yod sa red pa/ 'o de 'dra yin dus sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur// gsungs pa 'di red/ de ma gtogs mgo yi skra dkar po red tshar song na'ang da dung sgra chos can/ mi rtag pa yin ste/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir zer bsdad pas phan gyi med pa red 'dug /rnam mkhyen 'thob par zab mo'i gnad la myong ba thon dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug /kha rag sgom chung gi mgur nang du/ tha snyad tshig la mi zad thug pa med// de bas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa lon mdzod la// gong ma'i gdan sa dben gnas dam pa ru// bse ru bzhin du gcig pur mi gnas sam// gsungs 'dug /tha snyad tshig la mi zad thug pa med// rdzogs yag med red/ sde snod la mi tshe sbyang bsdad pa yin na yang da dung mang du mang du 'gro nas bcom ldan 'das la yang 'khor gsum bskor yag mang po dran bsdad kyi red/ de 'dra yong bsdad kyi yod red/ de bas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa lon mdzod la// bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang 'brel nas bla ma dam pa'i man ngag rang gi snying khung rus pa'i gting du bcug nas stan thog gcig la spang la be phur brdab pa nang bzhin byed nas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab ste sgom brgyab kyi yin na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa lon thub kyi red gsungs 'dug /gong ma'i gdan sa dben gnas dam pa ru// bse ru bzhin du gcig pur mi gnas sam// gsungs pa de 'di red/ de 'dra yin dus sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur// gsungs yag de dpe cha po ti bre chen tsam zhig rgyab la 'khyer nas 'gro bsdad pa yin na yang phan gyi ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /zhe 'dod thams cad bral ma thub na mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i nyams len gyi steng la slebs ma thub na/
mi tshe hril por sde snod sbyang bsdad pa yin na'ang sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/

0000000000000255 don 'dir gzhol na 'khor ba'i btson las thar// don 'dir mnyam bzhag sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg / bstan pa'i sgron me zhes su bshad pa yin// 00000255 00000000de 'dra'i rang byung rang zhi chu yi pa tra 'dra po'i mi gnas mi dmigs pa'i don yid la byed pa dang bral ba zhe 'dod thams cad dang bral ba'i mun pa'i sgron me yin pa mun pa'i sgron me yid la mi byed pa'i gnas lugs de'i steng la gzhol na gsungs pa red/ gzhol na zer yag de de'i steng la slebs thub na gsungs pa red/ de'i steng la nyams len mthar phyin na gsungs pa red ma gtogs de'i steng la bsdad sdod na zer ba'i skad cha ma red/ nyams su len na zer ba'i skad cha ma red/ de'i steng du tshad 'khyol na'am tshad 'khyol ba'am de'i steng du slebs thub na dang de'i steng du nyams su myong thub na 'khor ba'i btson las thar gsungs pa red 'dug /de lta bu'i sems kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i don de nyid la mos pa tsam ma yin pa mos pa'i steng nas de'i steng du nyams len tshad 'khyol ba zhig byed thub pa yin na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho'i btson khang chen po las thar gyi red gsungs pa red/ don 'dir mnyam bzhag sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg /don 'dir mnyam bzhag zer na don 'di'i steng du mnyam par bzhag na'am nyams su myong na gsungs pa red/ mnyam par bzhag pa'am nyams su myong na de kho na nyid kyi blos mthong ba'am yang na nyams su myong na/ yang na brtan pa thob na zer na'ang 'grig gi red/ brtan pa thob zer ba'i tshig de yag po yod red/ brtan pa thob de 'dra byung ba yin na sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg gi red gsungs pa red/ yin gcig min gnyis badz+ra sa twa dung phyur gsag dgos yag 'dra po dang sdig sgrib dag yag la 'phral sel gyi thabs 'dra mi 'dra byed yag yod red pa de tsho ma dgos pa red 'dug

/don de'i steng la mnyam par bzhag song na nad brgya sman gcig zer yag de red/ phyag rgya chen po la mtshams mtshams dkar po gcig thub zer gyi yod red/ dkar po chig thub la sa skya pas dgag pa brgyab kyi yod red/ khyed rang tsho'i dkar po chig thub zer yag de skad cha cho mi 'dug /mgo la skyabs 'gro yod dam med/ mjug la bsngo ba yod dam med/ yod na dkar po chig thub red mi 'dug /dkar po nyis thub red 'dug ces dgag pa brgyab mkhan byung yod red/ yin na yang de'i don dag de khag khag red pa/ de la lan phar brgyab yod red/ dkar po gcig thub zer yag de phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag rang gi steng nas yid la mi byed pa'i chos nyid gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs tshar ba'i skad cha red ma gtogs/ gzhi nas skyabs 'gro 'don bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags dmigs pa med pa klog bsdad pa de dkar po chig thub la slebs kyang thub yod ma red/ de dkar po gcig thub blo la ma shong ba'i skad cha red bden yang bden 'dug /de yin dus dkar po chig thub zer yag de sman dkar po chig thub zer yag gi nad brgya sman gcig zer yag de yin pa red/ sdig sgrib ma lus pa sreg par byed pa la re re bzhin du la lha re re bsten/ gnyen po re re bsten nas sdig sgrib re re dag dgos kyi yod na yun ring 'gor 'gro gi red pa/ de ma dgos pa gnas lugs de'i steng la slebs nyams su myong brtan pa thob song na sdig sgrib thams cad skad cig gcig la bsreg bzhag gi red/ dus mtha'i mes ri rab thams cad skad cig gcig la bsreg 'gro gi red pa/ de nang bzhin gyis sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg 'gro ba yin pa red/ bstan pa'i sgron me zhes su bshad pa yin/ des na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgron me/ 'di skabs su bstan pa zer na spyir btang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la go rgyu ma yin pa/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po ste snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor yin pa de kho na nyid bcu pa'i nang la gsungs yod/ de yin dus snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po red/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po'i sgron me yin gsungs pa red/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgron me la mang po yod red pa/ mi rtag pa yang dag pa zhig bsgom pa yin na yang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgron me red/ skyabs 'gro rnam dag cig nyams len byed na'ang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgron me red/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi nyams len byed na'ang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgron me red de 'di skabs su bstan pa'i sgron me zer ba de zhe 'dod thams cad dang bral ba/ mtha' thams cad las 'das pa/ yid la mi byed pa/ yul gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ yul can blo gang gis kyang mi dmigs par mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa de la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgron me yin gsungs pa red/00000000 16711680 de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rjes gdams pa ni/ 00000000 00000000 00000255 don 'dir mi mos skye bo blun po rnams// 00000000de 'dra po'i phyag rgya chen po'i don snying po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor de la yang zhe drag dad pa med mkhan yang yod red/ 'di gtso bo mi dmigs pa zer yag de sems can spyi yongs la gsungs kyi yod ma red/ grub mtha' la zhen pa yod mkhan 'ga' shas shig la gsungs kyi yod red/ grub mtha' la zhen 'dzin yod mkhan nam rang rang so so'i lta grub la zhen pa yod mkhan/ de 'dra'i rtog ge ba 'ga' shas shig yod pa red/ mgo mkhreg po dang klad pa mkhreg po de 'dra 'ga' shas sam blo gros kyi mig med pa'i blun po rnams ni/ 0000000000000255 'khor ba'i chu bos rtag tu 'khyer bar zad//

00000000srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las rtag tu mi thar zhing*/ ngan song gi gnas nas sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong bar 'gyur te/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi shes bya mdzod kyi nang la/ bod ston phal ches lugs 'di sems tsam zhes/ thogs med sku mched mched bcas dman par 'dzin// thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan gyur nyi zla ni// shing rta gnyis kyi gzhung lugs kho na ste// gzhung phran rgyu skar brag cha'i rjes zlos kyi// phyogs zhen spangs nas mtshungs par 'jug par rigs// zhes gsungs 'dug /bod ston phal cher lugs 'di sems tsam zhes zer na bod pa'i ston pa 'ga' shas shig ste go ram pas dbu ma gzhan stong gi nyams len de tsho sems tsam pa'i lta ba red ma gtogs sems tsam pa'i lta ba las sor gang 'phags yod ma red zer nas 'phags bod gnyis la mna' bskyal nas dam bca' bzhag nas 'gro thub sa red zer nas lab pa red/ thogs med sku mched mched bcas dman par 'dzin/ thogs med dang klu grub khong rnam pa gnyis kyi bar la khyad par chen po zhig blta gi 'dug /thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan gyur nyi zla ni// shing rta gnyis kyi gzhung lugs kho na ste// yin na yang thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan shing rta rnam pa gnyis kyi gzhung lugs ma gtogs 'gro sa med pa red/ yang na zab mo gtso bor bstan pa 'phags pa klu grub kyi lta ba sngon du 'gro dgos kyi red/ yang min na rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi thog nas 'gro na rgyal ba thogs med kyi gzhung nas 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ de gnyis thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan gyur nyi zla gnyis red/ gzhung phran rgyu skar brag cha'i rjes zlos kyi// phyogs zhen spangs nas mtshungs par 'jug par rigs// de ma gtogs pa'i gzhan gzhung phran tshegs rnam ni rgyu skar dang brag cha nang bzhin de la ha las rgyu gang yang mi 'dug gsungs pa red/

'o de yin dus mi mos pa zer mkhan de 'di'i steng nas yong gi 'dug /ga re byed nas mi mos pa red zer na/ mi mos pa de rang rang so so'i de lta bu'i snying po yid la mi byed pa'i nyams len de blo la shong gi yod ma red/ bsod nams kyi tshogs zhan pa/ shes rab kyi rtsal zhan pa/ brtson 'grus kyi rgyu tshogs zhan yong dus cha rkyen mang po zhig ma tshang mthun rkyen shin tu nyung 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i rkyen mang yong dus don de la mos thub kyi yod ma red/ 'jug pa sems bskyed drug pa'i nang la/ so so skye bo'i dus na'ang stong pa nyid thos nas// nang du rab tu dga' ba yang dang yang du 'byung*// rab tu dga' ba las byung mchi mas mig brlan zhing*// lus kyi ba spu ldang bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa// de la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blo yi sa bon yod// de nyid nye bar bstan pa'i snod ni de yin te// de la dam pa'i don gyi bden pa bstan par bya// gsungs 'dug /stong pa nyid yin na'ang so so skye bo'i dus nas stong pa nyid la bag chags yod pa zhig dgos kyi yod na/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len zer mkhan de dngos gnas drang gnas sam nges par du bsod nams kyi rgyu tshogs mang ba/ brtson 'grus kyi rgyu tshogs grangs mang ba/ shes rab kyi rtsal che ba de 'dra'i rigs dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs de ga tsam bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa med pas tshe 'di la rang yong thub kyi yod sa ma red/ stong pa nyid yang dag pa ni dper na phyogs kyi glang po dang chos kyi grags pa la sogs pa sngar byon zin pa'i mkhas pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis tshul bzhin du rtogs thub yod ma red zer khyed kyis smra'am zer na/ de de bzhin du smra'o zhes 'jug pa'i rang 'grel nang gsungs 'dug /ngas de ga rang lab kyi yin zer nas rtogs yod ma red gsungs pa red/ de 'dra yin dus mkhas pa yin pa tsam gyis phan gyi mi 'dug

/don de la mos pa la bsod nams kyi rgyu tshogs mang po dgos kyi yod pa red/ de lta bu'i mi mos skye bo blun po la sogs pa de tsho/ 'khor ba'i chu bos rtag tu 'khyer bar zad/ gsungs pa red/ rgyud bla ma'i nang la/ gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// gsungs pa red/ mtshams med lnga yi las bsags na'ang sdig pa byang yag yod gsungs song*/ mtshams med lnga yi las bsags pa de tsho la yang gnyen po bsten na sdig pa byang yag yod pa red/ de ga nang bzhin gyis srung sdom gyi dam tshig de tsho nyams song ba yin na'ang dper na sngags kyi skabs su 'gal 'das nyams ral thams cad kyang gnyen po stobs che chung gi steng nas sdig pa byang yag yod pa red/ chos 'dul ba'i nang la/ pham pa 'chab bcas tshe 'dir gsor mi rung*// 'chab med yin na dngos pa brjod pas 'dag /ces pham pa 'chab med de tsho yod na'ang dngos por brjod nas dag thub yag yod pa red/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi skabs su yang spyir btang nyes pa chen po mang po gsungs yod red de yin na yang mang che ba la gnyen po bsten nas dag thub yag gi thabs kyi rim pa mang po gsungs yod pa red/ yin na'ang de tsho la thar pa yod gsungs 'dug /gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// gsungs dus 'di'i skabs su chos de rgyud bla ma las ga re gsungs pa red zer na/ snying po'i don de gtso bo gsungs kyi yod red/ snying po'i don de lta bu dngos gnas drang gnas kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yid byed zhe 'dod thams cad dang bral ba tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya thub yag gi gdams ngag zab po de lta bu sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po de lta bu la mos pa ma byed nas de la dad log skye na thar pa med gsungs 'dug /gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// gsungs kyi yod red/ de nang bzhin 'khor ba'i chu bos rtag tu 'khyer bar zad/

'khor ba'i chu bo chen pos rtag tu 'khyer ba/ 'khor ba'i chu bo zer mkhan de 'gro ba rigs drug gi 'khor ba red pa/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi 'khor ba'i chu bo'i nang las dang nyon mongs pas rtag tu 'khyer ba/ rang dbang med par 'khyer ba red/ de yang dos drag la yun ring bar 'khyer ba red ma gtogs lo gcig gnyis kyi skad cha ma red/ 0000000000000255 ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzad blun po snying re rje// 00000000de nas mar 'gro yong dus dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro la sogs pa ngan song gi gnas la sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa sdug bsngal tshad med pa/ sdug bsngal dos drag pa/ sdug bsngal yun ring ba/ bar ma chad pa nyams su myong bar 'gyur gyi red gsungs pa red/ ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzad blun po snying re rje/ de 'dra'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa myong bsdad mkhan gyi blun po de tsho snying re rje gsungs pa red/ de rnams blun po red pa/ blun po los yin/ phyag rgya chen po'i don la yid la mi byed pa de 'dra'i chos skor bzang po de tsho la mi mos nas de tsho 'dra la log par blta na de blun po red pa/ blun po las kyang blun po thal che ba yin pa red/ de tsho la snying re rje gsungs pa red/ snying rje ba'i yul red/ snying rje ba'i gnas yin gsungs pa red pa/ phyag chen smon lam nang la/ 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu sangs rgyas kyang*// ma rtogs dbang gis mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams// gsungs 'dug /de dang gcig pa red/ 'gro ba'i rang bzhin kho rang tsho'i sems kyi gnas lugs la blta ba yin na sems kyi gnas lugs rtag tu sangs rgyas red ma gtogs sems can red yod ma red/ yin na yang sangs rgyas yin pa la yin par ngo ma shes yong dus ma rtogs dbang gis don med par 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por sbyor gyi gi yod red/ phyag chen smon lam nang la/
