sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i sems can la// bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog /gsungs 'dug /de 'dra po de la yang snying rje zer nas snying rje ba'i gnas de yin pa red/ 00000000 00000255 mi bzad thar 'dod bla ma mkhas la bsten// 00000000gsungs pa red/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal mi zad pa de 'dra yong gi yod dus de lta bu'i sdug bsngal de bzod kyi yod red pas zer na/ sdug bsngal de bzod thub kyi yod ma red/ sdug bsngal tshad med pa yod red/ sdug bsngal shugs chen po yod pa red/ de 'dra'i bzod mi thub pa'i sdug bsngal de las thar dgos kyi yod red pas zer na thar dgos kyi yod red/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dang bde ba 'dod mkhan sha stag red pa/ yin na yang thar dgos kyi 'dug nga thar dgos kyi 'dug zer nas skad brgyab bsdad pas phan gyi yod ma red/ thar bar byed pa la ga re dgos kyi yod red zer na thar bar bya ba'i ched du dang po mi lus rin po che thob dgos kyi 'dug /ma gtogs ngan song nas kha thug yar thar pa la 'gro thub yag yod ma red/ ngan song nas thar nas dang po mi lus yag po thob/ mi yul gyi skye ba blangs tshar ba'i mjug la mi lus kyang mi lus tsam po ba ma yin pa dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dam pa dang mjal/ gdams ngag bzang po nyams su len nas bla ma mkhas pa zhig la bsten nas 'di skabs su bla ma mkhas gsungs pa de sde snod gsum blo la sha ra ra 'don thub mkhan de 'dra zhig la bla ma mkhas pa gsungs kyi yod ma red/ 'o na ga re red zer na/ phyag gya chen po yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor zab mo de lta bu zhig la thos byung gi shes rab bsam byung gi shes rab sgom byung gi shes rab la brten nas the tshom gyi drwa ba ma lus pa chod nas rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol/ thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin thub pa zhig yod na de 'dra la bla ma mkhas pa yin gsungs kyi yod red/

rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin thub pa zhig gis rten 'brel lus la 'grigs/ rtogs pa sems la 'char zer yag cig yod red/ rten 'brel lus la 'grigs rtogs pa sems la 'char ba'i de lta bu'i bla ma zhig yod na de la bla ma mkhas pa gsungs kyi yod red ma gtogs sde snod gsum de blo la sha ra ra 'don thub pa zhig yin na'ang bla ma mkhas pa'i gras la 'gro gi ma red/ de 'dra yin dus rten 'brel lus la 'grigs/ rtogs pa sems la 'char/ de la brten nas rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol/ thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin pa'i bla ma zhig yod na de la bla ma mkhas pa gsungs kyi yod red/ bla ma mkhas pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa zhig la bsten dgos pa red/ de lta bu'i bla ma mkhas pa dag la bsten zhing bsten tshar na/

00000000 00000255 byin rlabs snying la zhugs na rang sems grol bar 'gyur/ ༈ /13/ 00000000gsungs pa red/ de 'dra'i bla ma de'i byin rlabs de rang gi sems la zhugs na phyag rgya chen po rtogs thub kyi red gsungs 'dug /byin rlabs kyis grol dgos kyi yod red/ byin rlabs zer mkhan de dgos kyi yod red/ rdo rje 'chang 'thung ma'i nang la/ mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor gsungs pa bzhin/ man ngag gter sgo 'byed pa'i bla ma la// rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgom chen la// bcos min mos gus skye bar byin gyis rlobs// gsungs 'dug /mos gus zer mkhan de gal chen po yin pa red/ 'jig rten mgon po'i 'bri gung lnga ldan mgur nang la/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la// mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas// sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces mos gus la nan tan chen po gnang 'dug /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya'o// bsnyen bkur bar bya'o// de la dad par bya'o gsungs 'dug /dad pa dgos pa red/ rgyud bla ma nang la yang*/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam de// dad pa nyid kyi rtogs bya yin// zhes gsungs pa de rang byung nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang mthar thug don dam pa'i gnas tshul rtogs yag la dad pa yin gcig min gnyis dgos kyi yod gsungs pa red pa/ dad pa dang mos gus gnyis bar la khyad par tog tsam yod red/ dad pa zer mkhan de spyi btang mthun mong gi sgo nas yid ches pa tsam la dad pa zer gyi yod red/ mos gus zer mkhan de bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su thag chod nas bzang na'ang legs po zhig byung na'ang bla ma kho rang gi thugs rjes yin/ ngan pa zhig yin byung na'ang bla ma kho rang gi red ma gtogs ci mdzad khyed shes ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin thub pa zhig byung ba yin na de la mos gus lab pa red/

mos gus thang lhod med pa dper na rje btsun nā ro pas tai lo pa la ga 'dra bsten 'dug /de 'dra po zhig yin na de la mos gus zhes lab pa red/ de dad pa las kyang zhe drag zab kyi yod pa red/ bla ma mkhas la bsten/ de 'dra la byin rlabs dang mos gus gnyis yod na byin rlabs snying la zhugs kyi 'dug /tai lo pas kyang*/ tai lo nga la ci yang bstan du med// rang gis rang nyid mthong na grol bar 'gyur// gsungs nas mchil l+h+wam gyi rdog pa bsnun yong dus gcig brgyal song ba red/ brgyal ba las sangs yong dus tai lo pas thugs rgyud la yod pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad nā ro pa'i snying la tshwa tshwa'i par btab pa ltar thams cad shar ba yin gsungs 'dug /de tsho 'dra po de gtso bo byin rlabs la brten nas yong gi yod pa red/ byin rlabs zer mkhan de yang spyi btang nga tshos de ga tsam nga la phyag dbang zhig gnang rogs/ zhus nas bla mas nga tsho'i mgo la phyag bzhag pa tsam zhig gis yong gi yod sa ma red/ gang red zer na bla ma'i ngos nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang slob ma'i ngos nas snod dang ldan pa zhig de gnyis rten 'brel 'grigs yong dus thod pa thug nas skal pa dang las 'phrod sad pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ de ma gtogs de ga tsam gyis yong gi ma red/ nga tshos da lta sngags kyi skabs su yo byad cho ga de tsho'i nang la me tog gtor yong dus me tog phog pa'i lha skal zer gyi 'dug /tshe rabs snga ma rnams su las 'phro yod pa'i me tog zhig phog dgos kyi red ma gtogs de ga tsam zur la badz+ra mahā su kha zer na'ang 'grig gi mi 'dug /las 'phro dgos kyi yod red las dang skal pa ldan pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ de yang las dang skal pa la 'brel pa zhig yod dgos kyi yod red/ gang yin de la phog par shog zer ga byed kyi 'dug /gang yin de la phog par shog zer na ga re red/ dper na tshe rabs sngon ma la so so'i las dang skal pa dang 'brel ba yod bsdad mkhan gyi yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa de la phog par shog gsungs kyi 'dug

/yi dam gyi lha la yang las dang skal pa yod dgos kyi yod na mi la los dgos/ mi'i bla ma la nges par du dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus byin rlabs snying la zhugs zer ba de 'dra red ma gtogs byin rlabs snying la zhugs zer nas thod pa gtugs na'ang phan gyi ma red/ gzungs thag rdo rje zhig 'dzin nas snying la de 'dra gtug bsdad na'ang phan gyi ma red/ de ga tsam byin rlabs 'dra po de kha la 'thung nas byin rlabs snying la zhugs yag yod ma red/ byin rlabs yag shos de ga re red zer na byin rlabs de rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol/ thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin pa zhig gi steng nas rang yang bsod nams kyi rgyu tshogs mtha' yas pa dang brtson 'grus stobs che ba de bzhin du shes rab rtsal che ba de 'dra zhig yod pa yin na de gnyis las 'phro thug yong dus byin rlabs snying la zhugs zer yag de red/ spyir btang dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la// skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye zhing*// ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis// bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /zer nas bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug stangs de la rgyu mtshan de'i steng nas bshad 'dug /rnam par thar pa la skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye lab pa red/ bla ma'i mdzad pa ji ltar bstan na'ang*// ngo mtshar mos pas rtag tu mchod byed cing*// bya ba kun la gzhan skyon mi rtog pa// phan pa'i 'du shes rtag tu rnyed gyur cig /gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis rang gi bla ma des yag sdug ga re gnang song ba yin na yang de thams cad gdul bya 'dul ba'i dgos pa/ sems can 'dul ba'i dgos pa rang red bsam dgos kyi red ma gtogs kho rang ngos nas skyon yod na'ang khyad par gang yang med red/ yin na yang rang nyid lam sbyong mkhan yin pa yin dus rang nyid kyi mthong snang la de 'dra po de gdul bya 'dul ba'i dgos pa red/

mi bsad na'ang gdul bya 'dul ba'i dgos pa red/ chang a rag 'thung na'ang gdul bya 'dul ba'i dgos pa red/ tha na bzhad mo zhig shor na'ang 'dul bya 'dul ba'i dgos pa red ces bsam blo gtang dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra'i bsam blo btang yong dus bla ma dam pa la log lta mi skye zhing ci mdzad legs par mthong*/ ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin de'i steng nas bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug dgos pa red 'dug /de ma gtogs bla mas byams po gnang ba'i skabs su bla ma la mos gus skye/ bla mas tog tsam bka' bkyon gnang yong dus bla ma la ma dga' ba de 'dra byed na de mos gus tha mal pa lab pa red/ de mi yong ba red/ nga rang tsho la dpe bzhag sa yag po yod red pa/ nā ro pas tai lo pa la ga 'dras bsten 'dug /de ga nang bzhin gyis mar pas nā ro pa la ga 'dras bsten 'dug /mar pa la mi la ras pas ga 'dra bsten 'dug /mi la ras pa la dwags po lha rjes ga 'dra bsten 'dug /brgyud pa'i zam ma chad pa'i dpe yag po yod pa red/ phreng ba brgyud pa nang bzhin byed nas 'phel bsdad yod red la de thams cad kyang gtso bo tshig gi brgyud pa ma red don gyi brgyud pa red/ don brgyud kyi byin rlabs de yang gtso bo de rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin pa'i steng nas don rgyud de yong dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs de ga tsam lung zhig 'don/ khrid cig brgyab bsdad pa tsam gyis phan nus stobs chen yong gi yod ma red/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyis de 'dra'i steng nas yong dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs na rang sems grol bar 'gyur gsungs pa red/ de 'dra'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas byin rlabs snying la zhugs yong ba red/ byin rlabs snying la zhugs yong dus rang sems grol gyi yod red gsungs pa red/ rang gi sems grol ba'am rang gi sems de thob pa'am rtogs thub pa byung ba yong gi red gsungs pa red/

phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ gang ltar don dag de rang gi sems 'di ma rig pa'i rdul las grol thub kyi red/ rang gi sems de 'dzin pa dang zhen pa las grol thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'dzin zhen gyi rtog pa phra rags thams cad las grol thub kyi red gsungs pa red/00000000 16711680 de snying po'i don bstan pa/ 00000000 00000000 00000255 kye ho 'khor ba'i chos 'di don med sdug bsngal rgyu// byas pa'i chos la snying po med pas don ldan snying po ltos// gzung 'dzin kun 'das lta ba'i rgyal po yin// yengs pa med na sgom pa'i rgyal po yin// bya rtsol med na spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// re dwogs med na 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ ༈ /14/ 00000000 zhes gsungs pa red/ dang po la/ kye ho 'khor ba'i chos 'di don med sdug bsngal rgyu// byas pa'i chos la snying po med pas don ldan snying po ltos// zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis la 'grel pa brgyab na/ 'di'i skabs su/ kye ho 'khor ba'i chos 'di don med sdug bsngal rgyu// zhes pa de mdor na kye ho zer ba'i skabs su 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de dos drag la yun ring ba/ don med par de tsam du myong bsdad pa gzigs yong dus snying rje'i shugs kyis ma bzod yong dus smre ngag gi 'o dod 'bod pa red 'dug /kye ho zer dus a kha kha zer yag 'dra po/ ga re byed nas snying rje dgos pa red/ snying rje dgos yag gi rgyu mtshan ga re red zer na/ 'khor ba'i chos de don med kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgyu red 'dug /'khor ba'i chos zer ba'i nang la zag bcas kyi dge ba'ang bsdus dgos kyi yod red/ de ma gtogs 'khor ba'i chos zer yong dus yin gcig min gnyis 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug de kho rang la bsam blo btang yag med pa red/ zag bcas kyi dge ba cha tshang red/ gang zhen pa dang bcas pa'i chos yin na de thams cad de 'khor ba'i chos nang la 'gro gi yod red/

'das zer ba'i skabs su de las phar song ba/ de nas phar phyin pa/ dmigs pa'i yul gyi nang la 'jug rgyu med pa red/ dmigs pa'i yul las 'das dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra'i dmigs pa'i yul de dag thams cad las 'das na spyir btang nga tshos dus rgyun lha bsgom pa dang sngags bgrang ba gcig pu la bzhag na 'grig gi mi 'dug /dper na stong pa nyid bsgom pa yin na'ang 'grig gi yod red/ stong nyid sgom pa'i skabs su stong nyid la mtshan mar 'dzin na dmigs pa'i yul chags 'gro ba red pa/ stong nyid la mtshan mar 'dzin pa/ mi rtag pa la mtshan mar 'dzin pa/ bdag med pa la mtshan mar 'dzin pa/ de ga nang bzhin gyis stong nyid bcu drug la sogs pa la mtshan mar 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yon tan gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ phrin las gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la yang 'dzin pa chags song na dmigs pa chags 'gro ba red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus de 'dra'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba mtha'i 'dzin stangs rags pa la bshad ci dgos te mtha'i 'dzin stangs phra ba las kyang 'das dgos pa red 'dug /de la brten nas dmigs pa'i yul las 'das gsungs pa red/ de 'dra'i dmigs pa'i yul de dag thams cad las 'das na sems kyi rang bzhin gsal gsungs pa red/ sems kyi rang bzhin zer ba de'i skabs su la gang red/ dmigs pa med pa la go dgos pa red/ dmigs pa med pas rang bzhin gsal thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ dmigs pa med pa'i lta ba/ dmigs pa med pa'i sgom pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i nyams len/ dmigs pa med pas lha bsgom yag /dmigs pa med pas sngags bzla yag /dmigs pa med pas stong pa nyid bsgom yag /dmigs pa med pas byang chub kyi sems bsgom yag /dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje/

dmigs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa bsgom yag de tsho tshang ma sems kyi rang bzhin 'di'i skabs su dmigs med gsungs pa red/ dmigs pa med pa'i don de gsal ba yin dus sems kyi rang bzhin gsungs pa red/ sems kyi rang bzhin sems kyi gnas lugs gsungs pa 'dra po la go rgyu ma yin pa 'di'i skabs su sems kyi rang bzhin gsungs pa'i skabs su dmigs pa'i yul las 'das yong dus dmigs pa med pa la gnas pa red 'dug /chos nyid rnam 'byed nang la/ dmigs pa yi ni sbyor ba dang*// mi dmigs pa yi sbyor ba dang*// dmigs pa mi dmigs sbyor ba dang*// mi dmigs dmigs pa'i sbyor ba'o// zhes sbyor ba bzhi gsungs yod red/ 'di'i skabs su sems kyi rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i sbyor ba red/ sems kyi rang bzhin dmigs pa med pa'i don dam pa'i gnas lugs/ dmigs pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi mthar thug /dmigs pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi gnas lugs gang yin pa de gsal ba'am de mngon du 'gyur ba yin na gsal zhes gsungs pa red/ gsal zer yag de gsal po yod zer ba la ma yin pa de mngon du 'gyur ba nyams su myong ba yang dag par nges pa yang dag par nyams su myong ba yang dag pa'i gnas la slebs pa de la rang bzhin gsal gsungs pa red/ de 'dra yin dus sems kyi rang bzhin ga re red sems kyi rang bzhin dmigs pa med pa red/ dmigs pa'i yul thams cad las 'das yong dus dmigs pa med pa la slebs kyi red/ dang po dmigs pa yod red/ dmigs pa yod pa la man ngag bzang pos bcings dmigs pa med pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum la nges shes 'drong yong dus dmigs pa med pa la slebs song ba red 'dug /zhi ba lhas/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa// de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pa// dmigs pa med pa rab tu zhi// gsungs pa lta bu'o/ des na sems kyi rang bzhin gsal gsungs pa'i skabs la sems kyi rang bzhin dmigs pa med pa'i don de gsal po yong gi red/

de gsal yong dus gzhi'i skabs su dmigs pa'i yul las 'das nas sems kyi rang bzhin gsal yong dus lam gyi skabs su/ bgrod ba'i lam med sangs rgyas lam sna zin/ gsungs 'dug /gzhi'i skabs su de 'dra po zhig gis gsal 'debs dgos kyi yod red/ gzhi'i skabs su de 'dra'i gnas lugs la ngo 'phrod dgos pa red/ gzhi'i skabs su de 'dra po'i gnas lugs la btsan sa zin dgos pa red/ de 'dra'i btsan sa zin nas/ bgrod ba'i lam med sangs rgyas lam sna zin// de 'dra'i dmigs pa med pa'i don de gsal por nyams su myong thub na de nas bgrod pa'i lam yod ma red/ bgrod pa'i lam zer dus 'di'i skabs su lam de ga ba la go dgos pa red zer na/ theg pa chung ngu'i lam/ theg pa chen po byang chub sems dpa'i lam la sogs gang la yang mi go pa red/ theg pa che chung gi lam dang lam lnga la sogs pa gang yang dgos kyi ma red gsungs 'dug /bgrod pa'i lam dgos kyi ma red/ bgrod pa'i lam med gsungs 'dug /bgrod pa'i lam thams cad las 'das gsungs pa la lam med gsungs pa red ma gtogs spyir bgrod pa'i lam med gsungs pa ma red/ bgrod pa'i lam med zer dus bgrod pa'i lam las pha rol du son pa/ bgrod pa'i lam las 'das gsungs pa red/ de la brten nas bgrod pa'i lam med zer nas gzhi bye brag pa zhig la sbyar dgos pa red ma gtogs spyi yong gi thog nas bgrod pa'i lam yod ma red zer na skur ba btab 'gro gi red pa/ yin na yang bgrod pa'i lam med zer dus gzhi ga 'dra zhig la sbyar nas bshad kyi yod zer dus gzhi de dmigs pa med pa'i btsan sa zin na/ de 'dra'i rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag la bgrod pa'i lam las 'das pa yin gsungs pa red/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ sgom pa po med bsgom bya med// bgrod bya sa dang lam yang med// 'bras bu sku dang ye shes med// de phyir mya ngan 'das pa med// gsungs 'dug

/de'i skabs la med med gsungs pa de ga re red/ spyir med zer nas gsungs pa ma yin pa/ gzhi bye brag pa zhig la sbyar dgos pa red/ su'i ngo la med pa red zer nas spyir btang de bshad dgos pa red/ su'i ngo la lam med pa red/ su'i ngo la 'bras bu med pa red zer nas bshad yong dus de 'dra ba'i dmigs pa'i lta ba dang dmigs pa'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa mtha' dag las 'das nas dmigs pa med pa'i gnas lugs de kho na nyid khong du chud zin pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i gnas lugs gang yin pa de nyid yang dag par nges zin pa'i rgyud ldan gyi gang zag la gzhi dang lam 'bras bu la sogs pa med gsungs kyi yod red/ 'o de 'dra byed nas ltos gzhi gcig la sbyar nas yod med kyi mtshams 'dzin de bshad dgos pa red ma gtogs spyir yod pa dang med pa zer nas bshad bzhag na lta ba bshad shes yag med pa red/ lhag par du dbu ma'i skabs su 'di dgag bya chen po yod pa red/ de yin dus ma brtag ma dpyad pa'i gnas skabs/ cung zad dpyad pa'i gnas skabs/ shin tu dpyad pa'i gnas skabs zer yag gi gnas skabs gsum gyi rang bzhin de dbu ma'i skabs su zhe drag rtsa ba chen po gsungs bsdad kyi yod red/ da lta phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gi lugs la yang spyir btang gi lta ba'i yul las 'das pa dang spros pa'i yul las 'das pa dang mtshan 'dzin gyi yul las 'das pa zer mkhan de tsho thams cad kyang spyir lta thog nas bshad bsdad pa 'dra po ma yin pa/ lta ba rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de lta bu de la yang dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum yod pa dang dbang po rab de la dmigs pa'i yul las 'das nas dmigs med kyi btsan sa zin/ de 'dra ba la gzhi lam 'bras gsum dgos kyi ma red gsungs pa'i skad cha de 'dra zhig gis steng nas 'gro dgos kyi red/ go rim de 'dra po zhig nges pa'i thog nas 'gro dgos pa red ma gtogs phyag rgya chen po nyams len byed mkhan tshang ma la lta sgom spyod gsum yod ma red zer bzhag na yong gi ma red pa/

'di ha cang thal che ba'i skyon yong gi yod red/ bgrod pa'i lam med sangs rgyas lam sna zin/ de yin dus bgrod pa'i lam theg pa chung ngu la sogs pa dang theg pa 'bring dang theg pa chen po la sogs pa gang yang med pa red/ lam lnga dang sa bcu la sogs pa de tsho yang ma dgos pa red/ mi las/ phyag rgya chen po cig chod la// rmongs pas sa lam brtsi ba 'khrul// gsungs pa ltar/ phyag rgya chen po zer yag de lam cig chod red gsungs pa red/ gang red zer na dbang po yang rab kyi nyams len red/ dbang po rim gyis pa ma red/ cig char ba red/ shes rab cig char ba dang dbang po cig char ba'i nyams len yin pa yin dus phyag rgya chen po zer yag de cig chod red/ gnas lugs gcig rtogs song na chos thams cad khong du chud tshar ba red/ rim pa bzhin du sa bcu lam lnga zer nas brtsi ma dgos pa red/ des na rmongs pas sa lam brtsi ba 'khrul ba red gsungs pa red/ des na bgrod pa'i lam med gsungs yag de 'di'i steng nas 'gro dgos kyi 'dug /bgrod pa'i lam theg pa chung ngu la sogs pa thams cad med pa/ sangs rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i lam sna zin cing lam sna zin tshar dus sangs rgyas pa'i lam tshad ma de zin thub kyi yod red/ lam sna zin pa'am sangs rgyas pa'i lam la 'gro thub pa/ sangs rgyas pa'i lam la btsan sa zin thub pa/ sangs rgyas zer ba de spyir btang nga rang tshos mang che ba zhig gi bsam blo nang la sangs rgyas zer dus dbu la gtsug gtor zhabs la 'khor lo yod mkhan zhig la yin gcig min gnyis dmigs pa 'dra po zhig bsam blo btang dgos pa de ma dgos pa red 'dug /sangs rgyas zer yag de gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur na sangs rgyas yin pa red/ gnas lugs mngon du ma gyur ba'i skabs su sems can zer gyi yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus sems kyi gnas lugs la btsan sa zin nas sems don ngo 'phrod na sangs rgyas red/

sems don ngo ma 'phrod pa'i gnas skabs na sems can red/ de 'dra zhig gi khyad par ma gtogs yin gcig min gnyis sangs rgyas zer ba'i skabs su dbu la gtsug gtor zhabs la 'khor lo yod mkhan zhig ma dgos pa red/ sangs rgyas zer yag de/ rje sku tshe gcig la sangs rgyas nas// mtshan thos tshad thar pa'i lam sna 'dren// zer dus rje btsun mi la ras pa lta bu yin na tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa de lta bu red/ bsgom pa'i yul med goms na bla med byang chub 'thob/ ༈ /sgom du med pa yin dus bsgom pa'i yul med gsungs pa red/ bsgom rgyu'i chos yod ma red pa/ bsgom rgyu'i chos de 'dra zhig yod red/ bsgom par bya rgyu'i chos de 'dra zhig yod red/ dper na/ bsgom rgyu phyag rgya chen po 'dra po zhig bshad pa yin na phyag rgya chen po zer yag de 'di 'dra zhig yod red/ rdzogs pa chen po zer yag de 'di 'dra zhig yod red/ dbu ma chen po zer yag de 'di 'dra zhig yod red zer nas bshad dgos na bshad rgyu med pa red/ mtha' thams cad las 'das pa yin pa red/ yul dang yul can gyi spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhi'i dbyings na de 'dra'i bsgom pa'i yul med pa red/ des na sgom du med pa'i yul med pa de nyid bsgom na sgom du med pa red/ sgom du med yong dus bsgom yag kho rang med na bsgom pa'i yul yong gi ma red pa/ bsgom rgyu zhig yod na bsgom pa'i yul yong gi red ma gtogs sgom zhes bya ba kho rang yang rtog pas btags tsam rten cing 'brel bar 'byung tsam red ma gtogs don la bsgom pa med pa ha go thub kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus rig pas dpyad nas stong nyid du song ba dang rig pas dpyad nas sgom du med pa 'dra po zhig la khas len pa ma yin pa/ gang zag dbang po dang shes rab rno ba thams cad kyis bla ma'i man ngag la phur tshugs su bsgom yong dus rang gi tshe rabs snga ma'i chos la sbyang pa chen po yod bsdad yag gi las 'phro de sad yong dus gnas lugs kyi btsan sa zin pa dang gnas lugs ngo 'phrod yong ba red/

de 'dra'i gnas lugs ngo 'phrod yong dus bsgom du med pa'i gnas lugs de rtogs thub kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra ma gtogs re re bzhin du rigs pa btang nas rig pa des bsgom du med pa'i rgyu mtshan de 'dra red/ bsgom ma dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de 'dra red zer nas bshad ma dgos pa yin pa red/ lung dang rigs pa la brten ma dgos pa red/ spyir lung dang rigs pa la bsten dgos kyi yod red de phyag rgya chen po gcig chos la lung dang rigs pa la brten ma dgos pa red/ des na bsgom pa'i yul med pa/ sgom med na bsgom pa'i yul med pa red/ de 'dra'i bsgom pa med pa dang bsgom pa'i yul med pa de gnyis la yang nas yang du goms thub na bla med byang chub 'thob thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'di gsungs pa'i don dag des ga re go gi 'dug zer na/ sgom brgyab mkhan/ brgyab rgyu'i bsgom/ bsgom pa'i yul bcas la 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pas 'dzin na bsgom pa ma red gsungs 'dug /des bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang 'thob kyi med pas bsgom pa'i yul thams cad las 'das dgos pa red/ de 'dra yin dus phyag rgya chen po'i rnam 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi thog nas bshad yong dus rtse gcig spros bral ro gcig gsum po de mthar phyin pa'i skabs su sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sa gsungs kyi 'dug /sgom med zer yag de sangs rgyas kyi sa la zer gyi yod red ma gtogs sgom yod chos sku'i rgyal sa gsungs kyi mi 'dug /sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sa bsgom du med pa'am bsgom bya sgom byed stor te thal// zhes rje btsun mi la ras pas gsungs pa de tsho gcig pa red/ snga ma 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma zhig gis lo gsum phyogs gsum sgrub khang la bzhug gi yin gsungs nas brag phug nang du phebs te bzhugs pa'i skabs su zhag po gcig bzhugs nas phyir bud yong ba red/

khyed lo gsum phyogs gsum bzhugs ma song ba gang red zer dris dus/ nga lo gsum phyogs gsum la bsdad grabs byas pa yin te cung zad cig bsgoms pas lo gsum zer yag de yang ming tsam red 'dug rtog btags red 'dug /lo gsum la bsgom brgyab zer dus sgom zhes bya ba de yang tha snyad red ma gtogs don la bsgom bya sgom byed gang yang med pa'i gnas lugs gcig ngo 'phrod song*/ des na phyir don yong ba yin gsungs pa red/ 'o de lta bu red 'dug /des na bsgom pa'i yul med goms na zer ba de gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus de 'dra zhig go dgos pa red/ rje btsun mi la ras pas kyang*/ bsgom bya sgom byed stor te thal// gsungs pa red/ bsgom par bya rgyu'i chos kyang med/ sgom mkhan gyi sems kyang med/ gang gi ched du bsgom pa gsum ga med pa dmigs pa med par rtogs yong dus bsgom pa'i yul med gsungs pa red/ mi bsgom pa'i sgom pa chen po zer yag yang don 'di red/ goms na bla med byang chub thob zer na de 'dra po'i bsgom bya dang sgom byed bsgom pa'i yul gsum ka yang rang bzhin med pa dang dmigs pa med pa la nges pa drangs thub pa yin na de la brten nas mthar thug gi bde ba bla na med pa'i byang chub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob kyi red gsungs pa red/ des na gzhi'i skabs su dmigs pa'i yul las 'das pa/ lam gyi skabs su bgrod pa'i lam las 'das pa/ 'bras bu'i skabs su bsgom pa'i yul med na byang chub 'thob kyi red/ des na 'di'i don de gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum la sbyar nas gsungs pa red/00000000 16711680

de nyams su ji ltar len tshul gdams pa ni/ 00000000 0000000000000255 kye ma 'jig rten chos la legs rtog dang*// brtag mi thub ste rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra// rmi lam sgyu ma don la yod ma yin// des na skyo ba bskyed la 'jig rten bya ba thongs// 'khor yul chags sdang 'brel pa kun chod la// gcig pur nags 'dabs ri khrod gnas par sgoms// sgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis// 00000000kye ma zer na mya ngan gyi brda red/ nga rang phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs la mngon du 'gyur tshar ba'i skabs su de lta bu ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la snying rje yag de chos nyid kyi gshis yin pa red/ spyir btang nga tshos stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel gyi nyams len bshad yong ba'i skabs su stong nyid la brten nas snying rje skye ba dang snying rje la brten nas stong nyid skye ba de gnyis 'brel ba chen po yod bsdad pa red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus phal che ba zhig gis stong nyid la brten nas snying rje skye ba de shugs che ba gsungs kyi yod pa red/ dang po stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba sngon du 'gro nas de nas snying rje rang bzhin gyis skye gi red gsungs kyi 'dug /chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa de stong pa nyid red/ stong pa nyid yin pa la rang gis nges shes skyes zin nas rang gnas lugs stong pa nyid la nges shes drangs tshar ba red de yin na yang gnas lugs stong pa nyid yin pa ha go tshar ba la de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad de rnams a tsi de 'dra'i gnas lugs stong pa nyid dang gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len de la do snang skye gi mi 'dug /de tsho gnas lugs dang rgyab 'gal gnas lugs dang phyin ci log tu gyur pa sha stag red 'dug /de thams cad la snying rje bsam nas snying rje yang dag pa zhig skye yong ba red/ de ma gtogs kho mgo na gi 'dug snying rje zer na snying rje 'di yang dag pa zhig chags kyi med zer ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di red pa/

kho la dpal 'byor mi 'dug dpal 'byor sprad dgos kyi red zer na snying rje tsam po ba red/ gnas skabs kyi sdug bsngal dang gnas skabs 'phral sel gyi sdug bsngal tsam sel ched du snying rje de snying rje tsam po ba red/ snying rje 'di dang stong nyid la 'brel ba gang yang med pa red/ snying rje de snying rje rang mtshan pa chags 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa red/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min/ nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can// de yang 'jig tshogs lta ba yin// zhes rnam 'grel tshad grub le'u las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis byams pa dang snying rje stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang 'gal ba gang yang yod ma red pa/ da lta 'di'i skabs su stong nyid rtogs pa'i nges shes la brten nas snying rje skye yong ba de 'dra'i snying rje dang stong nyid gnyis zung 'brel chags yong ba red/ de yin dus da lta 'di'i skabs su rang phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs de phyin ci ma log pa yang dag par rtogs zin nas de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad la snying re rje zer 'dug /da lta bde mchog gi cho ga'i nang gzhal yas khang bskyed yong dus/ chos kyi chos nyid ma rtogs 'khor ba la// bdag gis chos nyid mngon du gyur nas kyang*// zab mo'i de bzhin nyid don rtogs par bya'o// zhes gsungs 'dug /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas red de chos kyi chos nyid ma rtogs nas 'khor ba la 'khor bsdad pa red/ da res ngas lam bzang po de 'dra ba'i bde mchog he ru ka'i rgyud la yod pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don la brtson yong dus de'i stobs kyis sems can thams cad kyi zab mo de bzhin nyid khong du chud thub pa zhig byed kyi yin bsam nas dang po sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro nas de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed yong gi 'dug /spyir btang rgyud sde kho rang la yang 'gro stangs de 'dra bsam blo btang yong dus kyai ma zer nas gsungs pa red/

de ma gtogs de snyan ngag 'dra po de 'dra gang yang ma red pa/ 'jig rten chos la legs rtog dang*/ gsungs 'dug /'jig rten zer yag de spyir btang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig la go dgos pa red/ 'jig rten zer ba'i skabs su bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtha' yas pa/ blos 'jal ma thub pa zhig la 'jig rten zer gyi yod red/ de yin na'ang 'di'i skabs su 'jig rten zer yag de 'khor ba'i bya ba la go dgos pa red/ dgra 'dul yag gnyen skyong yag ming gtam snyan grags thob mnga' thang gzi brjid la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bya ba mang po yod red/ tshur bsdus yong ba'i skabs su chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rnam rtog gsum gyi nang la 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad bsdus yong dus 'khor ba'i 'jig rten zer mkhan de la go dgos kyi yod red/ 'khor ba 'jig rten gyi chos zer yag gi 'jig rten gyi chos de ga re red/ dgra 'dul yag dang gnyen skyong ba la sogs pa chags sdang gi rnam par rtog pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu rang la rang dbang med pa chags sdang gi gzhan dbang gis khol por song nas dus rtag tu kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pas mnar/ de'i 'bras bu khams gsum la sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong bsdad yag de 'jig rten gyi chos red pa/ de 'dra'i 'jig rten gyi chos la legs par rtog dang zer ba'i skabs su rtog zer yag de ga re red/ brtag dpyad yag po gtong dang gsungs pa red/ brtag dpyad btang thub kyi red pas zer na/ brtag mi thub ste rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra// brtag mi thub ste gsungs 'dug /brtag mi thub zer na/ brtag dpyad btang thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ brtag thub yag med pa red/ 'jig rten chos de tsho thams cad la brtag thub yag med pa red/ gang red zer na brtag nas rnyed yong yag med de ji tsam ji tsam 'jig rten pa'i chos la brtag cing dpyad na de tsam de tsam 'jig rten gyi chos de la sob sob ya ma brla snying po med par mthong thub kyi yod pa red/

brtag mi thub pa yin pa la brten nas dbu ma'i skabs su kun rdzob pa'i chos de rigs pas dpyad bzod pa ma yin gsungs 'dug /kun rdzob pa'i chos de rigs pas dpyad mi bzod pa red/ kun rdzob pa'i chos la rigs pas dpyad dgos kyi yang ma red gsungs pa red/ kun rdzob kyi chos la gal srid rigs pas dpyad pa yin na/ kun rdzob kyi chos de dpyad don rnyed rgyu med pa red/ de 'dra yin dus kun rdzob kyi chos de rig pas dpyad mi bzod pa yin pa red/ rigs pas brtag mi thub pa yin pa red/ des na/ ji ltar khyod kyis gzhan dbang dngos 'dod ltar// kun rdzob kyang ni bdag gis khas ma blangs// 'bras phyir 'di dag med kyang yod do zhes// 'jig rten ngor byas bdag ni smra bar byed// zhes gsungs pa red/ chos thams cad gzhan ngor khas len pa dbu ma'i skabs su gsungs bsdad pa de da lta 'di'i skabs dngos gnas gcig pa red 'dug /'jig rten gyi bya ba 'di'i steng nas bshad yong dus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams la sprul/ 'jig rten gyi khams la mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa bstan/ 'jig rten gyi khams la cho 'phrul dang mdzad pa phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang ba tshang ma gzhan ngor khas len yin pa red/ mthong tshul 'jig rten gyi ngor yin pa red/ de la don dam pa'i rigs pa gtso bo bshad yong dus don dam pa'i gnas lugs de dbang btsan po byed nas bshad yong dus 'jig rten bya ba thams cad brtag thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ de ga nang bzhin dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la/ gal te de nyid rnam par bshad pa na// gzhan gzhung 'jig par 'gyur na nyes pa med// gsungs 'dug /gal te de nyid rnam par bshad pa na// zer na don dam pa'i bden pa dbang btsan pa byed nas bshad yong dus de lta bu'i don dam pa'i bden pa dbang btsan pa bshad yong ba'i chos de lta bu 'di 'jig rten pa'i chos dang sgo mthun thabs rtsa ba nyid nas yong gi ma red/

don dam pa'i bden pa gtso bo bshad yong dus de dbang btsan par bzhag nas kun rdzob kyi chos dang mthun pa zhig dus nam yang yong thub kyi ma red/ kun rdzob kyi chos dang phyin ci log pa sha stag 'gro gi red/ ga 'dra 'gro yi red zer na/ 'jig rten gyi ngor kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad de bden pa yin pa/ kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad de rang bzhin yod pa/ kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad de rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ don dam pa'i bden pa de dbang btsan pa bshad yong dus de dag thams cad brtag mi thub yong dus rang gi ngo bo ma grub pa/ rgyu ma dmigs pa 'bras bu ma dmigs pa ngo bo ma dmigs pa gsum gyi thog nas bshad yong dus kun rdzob bden pa de brtag mi thub pa yin pa red/ 'o de dang gcig pa red/ brtag mi thub ste zer na sems kyi rtsa ba dpyad yong dus 'jig rten pa'i chos de thams cad brtag thub kyi ma red/ ga re red zer na/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad de sems kyis sprul pa yin pa red/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad de sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa red/ ji tsam ji tsam phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len gyi steng nas sems la rtsad bdar bcad yong dus de tsam de tsam gyis 'khor ba'i chos thams cad de tsho snying po med pa mthong thub yag gi rgyu mtshan 'di red 'dug /de ma gtogs sems de tshur bzhag nas kha phyir blta kho nas dkar yol de bden pa red pas/ dkar yol de bden pa ma red/ ces pa lta bu kha phyi la blta nas dpyad pa kho nas khungs chod kyi ma red la des lam bgrod thub kyi ma red pa/ da lta 'di'i skabs su spyir btang dbu ma nang bzhin bshad kyi ma red/ dbu ma'i skabs su yin na rigs pas chos thams cad kyi steng la phar bsam blo zhig btang nas dpyad bsdad pa red ma gtogs dang po sems nyid rtsad bcad de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa red zer nas de bshad kyi mi 'dug

/da lta 'di'i skabs su rnal 'byor pas sems nyid rtsad bdar bcad pa red/ sems kyi rtsad bdar bcad yong dus/ sgro 'dogs sems la chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// zhes tshig kho rang la dang po 'di bshad yong gi yod red/ de'i don sgro 'dogs sems la chod zin pa'i rnal 'byor pa de yis 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs shar bsdad pa de tsho sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa dang sems kyi rang rtsal yin pa/ de dag thams cad brtag mi dgos pa yin pa/ de dag thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa/ de dag thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa/ de dag thams cad la ngo bo med pa rgyu med pa 'bras bu med pa thog nas bsam pa thams cad de dang po sgro 'dogs sems la chod/ sems kyi rtsad bdar bcad tshar nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa nges thub pa yin pa red 'dug /dbu ma'i skabs su chos can bye brag pa re re'i steng la yang stong pa nyid re re sbyar nas bshad bsdad pa'i skabs shig yod red/ dbang po yang rab kyi skabs su yin na ni dang po nas gzung ba'i yul rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa/ des na 'dzin pa'i sems kyang ma grub/ de'i phyir na yul yul can gnyis ka rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas na rnal 'byor pa thams cad de chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa yin zer nas lam so so nas gsungs kyi yod pa red/ phyag rgya chen po lam cig chod yin dus dang po nas sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zer yag de tsho thams cad sems snang kho rang steng nas ngo sprod nas gsungs yong gi 'dug /dang po nas rang gi sems la ltos/ rang gi sems la rtsad bdar chod/ rang gi sems la sgro 'dogs chod/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo la ltos gsungs yong dus sems kyi ngo bo la blta yag dang sems la rtsad bdar bcad pa de sems don gyi man ngag mkhan po de tshos man ngag bshad yong dus sems kho rang gi steng nas byung 'ong 'gro sogs la brtag dpyad btang nas sems kyi rtsad bdar bcad pas sems kyi ngo bo de mthong yong dus 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs shar yag de sems kyi rang rtsal yin pa de ngo shes/

'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa de sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa la nges shes rnyed/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa de sems kyi phar btags bzhag pa dang*/ sems kyi rang rtsal yin pa la ngo shes yong dus 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la brtag mi thub pa red zer yag gi rgyu mtshan de 'di nas nges dgos pa red/ de yin tsang dbu ma'i skabs su 'gro stangs tog tsam 'dra gi ma red/ de 'dra yin dus 'di'i skabs su brtag mi thub ste zer yag de rigs pas phar brtag dpyad btang nas chos thams cad la brtag na thub kyi ma red zer yag de la bsam blo gtang rgyu med pa byas/ dang po sgro 'dogs sems la bcad/ sems kyi rtsad bdar bcad tshar nas de'i steng nas 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs sems kyi cho 'phrul yin par nges thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ 'o de 'dra'i steng nas yong dgos kyi 'dug /'di nges yong dus 'jig rten pa'i chos thams cad kyi snang tshul la ji tsam brtag na'ang brtag thub kyi ma red la 'jig rten pa'i chos de la brtag thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ brtag mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re red zer na/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma 'dra ba dper na mdo de tsho'i nang la sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang bcu gnyis la sogs pa mang po yod red/ da lta rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i cho ga'i nang dbang gi skabs su/ me long yongs su dag pa la shar ba'i rdo rje 'chang gi gzugs brnyan de gang nas kyang ma skyes/ gnas pa'i tshe na'ang me long rnams kyi mdun dang rgyab la sogs pa gang na gnas kyi yod ma red zer nas dpe gcig bshad/ de nas brag yod sa la yi ge ā li kā li sogs kyi sgra grag yong dus brag cha de phar nas tshur yong ba ma red/ tshur nas skad brgyab pa ma red/ sgra grag bzhin du rang bzhin med pa stong bzhin du nye bar snang ba zer nas de 'dra mang po gsungs bsdad kyi 'dug /de tsho thams cad kyang de'i steng nas 'gro gi yod red/

thams cad de'i steng du yong gi yod/ mdor na sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang 'dra ba lta bu dang rmi lam la sogs pa dang sgyu ma lta bu dang dri za'i grong khyer lta bu sogs nang bzhin red/ rig pa drug cu pa'i nang du/ rmi lam lta bu dang dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dpe mang po bzhag yod red/ rmi lam lta bu dang dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang gsog dang gsob ya ma brla lta bu snying po med pa red/ de bzhin du skye ba dang gnas pa thams cad kyang rang bzhin med zer yag gi tshig zhig yod red/ rmongs pa'i grong khyer mi bzad pa'i// 'gro ba sgyu ma bzhin du snang*// gsungs pa de red/ 'gro ba sgyu ma bzhin du snang zer yag de sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'o/ spyir btang nga tshos dus rgyun du chos thams cad bden pa yod ma red/ ga 'dra red zer na/ dper na khyed rang gi rmi lam nang bzhin red zer ba'i skabs su rmi lam de nga tshos mtshan gzhi 'dra po zhig bzhag gi yod red pa/ yin na yang da lta 'di'i skabs su sgro 'dogs sems la chod zin pa'i rnal 'byor pa la rmi lam de yin gcig min gnyis dpe bzhag ma dgos pa yin pa red/ nyin mo'i snang ba de ga rang rmi lam lta bur mtshon thub kyi yod pa red/ nyin mo'i snang ba 'di rang rmi lam yin par mtshon thub kyi yod pa red/ nyin mo'i snang ba de ga rang rmi lam chags bsdad kyi yod red ma gtogs yang rmi lam zur du dgos kyi yod ma red/ yin na yang lam la slob pa'i skabs su rmi lam gyi dpe zhig dgos kyi yod red pa/ de yin dus sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang 'dra bar snang na'ang rmi lam lta bu red gsungs dgos kyi yod red/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu dpe de tsho de ga re red zer na don la yod pa ma yin pa red/

rmi lam sgyu ma don la yod ma yin// gsungs pa red/ rmi lam de sgyu ma 'dra po red/ rmi lam de sgyu ma 'dra po red zer nas dpe de tsho rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu la bzhag pa red de don thog la bsam blo btang na rmi lam dang sgyu ma kho rang yang grub yod ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /de ma gtogs rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i dpe bzhag yang rmi lam dang sgyu ma yod red zer yag 'dra po go 'gro ba yin na de yang go ba log 'gro gi yod red/ de 'dra ma red rmi lam dang sgyu ma yod gsungs pa ma red/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma la snying po med pa nang bzhin gyis 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la yang snying po yod ma red/ don dag la rmi lam dang sgyu ma 'dra po red zer nas dpe de rmi lam dang sgyu ma bzhag pa red de don la dpyad yong na rmi lam dang sgyu ma yang bden pa yod ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /shing gnyis brdar bas me byung*/ me des shing gnyis bsreg /shing gnyis bsregs tshar nas me de yang tha mar rang bzhin gyis yal 'gro ba red ma gtogs me lhag bsdad kyi ma red pa/ 'o de nang bzhin gyi dpe de'i mtshan nyid dang 'dra ba'i don gyi mtshan nyid kyang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa gtan la phab tshar nas tha ma dpe de'i mtshan nyid kyang rang zhi ru 'gro dgos pa red/ de 'dra yin dus/ rmi lam sgyu ma don la yod ma yin// gsungs pa red/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma de don la yod ma yin zer yag gi don de ga re red/ don de don dam pa la yod ma yin gsungs pa red/ ngo bo nyid la yod ma yin gsungs pa red/ chos kyi dbyings la yod ma yin gsungs pa red/ 'di gsungs yong dus dpe dang don gnyis cha la 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma kho rang don la yod pa ma yin pa de dang 'dra bar 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyang ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub/ chos kyi dbyings la ma grub/ don dam pa la ma grub gsungs kyi yod red/

de yin dus don la zer yong dus don de la don dag gnyis go dgos kyi yod red/ dper na rmi lam dang sgyu ma kho rang yang don la yod ma red/ de dang 'dra ba da lta dpe de gang la bzhag sa'i don 'jig rten gyi chos de yang ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub/ chos kyi dbyings la ma grub/ don dam pa la ma grub gsungs kyi yod red/ de yin tsang don la yod ma yin zhes pa'i tshig de 'gro dgos kyi 'dug /rmi lam sgyu ma gcig pu don la yod pa ma yin gsungs kyi yod ma red/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma kho rang don la yod pa ma red lags/ de dang 'dra bar 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyang ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub/ chos kyi dbyings la ma grub/ don dam pa la ma grub gsungs dgos kyi yod red/ des na skyo ba bskyed la 'jig rten bya ba thongs// gsungs pa red/ de'i phyir na 'khor ba'i chos thams cad la skyo ba bskyed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ skyo ba bskyed zer na ga re red/ skyo ba bskyed zer yag de snying po med pa mthong dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ sems pa skyo zer ba 'dra po 'khor ba'i bya ba mthong nas ngu dgos kyi yod pa red/ sems skyo dgos kyi yod pa red/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i cho ga'i nang du/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes// 'jig rten bya ba thams cad spangs nas ni// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog dam pa 'dir// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ zhes thar pa chen po'i grong mchog la bzhag rogs gyis zer nas zhu yi 'dug /lha rgyal ba rgya mtshos bzhag yong yag gang yang yod ma red/ gtso bo rang gis 'gro dgos kyi red pa/ yin na yang der 'gro thub yag la sgo gsum byin gyis brlab rogs gyis zer nas gsungs pa red ma gtogs rang skyid po byed nas nyal 'gan thams cad rgyal ba rgya mtshor g.yog nas yar 'khrid 'gro rogs gyis zer yag gi skad cha ma red pa/

gtso bo de rang gis byed dgos pa yin na yang de 'dra yong thub yag la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang yi dam gyi lha la sogs pa thams cad kyis bdag la sgo gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol zer nas gsol ba 'debs kyi yod red/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len de byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis 'thob dgos kyi yod red/ nga tshor 'di gal chen po red 'dug /dbang po yang rab gcig dgos yag de gal chen po red/ shes rab kyang rnon po dgos kyi yod red/ shes rab rnon po zhig dang dbang po rnon po de dgos yag de rtsa ba la bzhag /de'i steng du med du mi rung ba'i khyad chos kyi yon tan byin rlabs kyi stobs zer yag de zhe drag gal chen po red/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi stobs zer yag de bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba dang yi dam gyi lha de yang sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba zhig gis rtogs pa'i gdeng thob thub mkhan zhig yod na/ de 'dra'i yi dam gyi lha dang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'jug yong dus de'i stobs kyis phyag rgya chen po rtogs yag la sngon gyi las 'phro bzang po sad/ chos nyid kun tu 'gro ba'i rigs de yang sad/ rang bzhin gnas rigs de yang sad yong dus ngo 'phrod yong ba red 'dug /'o de yin dus byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis 'gro ba de zhe drag gal chen po yin pa red ma gtogs byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis ma yin par ga tshod phyag rgya chen po la lung dang rig pa mang po zhig spungs nas ga tshod slob sbyong byed/ mgo 'gul/ gzugs po g.yug na yang mi phan pa red/ phyag rgya chen po zer yag de la byin rlabs kyi stobs de zhe drag gal chen po red/ de la brten nas nga tsho'i sgrub brgyud kyi nyams len de tsho tshang ma gtso bo mos gus la rag las kyi red gsungs pa de 'di red 'dug /sgrub brgyud de gtso bo mos gus la rag las kyi yod pa red/

dad pa la rag las kyi yod red/ dad pa med na byin rlabs 'jug gi ma red/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa la dang po dad pa dgos pa red/ des na de la skyo ba bskyed gsungs pa de skyo ba bskyed yag de gtso bo rang gis bskyed dgos pa red/ skyo ba bskyed zer yag de snying po mi 'dug bsam dgos pa red pa/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba de la rigs pas brtag cing dpyad pa'i skabs su dpyad don rnyed rgyu mi 'dug /sgro 'dogs sems la chod tshar ba'i skabs su sems kyi gnas lugs ngo 'phrod tshar ba'i skabs su phar blta bsdad yag de tsho tshang ma sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa red/ phan thog gang yang med pa red/ snying po med pa red/ bye ma'i khang pa nang bzhin yin pa red/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad la skyo ba chen po bskyed la/ gzugs po la na tsha chen po zhig thebs pa dang mgo la zug chen po zhig brgyab nas sman bcos dka' las khang po chags yong dus de dus skyo ba bskyed na mi phan pa red/ skyo ba da lta nyid nas bskyed dgos pa yin pa red/ lus bde po yod/ lus sems gnyis ka bde po yod/ nyams len yag po gnad la gcun thub pa zhig byed pa'i skabs der skyo ba bskyed thub na skyo ba yag shos de yin pa red/ 'jig rten bya ba thongs/ zer na 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad g.yug shog gsungs pa red/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba zer ba 'di'i skabs su bya ba ga re red/ ming dang thob dang mnga' thang gzi brjid la sogs pa mdor na 'di'i nang la 'jig rten gyi bya ba zag bcas kyi dge ba tshun chad tshang ma la 'gro gi yod red/ zag bcas kyi bya ba yin na yang 'jig rten gyi bya ba chags 'gro yi yod red/ zag bcas kyi dge ba dper na nga tshos sbyin pa zhig btang ba yin na yang mig gis phar bltas byas mi gzhan gyis tshur blta gi 'dug mi 'dug blta/ gcig gis rang la blta gi 'dug bsam na yang dngul mang tsam zhig sprad/

tshur blta mkhan mi 'dug bsam pas rdog rgyag zhus nas btang bzhag pa yin na phan thog yod ma red/ 'o de lta bu yong gi red/ de ga nang bzhin gyis kha ton dang dge sbyor la sogs pa byed yag dang sgom brgyab yag la sogs pa thams cad la yang ming dang grags pa dang lan gyi re ba dang rnam smin gyi re ba la sogs pa mdor na bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo dang 'brel nas dge ba zhig bsgrub tshun chad la 'jig rten gyi bya ba nang la 'gro gi red gsungs kyi yod red/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thongs/ thongs zer na g.yug shog gsungs pa red/ de tsam du ma zad pa/ 'khor yul chags sdang 'brel pa kun gcod nas// gsungs 'dug /'khor zer dus pha ma gnyen bshes mdza' grogs la sogs pa de thams cad de 'khor red pa/ yul zer ba de sa cha red/ sa cha 'di dpe skyid po yod red bsam bsam 'dra po sa cha la 'dzin pa chags na yul la chags pa red/ de ga nang bzhin gyis 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog la sogs pa mdor na nyon mongs pa yod do cog 'brel pa yod tshad thams cad de la 'brel pa kun bcad nas/ 'khor yul chags pa sdang ba thams cad dang 'brel ba bcad dgos pa red gsungs pa red/ dwags po rin po che la mi la ras pas/ bu khyod 'khor ba dang 'brel thag chod pa yin// gsungs pa ltar/ gnas lugs kyi btsan sa zin yong dus phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag de phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la bskyed nas/ bu khyod 'khor ba dang 'brel thag chod pa yin gsungs pa red/ 'di'i skabs su sgro 'dogs sems la chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa de mi mang po'i nang la bsdad yag dang rang gcig pur bsdad pa gnyis la khyad par med gsungs pa red pa/ 'o de 'dra'i sgro 'dogs sems la chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nyin mor bsgom nas bsdad na'ang red mtshan la nyal na'ang khyad par med gsungs pa red/ de lta bu zhig byung song na 'grig tshar ba red/

de ma thub kyi bar du 'brel thag gcad yag gi thabs la brtson dgos gsungs pa red 'dug /'khor yul chags sdang 'brel pa kun bcad nas ga par 'gro dgos kyi red/ 'khor yul chags sdang la sogs par zhen pa'i sems de spang tshar ba'i skabs su 'brel thag chod zer gsungs pa red/ de 'dra'i sems chags sdang gi rnam rtog de spang tshar na ga par 'gro dgos kyi red zer na/ gcig pur nags 'dabs ri khrod gnas par bsgom// gsungs 'dug /rang gcig pur gsungs pa red/ gnyen mdza' grogs la sogs pa gang yang med pa/ nyin mo mi'i rgyun 'grul med pa/ mtshan mo dgra'i klag cor med pa/ gnas dben pa la 'gro ba red/ nags tshal nang du gcig pur 'gro ba red/ rje btsun mi la ras pa nang bzhin gcig pur nags 'dabs la sogs pa dang*/ ri khrod la sogs pa dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyis sa dben pa dang*/ brag phug dang*/ shing skam po'i drung dang*/ gang ltar chags sdang gi rkyen med sa de 'dra la 'gro dgos pa red/ rgyal sras lag len las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ yul ngan spangs pas nyon mongs rim gyis 'grib/ ces yul gang zhig la brten nas nyon mongs thams cad rim gyis 'grib thub yag gcig gi yul yod na der brten dgos pa red 'dug /gcig pur zer yag don de 'di red/ nags 'dabs ri khrod gnas par bsgom/ yang ri khrod zer ba'i skabs su me tog mang po skye bsdad sa 'dra po dang*/ spang skyid po 'dra po dang*/ chu yang legs po yod sa dang*/ shing tog de tsho yag po skye sa de 'dra zhig la ri khrod zer gyi yod ma red/ rje btsun mi la ras pa nang bzhin/ phyi'i rdzong drug nang gi rdzong drug gsang ba'i rdzong drug dang yang rdzong gnyis dang nyi shu/ yongs su grags pa'i phug chen bzhi/ ma grags pa'i phug chen bzhi bcas phug chen brgyad la sogs pa'i nang la ga tshod mang po bzhugs 'dug /de tsho thams cad kyang brag dang phug skam po mdog ngan pa 'dra po phar cher chu tshod gcig bsdad dgos na'ang bsdad ma thub sa de 'dra'i sa cha yod red ma gtogs/

mthong rgya yag po yod sa dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyi chu gtsang ma bab bsdad sa dang shing tog mang po yod sa dang*/ yang grong khyer la 'gro na'ang thag nye po yod sa de 'dra de 'dra la ri khrod zer gyi ma red/ ri khrod zer yag de su gcig gis kyang bsdad ma thub sa de 'dra dgos kyi 'dug /rje btsun mi la ras pa de 'dra la bzhugs bsdad pa red/ phal cher wa dang gla ba rwa lta bu de 'dra 'gro sa red ma gtogs mi 'gro sa ma red bsam bsam gyi sa cha de 'dra nang la bzhugs kyi 'dug /de 'dra la ri khrod zer nas lab pa red pa/ gnas nges med de 'dra la 'gro dgos kyi red 'dug /de yin dus gcig pur nags 'dabs ri khrod gnas par bsgom zer yag 'di red/ bsgom zer dus ga re bsgom dgos kyi red zer na/ gcig pur nags 'dabs dang ri khrod du bsdad nas sgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis// gsungs pa red/ yang 'di la 'brel ba 'dug /bsgom zer dus sgom brgyab nas tsog tsog byed nas bsdad zer ba'i skad cha med/ bsgom rgyu zhig yod nas lha bsgom sngags bsgom dkyil 'khor bsgom gzhal yas khang bsgom zer ba'i skad cha med/ 'o na ga re bsgom zer na bsgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis/ gsungs pa red/ bsgom bya dang sgom byed bsgom pa'i yul thams cad las 'das pa'i gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la gnas gsungs pa red/ sgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas dgos kyi yod red/ sgom du med pa'i ngang las mi g.yo bar byed nas bsdad dgos pa red/ sgom du med pa'i ngang las ma 'das par byed nas bsdad dgos pa red/ bsgom du med zer yag de bsgom rgyu zhig yod nas sgom du med pa ma red/ phyag rgya chen po zer yag de bsgom bya sgom byed las 'das pa red 'dug /bsgom bya sgom byed las ga 'dra byed nas 'das pa red/ bsgom bya sgom byed las 'das yag de sems kyi rang bzhin ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba rnam pa sna tshogs su shar ba don dam pa'i sku gsum tshang bsdad yag gi sems kyi gnas lugs kyi steng la ma bcos par mnyam par zhog gsungs pa red 'dug

/ma bcos pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /ma bcos pa'i ngang la glod/ ma bcos pa'i ngang la zhog gsungs pa red/ bzhag zer ba'i skabs su gzhag rgyu zhig kyang yod ma red de ngang la lhod bzhag pa red 'dug /'di la tshig zhe drag mang po gang yang lab yag yod ma red/ gang mtshams shig nas tshig gis sgrog bcings nas yang mgo bo 'khor gyi red/ gang ltar bsgom du med pa'i ngang las ma g.yo bar gyis gsungs pa red 'dug /rnam rtog ngo bo chos skur gsungs pa bzhin// ci yang ma yin cir yang 'char ba la// ma 'gags rol par 'char ba'i sgom chen la// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gsungs 'dug /'o tshig de yag shos yin pa red/ ci yang ma yin cir yang 'char ba la// de 'dra phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i skabs su phyag rgya chen po sgom mkhan gyi shes pa'i ngo la rol pa sna tshogs shar gyi red gsungs pa red/ de la bzang po shar gyi red ngan pa yang shar gyi red 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa shar gyi red/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa shar na'ang rung bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog gang shar na'ang de la dgag sgrub ma byed gsungs pa red pa/ bzang po'i rnam rtog shar song na'ang de yag po red bsam nas de la re ba dang der lhur len pa mi byed/ ngan pa'i chags sdang dang khong khro la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i phyogs su 'gyur ba'i rnam rtog phyin ci log pa yang skye gi red/ 'o rnam rtog ngan pa skye song bsam nas sems la khu khrig dang sems la dwogs pa de 'dra ma byed/ dgag sgrub gang yang ma byed/ ma bcos pa de gar zhog /rnam rtog shar na shar ba de ngos zin par byed dgos pa red gsungs 'dug /da lta bar du nga tsho 'khor ba la ga re byed nas 'khor ba red zer na rnam rtog de ngos ma zin nas 'khor ba red/ rnam rtog la snang med btang bzhag pa red/ rnam rtog de yan par btang bzhag pa red/ rnam rtog de ngan lang btang bzhag pa red/

rnam rtog de lang shor ram rkyen ngan gyi lam la btang bzhag dus rnam rtog gi rang nyid phar drud song ba red pa/ nga rang rnam rtog gi gzhan dbang du gyur pa red/ rnam rtog kho rang ga pa 'dod 'dod 'khrid song ba red/ nga rang yang de'i rjes su rgyugs song ba red/ mig long ba nang bzhin byed nas mig long ba de mig yod mkhan zhig gis 'khrid 'gro dus ga ba 'khrid na'ang 'gro rgyu red pa/ de ltar byas nas rnam rtog gi gzhan dbang du 'khrid song ba red/ de 'dra ma yin par rnam rtog shar yong ba'i skabs su rnam rtog de ngos zin par byed/ rnam rtog ngos zin tshar ba'i skabs su rnam rtog de yag po red dam sdug chag red bsam pa'i 'khu 'khrig de ma byed gsungs song*/ bzang po'i yon tan gyi rnam rtog shar song na'ang de la dga' ba ma bsgom/ ngan pa'i rnam rtog shar song na'ang de la dwogs pa dang sems sdug ma byed/ bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog gang shar na'ang shar ba de'i ngo bo la ltos dang shar tsam nyid nas rang yal du 'gro ba chu la ri mo bris pa nang bzhin 'gro gi red/ gnad 'gag de'i steng du 'gro dgos pa red/ las dang po pa la sems khrid byed dus rnam rtog skye yong ba'i skabs su dang po rnam rtog de ga 'dra byed nas yong gi 'dug brtag dpyad btang*/ dper na rdo rje gdan lta bu zhig yid la skad cig gcig gis bsgom yong dus rdo rje gdan de phar nas tshur slebs yong ba red dam nga rang gi sems de phar 'gro ba red dpyad de dmigs pa zhig bshad kyi yod red/ las dang po par de'i rjes la rim pas rnam rtog shar yong dus de yi ngo bo la blta nas rnam rtog de gang du 'gro song zer yag gi man ngag de bslab kyi med pa red/ rnam rtog rang yal du 'gro ma 'gro'i skad cha med pa red/ rnam rtog shar tsam nyid nas rnam rtog gi ngo bo la ltos gsungs pa de ga rang red ma gtogs de'i rjes la rnam rtog yal song 'dug zer ba'i skad cha de yod ma red/

phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag la goms yong dus de nas rang bzhin gyis shar bas gnas pa la mi gnod/ gnas pas shar ba la mi gnod par 'gyu 'phro rtog gsum gnas 'gyu rig gsum tshang ma phyag rgya chen po gcig gi ngo bo la rtogs yong dus de nas rnam rtog shar yong ba dang ngos zin pa gnyis dus mnyam yong gi yod red/ rnam rtog dang po shar ba dang gnas lugs la btsan sa zin tshar na rnam rtog shar ba dang rnam rtog grol ba dus mnyam ste shar grol dus mnyam zer yag de red pa/ 'di zhe drag gal chen po red/ rdzogs chen dang skad cha 'dra po yod red/ de la brten nas sgom du med zer yag de red/ rnam rtog bzang ngan gang shar na'ang rnam rtog de la bzang ngan gyi 'du shes ma byed/ rnam rtog shar ba nyid nas rnam rtog ngos zin pa byed/ rnam rtog ngos zin tshar na rnam rtog gsog dang de gsob ya ma brla snying po yod ma red gsungs pa red/ rnam rtog dang po gang nas byung ba'i khungs med/ rnam rtog da lta gang du gnas pa'i bca' sa gnas tshang yang med/ rnam rtog tha ma gang du 'gag sa'i 'gro yul yang med pa red/ de 'dra'i byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtag dpyad btang yong dus rnam rtog de rnyed kyi yod ma red/ de 'dra mi rnyed yong dus rnam rtog la nga rang gi phar dbang sgyur byed thub pa byung ba red/ rnam rtog de nga rang gi dbang du tshur bsdus thub pa byung ba red/ rnam rtog de nga rang gi rang dbang du tshur bsdus tshar ba red/ de nas gang mtshams shig la rnal 'byor pa de la ga tshod rnam rtog mang po shar ba yin na'ang rnam rtog de shar rim bzhin du grol 'gro gi yod red/ de la shar grol dus mnyam zer ba red/ shar grol dus mnyam chags yong dus ji tsam ji tsam rnal 'byor pa la rnam rtog mang ba de tsam de tsam gyis de dag chos nyid kyi grogs su chags 'gro ba red/ chos nyid kyi yo lang zhes pa der de red/

de 'dra ngo ma shes kyi bar du ji tsam rnam rtog mang po shar na'ang re dwogs dang 'khu 'khrig dang 'dzin par gyur nas bgegs kyi cho 'phrul chags 'gro ba red 'dug /bgegs kyi cho 'phrul chags yong dus rnal 'byor pa de la lam gyi bar chad byed kyi yod red/ lam gyi gegs byed kyi yod red/ sngon ma tog tsam nyams yag po yod pa de tsho yang brlag 'gro ba red/ phyis su nyams bzang po'am rtogs pa bzang po skye yag la gegs byed kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus rnam rtog la brngan bgrang byed dgos kyi yod dus rnam rtog de chos nyid kyi skul ma'am rnam rtog de chos nyid kyi rtsal yin pa/ rnam rtog de chos nyid kyi rol pa yin pa ha go yong dus ji tsam ji tsam chos nyid la nges shes yod pa de tsam de tsam rnam rtog de chos nyid kyi rol pa yin pa shes thub pas rnam rtog dngos grub yin zer yag de red/ de yi don chos nyid la yid ches yod pa dang chos nyid rtsa ba chen po yin pa la nges shes kyis rnam rtog dngos grub tu tshur 'gyur ba dang rnam rtog de rnal 'byor pa'i grogs chags yong ba red/ rnam rtog de rnal 'byor pa'i chos nyid kyi yo lang chags yong gi yod red/ ji tsam ji tsam rnam rtog mang po yod na'ang de tsam de tsam rnal 'byor pa'i nyams len gyi bogs 'don du 'gro ba dang*/ sgom nyams len de gong 'phel du 'gro rgyu yod pa red/ de 'dra ba'i thabs zab mo'i rim pa de tsho phyag chen gyi nang la gsung gi yod red 'dug /de'i phyir na sgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis gsungs pa red/ bsgom rgyu gang yang med pa red/ lha bsgom yag yod ma red/ sngags bzla yag yod ma red/ dkyil 'khor bsgom yag yod ma red/ de tsho thams cad rtog btags yin gsungs song*/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i chos shig yin na mi 'grig pa red 'dug /rje btsun mi la ras pas/

phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su// lus ngag gi rtsol ba ma byed cig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// gsungs pa red/ sgom du med pa'i ngang nas ma g.yo bar byed nas bsdad gsungs pa red 'dug /gnas zer yag de 'di'i skabs su go ba la sgom du med pa'i ngang la bsdad zer yag 'dra po go 'gro gi 'dug /sgom du med pa'i ngang la bsdad zer yag de tshig gi bed spyod tsam btang ba red ma gtogs don la sgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas bya gnas byed kyang yod ma red de tshig bed spyod btang yong dus de rjod byed dang brjod byar 'brel dgos// sgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas zer yag de sgom du med pa'i ngang las ma 'das pa zhig byed dgos kyi red/ sgom du med pa'i ngang nas phar ma bgrod nas bsgom du med pa'i ngang la glod cing bzhag dgos kyi red gsungs pa red 'dug /de ma gtogs bsgom du med pa'i ngang la yang bskyar bsdad zer na'ang bsdad bya sdod byed cig med pa red/ 'khor ba'i rtog pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtog pa/ gzung ba'i yul la zhen pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis grol thub kyi red/ 'khyags rom chur zhu ba ltar de yang 'khyags rom dang po chags yong dus nas chu'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa red ma gtogs 'khyags rom dang chu gnyis la khyad par gang yang yod ma red/ yin na yang rkyen la brten yong dus 'khyags rom chu ru zhu yong ba red/ de nang bzhin nga rang tsho'i sems kyi gnas lugs de phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo las ma 'das pa red/ yin na yang phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin yin pa la yin par nges shes ma skye nas phyag rgya chen po la nga dang bdag tu 'khrul song ba red/ phyag rgya chen po rnyog pa bzos bzhag pa red/ phyag rgya chen po las nyon gyi dbang gis rnyog pa bzos nas nga la bdag tu 'khrul pa dper na gong la 'khyags rom chu ru 'gyur ba nang bzhin phyag rgya chen po de bcings song ba red/

da lta bla ma'i man ngag dang rang gi mos gus phur tshugs su gtad/ des las 'phro sad yong dus de'i steng la slebs yong ba red/ slebs yong dus ngo shes nas slar yang rtog pa gsar pa rnyed pa dang*/ nyams gsar pa rnyed pa de 'dra'i skad cha gang yang ma red/ ga re red zer na rang gi gnas lugs ma mthong ba gang yin pa de da lta yin pa la yin par ngo shes pa red/ ngo shes yong dus slar yang 'khyags chu la phar zhu song ba red/ de ma gtogs gsar pa zhig yong yag dang gsar du yon tan thob song ba gang yang med pa red/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// gzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// gsungs pa de red/ skyon gyi cha thams cad phar bsal yag yod ma red/ yon tan gyi cha thams cad gsar du tshur gzhag yag yod ma red/ yang dag pa'i gnas lugs la yang dag par ma bcos par bltas pas de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag yong dus grol ba yin gsungs pa red/ da phan yon bstan pa ni/

thob med 'thob na phyag rgya chen po 'thob// gsungs pa red/ nga rang tsho'i phyag chen sngon 'gro nang la yang*/ 'thob bya thob byed thob pa ma dmig shing*// spang thob gnyis med gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa// dngos bral dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can// 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po mngon 'gyur shog /gsungs pa de 'di red/ 'thob bya thob byed 'thob pa ma yin pa // zer mkhan de 'bras bu la bshad kyi yod red/ thob med 'thob na zer na 'bras bu gsar du thob yong yag gang yang med pa red/ thob tu med pa'i 'bras bu de 'thob song na zer na yag po yod red/ gang red zer na/ 'bras bu thob zer ba'i skabs na nga rang tshos lam sang bsam blo nang la slob sbyong zhig byed nyams len zhig byed nas 'bras bu 'dra po zhig ya gir rdog rdog zhig 'thob pa la bsam blo btang gi yod red pa/ de 'dra ma red gsungs kyi yod pa red 'dug /thob med 'thob zer yag de rang la ga re yod pa'i 'bras bu de rgyu'i tshul du nang la dang po nas yod red la yod pa de da lta bar du ngo ma shes pa red/ da ngo shes yong dus nga rang la yod pa de nga rang gis mthong yong ba red ma gtogs gsar du rnyed yong ba min pa ha go yong dus 'thob med thob na gsungs pa red 'dug /thob tu med pa zhig 'thob na gsungs pa red ma gtogs yang thob tu med pa zer mkhan zhig yod red de tshur thob na zer ba'i skad cha ma yin pa/ rang la yod pa'i don de rang gis mngon du byed pa red/ rje btsun mi las dwags po rin po che la/ lta ba yin pa nged kyi sems la ltos // sems las gzhan du lta ba btsal ba na// gsungs pa nang bzhin red/ lta ba yin par nged kyi sems la ltos// gsungs pa dang*/ 'bras bu yin par nged kyi sems la ltos/ gcig pa red/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po zer yag dang 'bras bu gnas lugs la don dam pa zer yag de tsho rang gi sems rgyud la yod red ma gtogs gsar du thob dgos kyi ma red/

de yin dus thob med 'thob na gsungs pa de phyi nas tshur gsar du thob yag med pa slar yang gnyen po dang rkyen la brten nas tshur thob tu med dus thob med zhes gsungs pa red/ gnyen po la brten nas thob tu med pa/ rkyen la brten nas thob tu med pa/ lam la brten nas thob tu med pa zhes de gsum brten nas gsar du thob yag med pa yin dus thob med gsungs pa red/ 'o na 'di ga re zer gyi yod red/ don dag de rkyen dang lam dang gnyen po la brten ma dgos par rang chas su yod pa zer yag der go yi yod red/ rang la rang chas su yod pa'i yon tan nam rang la rang chas su yod pa'i chos nyid de'i nus pa dang chos nyid gang yin pa de da lta ngo 'phrod pa la brten nas 'bras bu 'thob zer ba red ma gtogs rkyen dang lam dang gnyen po la brten nas tshur gsar du thob yag med pa yin pa'i phyir na thob med gsungs pa red/ de lta bu'i thob med de 'thob na zer ba'i skabs su ga re thob na/ de 'dra po de ngo 'phrod na gsungs pa red/ ngo shes pa'am ngo 'phrod pa btsan sa zin pa la zla ba zer yag 'di red/ gnas lugs kyi steng du la zla ba 'bras bu la zla ba 'bras bu la btsan sa zin pa 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur ba gcig pa red de tsho de thob na gsungs pa red/ yin na yang tshig de bed spyod btang dgos pa red ma gtogs yang skyar thob zer ba'i skad cha ma red/ tshig gis bed spyod gtang yong dus thob pa zer nas lab dgos kyi yod pa red/ thob med 'thob na phyag rgya chen po 'thob// gsungs pa red/ phyag rgya chen po'i don ngo bo nyid dam chos kyi dbyings de thob kyi red gsungs pa red/ 0000000000000255 dper na ljon shing sdong po yal ga lo 'dab rgyas// rtsa ba gcig bcad yal ga khri 'bum skam// 00000000dper na ljon shing chen po'i sdong po de yal ga rgya chen po/ lo 'dab rgya chen po/

me tog rgya chen po/ rtsi shing 'bras bu rgya chen po mang po yod red pa/ yin na yang de re re bzhin du bkog dgos yag yod ma red pa/ rtsa ba kho rang mar nas yar bkog pa'am bcad thub pa yin na yal ga dang lo 'dab dang rtsi shing dang me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pa brgya phrag khri phrag 'bum phrag mang po yod pa de skad cig gcig la skam 'gro gi red gsungs 'dug /kho rang bzhin gyis skam 'gro gi red ma gtogs slar yang gnyen po re re bzhin du bsten dgos kyi yod ma red/ 0000000000000255 de bzhin sems kyi rtsa ba bcad na 'khor ba'i lo 'dab skam/ ༈ /16/ 00000000dpe de bzhin du sems kyi rtsa ba bcad na 'khor ba'i lo 'dab skam/ sems kyi rtsa ba bcad zer na ga re red/ sems kyi gnas lugs de ngo 'phrod na gsungs pa red/ sems kyi rtsad bdar bcad thub na'am sems de kho na nyid mngon du 'gyur thub na/ gang ltar sems kyi rtsad bdar bcad thub na zer na yag shos red/ sems la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'am sgro 'dogs sems la bcad thub na gsungs pa red/ sgro 'dogs de kha phyi la phar bskor nas bcad bsdad pa ma yin par rnal 'byor pas sgro 'dogs de nang sems la bcad thub na 'khor ba'i rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi lo 'dab de skam gyi red gsungs 'dug /'khor ba'i lo 'dab skam 'gro gi red/ de bzhin du karma pa lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bde smon nang du/ 'khor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang mya ngan 'das// kun rtog de bzhin nyid gang ye shes te// gcig dang du ma'i bdag nyid las 'das pa'i// chos nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros ldan gyur cig /gsungs 'dug /'khor ba zer yag de spang bya red/ yin na yang sgro 'dogs sems la bcad yong dus rnal 'byor pa des 'khor ba'i de bzhin nyid de ngo 'phrod pa red/ 'khor ba zhes bya de spang bya la bsam blo ma btang nas 'khor ba'i gnas lugs la brtag yong dus 'khor ba'i rang bzhin la brtag yong dus 'khor ba'i rang bzhin de bzhin nyid yin pa rtogs yong ba red/

de yin dus 'thob bya'i 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa logs su mi dgos pa red/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin de bzhin nyid yin pa rtogs thub na mya ngan las 'das pa de ga rang red gsungs 'dug /'khor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang mya ngan 'das// gsungs yong dus 'khor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de ga rang mya ngan las 'das pa red ma gtogs 'khor ba'i de bzhin nyid de phar bzhag nas mya ngan las 'das pa zhig zur nas 'bras bu thob tu re ba zhig dgos kyi ma red/ kun rtog de bzhin nyid gang ye shes te// gsungs pa red/ 'khor ba la 'o na sus 'dzin pa red/ 'khor ba rang bzhin gyis ma grub na 'o na 'khor ba la 'dzin mkhan su red zer na/ las nyon gyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i kun tu rtog pa de red gsungs pa red/ kun rtog zer yong dus srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug /las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i gtso sems kun 'gro lnga dang sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig bcas mang po 'dug pa de thams cad kun rtog gi nang la 'gro gi yod red/ kun rtog phra rags mang po yod red/ de yin dus 'khor ba zhes bya ba de la 'dzin mkhan de su red zer na kun rtog gis 'dzin gyi yod pa yin dus 'khor ba la bdag mkhan de sus bdag gi yod red zer na kun rtog gis bdag gi yod pa yin dus sgro 'dogs sems la bcad pa'i rnal 'byor pas kun rtog la brtag yong dus kun rtog gi rang bzhin de de bzhin nyid yin pa rtogs pa red/ kun rtog gi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid yin pa rtogs yong dus me long ye shes mnyam nyid ye shes sor rtog ye shes bya grub ye shes chos dbyings ye shes te ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid yin pa mthong thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ de lta bu'i 'khor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang mya ngan 'das pa dang*/ kun rtog de bzhin nyid gang ye shes te/ gcig dang du ma'i bdag nyid las 'das pa'i// gcig gi rang bzhin du yang ma grub/

du ma'i rang bzhin du yang ma grub/ gcig dang du ma'i bdag nyid las 'das pa'i gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus/ chos nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros ldan gyur cig /gsungs pa red 'dug /chos nyid rtogs pa zer nas ming de btags pa tsam red 'dug /chos nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros zer na 'di red/ sems kyi rtsa ba bcad zer ba de 'di red 'dug /gzhan yang der/ rang bzhin 'od gsal mkha' ltar mi dmigs kyang*// rnam pa kun ldan ye shes rol pa yi// shes bya ji snyed mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// dpag med thugs kyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// gsungs pa de yang 'di'i nang la 'gro gi 'dug /de tsho gcig pa red/ mdor na sems kyi rtsad bdar bcad thub pa yin na 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rnam rtog zhi thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ de bzhin du dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i nang la/ gcig gi lta po gang yin pa// de ni kun gyi lta po yin// gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa// de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ gang gis dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba// de yis dngos kun de bzhin nyid mthong 'gyur// gsungs pa de tsho tshang ma gcig par 'gro thub kyi red/ chos gcig gi rang bzhin de phyin ci ma log pa rtogs thub na de yis drangs pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de khong du chud thub kyi red gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan de sgro 'dogs de sems la bcad thub na sems kyi rtsad bdar bcad sems kyi gnas lugs de yag po ngo 'phrod thub na de yis drangs pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyang ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba rtsal sna tshogs su shar ba'i sku gsum gyi rang bzhin de rtogs thub kyi red gsungs 'dug /de yin dus mtshon byed kyi sku gsum/ mtshon bya don gyi sku gsum bcas mang po bshad kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus sku gsum rang la tshang zer yag de 'di'i steng nas 'gro dgos/

ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba rnam pa sna tshogs su shar ba gsungs kyi 'dug /rdzogs chen gyi skabs su yin na/ gzhi skye ba med pa chos sku/ gdangs 'gag pa med pa longs sku/ rtsal sna tshogs su snang ba sprul sku zhes gsungs pa de tsho gcig pa red/ tshig gi 'gro stangs kyi khyad par red ma gtogs de 'dra yin dus sku gsum rang la tshang bsdad pa bstan gyi yod red/ de 'dra'i skabs la slebs yong dus rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// gsungs 'dug /'o de tsho tshang ma de'i nang la yong gi yod red/ de ga nang bzhin gyi gcod kyi nyams len nang la yang*/ sems kyi gnas lugs sangs rgyas yin pa la yin par ma rtogs nas glo bur nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba de'i nang la song nas ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo bshags zer yag yong bsdad kyi 'dug /de tsho tshang ma de nas yong gi yod red/ da ga nang bzhin gcod snang ba laṃ khyer gyi nang la/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro la phyag 'tshal ba 'dra po dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la sogs pa la phyag 'tshal yag 'dra po dang*/ kun rtog la phyag 'tshal yag de tsho thams cad de yang gtso bo 'di'i nang nas yong gi yod red/ gnas lugs sems kyi sgro 'dogs de bcad tshar na sems kyi rtsa ba gcig bcad thub na/ chos thams cad kyi mtshang de dgrol thub kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus gnad gsang rtsa ba 'dra po de mi gsod par byed pa la dang po gnad 'gag de'i steng la gri de btsugs thub pa yin na srog dang dbral ba red/ de bzhin sems kyi gnas lugs la sems kyi rtsad bdar de bcad thub na 'khor 'das kyi chos kun gyi rol pa de shar thub kyi red gsungs 'dug /de bzhin sems kyi rtsa ba bcad na 'khor ba'i lo 'dab skam/

0000000000000255 dper na bskal stong bsags pa'i mun pa yang*// sgron me gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnams sel// de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal skad cig gis// bskal par bsags pa'i ma rig sdig sgrib sel/ ༈ /17/ 00000000dper na mun pa shin tu nag po'i mtshan nyid can zhig yod red/ bskal stong bsags pa'i mun pa de mun pa shin tu gnag pa la bzhag dgos pa red pa/ bskal pa stong phrag mang po la bsags pa'i mun pa zhig yin na yang*/ sgron me gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnams sel// sgron me de chung chung zhig ma gtogs med na yang sgron me zhig gis bskal pa stong phrag mang po la bsags bzhag pa'i shin tu gnag pa'i mtshan nyid can yang sgron me zhig gis mun pa'i tshogs thams cad bsal thub kyi red gsungs 'dug /sgron me gcig sbar yong dus mun pa'i tshogs thams cad gsal thub kyi red/ de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal skad cig gis// de nang bzhin gyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du sdig pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byed yod red/ de'i 'bras bu ngan song gi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong yod red pa/ ma rig pas de ga tsam bsgribs yod red de yin na yang da lta dngos gnas drang gnas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig la bsten/ man ngag zab mo phyag rgya chen po de 'dra ba zhig la the tshom dang yid gnyis bral bas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab ste mos gus rtse gcig gis nyams len byed yong dus rang gi sems la shar ba'i 'od gsal skad cig ma de nyid kyis/ bskal par bsags pa'i ma rig sdig sgrib sel// bskal pa stong phrag mang por bsags bzhag pa'i ma rig pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad kyang sel thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ mtshams med lnga'i las bsags bzhag yod na'ang sbyang thub kyi yod pa red/ sdig pa'i las bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshad med pa bsags bzhag na'ang sbyang thub kyi yod pa red/

de 'dra de'i rgyud la gnas pas phal cher sdig pa sbyang ma thub pa gcig kyang med pa red 'dug /de yin dus thabs brgya gnyen po stong gi mchog tu gyur pa de yin pa red/ sdig sgrib sbyong yag thabs rtsa che shos de yin gsungs pa red/ 16711680 da ni blo 'das kyi tshul bstan pa ni/ 00000000 0000000000000255 kye ho// blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong*// byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rtogs// blo 'das byar med don de thob 'dod na// rang sems rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog / rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dwangs su chug / snang ba dgag sgrub mi bya rang sar zhog / spang len med par snang srid phyag rgyar grol// kun gzhi skye ba med par bag chags sdig sgrib spong*// snyems byed rtsis gdab mi bya skye med snying por zhog / snang ba rab snang blo yi chos rnams zad du chug / 00000000kye ho// blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong*// blo yi chos zer yag de theg pa chung ngu'i chos thams cad la gsungs kyi yod red/ theg pa chen po ma yin pa'i theg pa chung ngu nyan thos kyi theg pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i chos shig yod red pa/ de la blo'i chos gsungs kyi yod red/ de ma gtogs de'i skabs su blo'i 'dzin pa'i chos zer yag la go rgyu yod ma red/ theg pa chung ngu'i chos la go dgos pa red/ theg pa chung ngu'i chos rnams la zer ba red/ theg pa chung ngu'i chos rnams la zer ba'i chos de tsho blo yis byas pa'i chos yin gsungs pa red/ blo'i chos la brten nas theg pa chung ngu'i rang lam nas blo las 'das pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs thub kyi ma red/ 'di rtogs thub kyi ma red pa/ ga re red zer na/ lta ba la rtsis 'debs yod red/ sgom pa la rtsis 'debs yod red/ spyod pa la rtsis 'debs yod red/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa la rtsis 'debs yod tshar ba'i rjes la des blo las 'das pa'i don rtogs thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/

dper na gang zag gi bdag med pa red bsam pas gang zag gi bdag med pa'i steng la ga tshod cig slob sbyong byed na'ang blo 'das de slob thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /gang zag gi bdag med pa la 'dzin pa yod red/ khong tshor gzung ba skad cig cha med dang shes pa skad cig cha med bcas cha med gnyis kyi 'dzin pa yong gi yod red/ de bzhin gang zag gi bdag med pa la zhen pa chen po yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus theg pa chung ngu'i chos de yis blo las 'das pa'i don rtogs thub kyi yod ma red gsungs pa red/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po sems kyi gnas lugs kyi don de mthong thub kyi ma red/

byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rtogs// byas pa'i chos zer na ga re red/ rtsol sgrub kyi chos saṃ rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i chos/ dper na/ sgom zhig brgyab na'ang rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i sgom/ nyams len zhig byas na'ang rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i nyams len/ dge ba byas na'ang zag bcas kyi dge bar 'gyur ba red/ gang ltar rtsis 'debs shig yod pa'i chos thams cad zer gyi yod red/ 'dzin pa yod pa dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa yod pa/ zhen pa dang bcas pa yod pa/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo/ bdag 'dzin phra mo yod pa'i chos thams cad de byas pa'i chos red/ 'dus byas kyi chos red/ zag bcas kyi chos yin pa red/ de 'dra'i zag bcas kyi dge ba'i chos dang 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i chos la 'dzin pa yod na dge ba'i phan yon rdzogs 'gro yag yod pa red 'dug pa/ phan yon yod dang yod red/ phan yon yud tsam zhig la brlag 'gro ba red/ de la brten nas byas pa'i chos yin pas na byas pa'i chos de yis byar med kyi don rtogs thub kyi ma red zer ba red/ byar med pa'i don zer na phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ ming tsam la ma 'dra ba mang po btags kyi yod red pa/ blo las 'das pa'i don de'ang phyag rgya chen po red/ byar med pa'i don de'ang phyag rgya chen po rang red/ phyag rgya chen po la bya rgyu gang yang yod ma red/ ga re byed nas bya rgyu med pa red zer na/ phyag rgya chen po zer yag de rang gi sems rgyud la rang chas su yod bsdad pa red ma gtogs gsar du 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed nas sgrub ma dgos pa red pa/ de la brten nas byar med gsungs pa red/ blo 'das byar med don de thob 'dod na// blo 'das zer dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de ga re red zer na/ da lta nga rang tsho'i blo gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gi rwa ba 'di'i nang la chud bsdad pa de la blo zer gyi yod red/

blo las 'das yong dus phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len zer yag de blo las 'das pa'am kun rtog gi drwa ba las 'das song ba yin dus blo las 'das pa zer ba red/ de yin dus blo'i drwa ba nang la bsdad sdod pa zhig gis blo las 'das pa'i don mthong thub kyi ma red/ de ga nang bzhin gyis zag bcas kyi dge ba'i bya ba nang la bsdad bsdad mkhan zhig gis zag pa med pa dang byar med pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i don dag rtogs thub kyi ma red/ blo 'das byar med don de thob 'dod na// de yin dus dngos gnas drang gnas kyis blo las 'das pa dang byar med pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len dang rtogs pa de thob tu 'dod kyi yod na/ phyag rgya chen po'i don de la bzar 'dod dang phyag rgya chen po'i don de la btung 'dod yod na gsungs pa red/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len gyi bza' btung la longs su spyod 'dod yod na/ rang sems rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog /rang gi sems nyid kyi ngang nas ma g.yos bzhin du rang sems rtsad chod gsungs pa de rang gi sems nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du rang sems de rtsad chod dgos kyi yod red/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngang nas g.yo nas rang gi sems de rtsad chod pa yin na 'jig rten pa'i chos nang la 'gro ba yin pa red/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngang nas ma g.yos bzhin du gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas phar ma 'das bzhin du rang gi sems de rtsad chod dgos pa red gsungs pa red/ rang sems rtsad chod zer ba'i skabs su rtsad chod yag gang yod red zer na/ rtsad chod yag de gang yang yod ma red de yin na yang rang gi sems kyi sgro 'dogs bcad dgos pa red/ sems de ga 'dra 'dug /sems la yang nas yang du brtag dgos kyi yod red/ spyir btang phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa thob tshar na'ang da dung yang sems la nan tan byed dgos pa red 'dug /'bras bu mchog thabs tshul bla na med pa yang dag pa mi gnas pa'i myang 'das mthar thug pa ma thob kyi bar du la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skye tshar na'ang da dung yang sems la rtsad bdar chod ma thub na mi rtog pa'i ye shes de la sgrib pa'i nyen kha yod pa red 'dug
