/gang red zer na bag chags zer mkhan de shin tu yun ring ba dang shin tu phra ba yin pa/ bag chags de shin tu nus pa gting ring po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas mtshams mtshams la las 'phro yod pa'i skabs su phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa shar na'ang sgrib yag gi nyen kha yod pa red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus da dung yang rang sems rtsad chod dgos pa red/ rang sems rtsad chod yong dus de nas ga re dgos kyi yod red zer na/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngang nas ma g.yo ba zhig rtogs yong na/ rig pa gcer bur zhog /gsungs 'dug /rig pa gcer bur zhog zer ba'i rig pa de ga re la go ba red/ rig pa zer yag de gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i phyag rgya chen po ngo 'phrod bsdad pa de la rig pa zer ba red/ rdzogs chen skabs su sems dang rig pa gnyis su bshad pa red pa/ de skabs kyi rig pa de dang da lta 'di'i skabs su bshad pa'i rig pa gnyis po de gcig pa red/ rig pa zer yag de rnam par shes pa tshogs drug de phar 'das tshar nas so so rang rig pa'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig yod pa la rig pa zer nas lab pa red/ rnam par shes pa tshogs drug gis ma bsgrib pa/ rnam par shes pa tshogs drug gis bkab song ba ma yin pa/ rnam par shes pa tshogs drug gis bsgrib bsdad pa ma yin pa/ de sgrib pa'i dri ma las 'das pa'i so so rang rig pa'i ye shes shig yod red/ de la rig pa lab pa red/ tshur bltas myang 'das zer mkhan de red/ phar bltas na 'khor ba dang tshur bltas na myang 'das de la rig pa zer nas lab pa red/ rig pa gcer bur zhog zer yag de gang ltar rnam rtog rtsad gcod mang po ma byed gsungs pa dang don dag gcig pa red/ rig pa de ye gdod ma nas dri mas gos ma myong ba red/ rig pa de la ye gdod ma nas rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs kyis gos ma myong ba red/ dper na nyi ma de nga rang tsho la sprin pas bsgrib bsdad pa'i skabs su nyi ma ma mthong ba red pa/

nga rang tsho'i ngo la nyi ma ma mthong ba red ma gtogs nyi ma kho rang gi yon tan 'od dang tsha zer la sogs pa la sprin pas che chung btang thub kyi ma red pa/ sprin pas sgrib thub kyi ma red/ nyi ma la gang yang 'gyur ba btang thub kyi yod ma red de nang bzhin gyis rnam par shes pa tshogs drug las 'das pa'i so so rang rig pa'i ye shes de la ji tsam ji tsam rnam rtog dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur na'ang rnam rtog dang nyon mongs pa'i tshogs kyis rig pa la sgrib thub kyi yod ma red gsungs pa red/ de yin dus yag tu re ba dang ngan du dwogs pa'i blo mang po ma skye bar da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma 'di rang gi steng la ma bcos par mnyam par zhog gsungs pa red/ gcer bur zhog zer yag de rang sor zhog shog gsungs pa red/ rjen par zhog gsungs pa'i skabs su ma bcos par zhog /rnam rtog gis rtsad gcod ma byed/ rnam rtog gis yag tu re ba dang*/ ngan du dwogs pa la sogs pa ma byed/ da lta'i shes pa ma bcos pa gang yin pa de'i steng du ma bcos par mnyam par zhog /da lta'i shes pa gang yin pa de la bzo bcos ma btang bar de'i ngang la lhod cing glod/ cog ger bzhag gsungs pa red/ mi la ras pas/ cog gis bzhag pas gnas lugs mthong*// gsungs 'dug /cog gis bzhag zer ba'i skabs su ma bcos par bzhag pa red/ nga rang tshos cog tse'i sgang la dkar yol bzhag pa'i skabs la cog ger bzhag pa red pa/ phar yo ba dang tshur yo ba la dwogs pa gang yang med pa red pa/ glod cing lhod pa dang cog gis bzhag pa zhes gnyis bzhag pa yin dus cog gzhag red/ de 'dra yin dus rig pa gcer bur zhog /zhog zer yag tshig de rig pa gcer bu'i steng du ngo shes par gyis gsungs pa red pa/ rig pa gcer bu la ngo 'phrod pa gyis/ rig pa de gcer bu yin pa la nyams su myong dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dwangs su chug

/rnam rtog gi tshogs thams cad 'gag pa la rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dwangs su chug gsungs pa red/ chu de btsog pa red bsdad yag de rnam rtog red pa/ de yin dus rig pa zer yag de dwangs ma red/ rig pa dwangs ma de la rnam rtog gi dri mas bsgrib bsdad pa red la de yin dus rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dwangs su chug /rtog pa dri ma'i chu de gzugs la 'dzin pa/ sgra la 'dzin pa/ dri la 'dzin pa/ ro la 'dzin pa/ reg bya la 'dzin pa la sogs pa rnam par shes pa tshogs drug gi 'dzin pa de rtog pa dri ma red/ de 'dra'i rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dwangs su chug gsungs pa red/ rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs thams cad de 'gag chug dgos pa red/ rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs thams cad rang yal du 'gro dgos pa red/ rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs thams cad de rang zhi la 'gro dgos pa red gsungs pa red/ yin na yang*/ snang ba dgag sgrub mi bya rang sar zhog /gsungs 'dug /snang ba la dgag sgrub bya yag med pa red/ snang ba zer yag de ga re red/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa red la de la dgag sgrub byed rgyu yod ma red gsungs 'dug /snang ba de mthong dgos kyi mi 'dug zer yag 'dra po dang*/ snang ba de la gcig dgos red gnyis dgos red zer nas gang ltar 'dzin pa dgag sgrub la sogs pa de byed dgos kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ tai lo pas nā ro pa la gsungs pa ltar/ bu snang bas mi bcings zhen pas bcings// zhen pa chod cig nā ro pa/ zhes bu snang bas mi bcings gsungs pa red/ snang bas bcings kyi ma red/ snang ba zer mkhan de khyad par med pa red/ snang ba zer mkhan de yag po yod pa red/ da lta nga rang tsho la ga res sgrib kyi yod red zer na/ sgrib yag de zhen pas bcings gsungs yag de gang red/ zhen pas bcings zer na snang tsam des ma tshim pa/ snang tsam des ma chog pa/ snang ba de'i btag don btsal nas de'i rang bzhin de da dung phug de la yod red bsam nas zhen pas lhan skyes kyi 'dzin pa de yis sgrib bsdad kyi yod red/

ma gtogs snang ba des nga rang tsho rnal 'byor pa la gang yang bar chad byed kyi yod ma red/ grub thob snye mo ba dngos grub rgyal mtshan gyi gsung mgur nang du/ nor gsog 'jog spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// nor rdzas 'di lung stong gi shwa rgod dang 'dra// yod kyang chog la med kyang chog /zhen pa nang nas bral ba 'di dang re spro// gsungs 'dug /nor gsog 'jog spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gsungs pa de dngul rgyu nor la sogs pa gsog 'jog spangs pa'i nal 'byor par sems la zhen pa med na 'grig tshar ba red gsungs pa red/ sems la zhen pa med na sgor mo 'bum phrag mang po yod na'ang 'dra gser srang 'bum phrag mang po yod na'ang 'dra khang pa stong phrag mang po yod na'ang khyad par yod ma red gsungs 'dug /nor gsog 'jog spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// nor rdzas de lung stong gi shwa ba 'dra po yin/ zhes sems la zhen pa med tshar na nor rdzas de tsho thams cad lung pa stong pa'i shwa ba nang bzhin red/ lung pa stong par shwa ba slebs na sems khral gang yang med pa red/ zhing kha yod mkhan gcig yin na sems khral yong gi red pa/ da shwa ba slebs yong na zhing med pa bzo gi red/ shwa ba gcig phar nas yong gi 'dug da yang nga'i zhing kha za 'gro gi red bsam pa'i sems khral mang po yong gi 'dug /da ma he slebs yong gi 'dug /ba phyugs slebs yong gi 'dug nga'i a shom za 'gro gi red/ da nga'i lo tog za 'gro gi red bsam nas sems khral 'dug /lung pa stong pa so sor dbang ba'i sa dang lo tog la sogs pa gang yang med na shwa ba slebs yong na'ang dga' rgyu gang yang yod ma red/ de bzhin shwa ba med pa'i skabs su sdug bzhag gang yang med pa red/ de yin dus lung stong gi shwa ba dang 'dra/ yod kyang chog la med kyang chog /nor rdzas de thams cad de yod na'ang 'grig gi 'dug med na'ang 'grig gi 'dug /chog shes pa yin pa red/

gtso che shos de ga re red zer na zhen pa nang nas bral ba 'di dang re spro/ zhes sems kyi steng nas zhen pa de rtsa ba nas bcad thub na rgyu nor longs spyod so so la yod bsdad pa des gang yang bcings kyi mi 'dug gsungs pa red/ bcings yag de rgyu nor longs spyod mang po med na'ang 'phrul me de gcig ma gtogs med na'ang bcings bsdad kyi red gsungs pa red/ de rtsa ba chen po yin zer nas bcings bsdad pa red/ 'phrul me de dpe mi srid pa'i dbang chen po chags tshar ba red/ nga rang dbang chung chung chags tshar ba red/ 'phrul me des nga rang ga ba 'khrid 'khrid yin pa red/ 'o de 'dra yin dus zhen pa nang nas bral ba de la dang re spro/ gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan de la brten nas snang ba dgag sgrub mi bya gsungs 'dug /snang ba de dgag mi dgos pa red/ dbu ma'i skabs su yang snang ba ched du bkag na nyes pa yod gsungs 'dug /snang ba bkag mi rung ba yin pa red/ rang sar zhog zer na ga 'dra snang gi 'dug snang ba ltar du zhog shog /mdzes par snang na mdzes pa la bzhag shog /ma mdzes par snang nam mdzes pa rang la bzhag shog /'di mdzes pa red zer nas dang du blangs na zhen pa chags pa red/ 'di ma mdzes pa red zer nas g.yug dgos kyi 'dug bsam na 'dzin pa chags song*/ 'o de 'dra po sgra snyan po 'dug bsam nas dang du blangs na zhen pa red/ 'o sgra ba tsog pa red snyan po mi 'dug bsam na'ang 'dzin pa red/ des na snang ba dgag sgrub mi bya rang sar zhog /gsungs pa red/ 00000000spang len med par snang srid phyag rgyar grol// de sdig pa red zer nas spang yag yod ma red/ de dge ba red zer nas len rgyu yang med pa red/ de bzang po red zer nas len rgyu med pa red/ de ngan pa red zer nas spang rgyu yang med pa red/ spang du med pa dang len du med par spang blang med pa'i gnas lugs de rtogs thub na snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad phyag rgya chen po gcig gi ngo bor grol thub kyi red gsungs pa red 'dug

/chu brgya zam 'og gi dpe ltar snang srid du gyur pa'i chos thams cad ya gi sangs rgyas nas ma gi dmyal ba bar du'am mtho ris nas dmyal ba bar du snang bsdad pa'i snang srid kyi chos thams cad 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po gcig gi ngo bor grol 'gro ba red/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po gcig gi ngo bo la rtogs yong ba red/ de 'dra yin dus chos shig rtogs tshar song na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad shes thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ ma 'gag sna tshogs su shar thub kyi red/ ma 'gag sna tshogs kyi ngo bor mthong thub kyi red gsungs pa de 'di yin pa red/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs shig rtogs tshar ba'i skabs su de nas ma bslab na'ang rigs gnas gzhung dpe cha 'jig rten gyi sgra tshad ma tshan rigs la sogs pa thams cad shes thub kyi red gsungs 'dug /de tsho thams cad spang len med par rtogs yong dus snang srid phyag rgyar grol yag rgyu mtshan de la brten nas bshad pa red/ yin na yang mkhas pa la las nga tsho bka' brgyud pa la tog tsam 'phya gi yod red/ de yang khong tshos/ phyag rgya chen po zer yag gi don dag de ga 'dra zhig rtogs kyi yod zer na/ phyag rgya chen po rtogs pas 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa thams cad de sems nyid gcig gi rol pa'i rtsal yin pa ha go /des gnas lugs ji bzhin du rtogs pas rnal 'byor pa de grol yong dus 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ma bslab na yang shes rab rang byung du brdol nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rim par ma bslab kyang dgongs pa'i gter grol nas sngar ma shes pa thams cad shes/ ma bslab pa thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis shes/ gsar du bslab ma dgos par lkugs pa yin pa thams cad kyang grung po chags/ shes rab med pa thams cad shes rab rnon po chags nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lag mthil la skyur ru ra bzhag pa nang bzhin mthong thub kyi red/

khyed rang tsho bka' brgyud pa thams cad kyi lab srol ltar byas na phyag rgya chen po rtogs yong dus bla ma de glen pa red nas gang mtshams nas za mi shes 'thung mi shes skad cha bshad ma shes mkhan red 'gro sa 'dug zer gyi yog red/ de ga re byed nas lab kyi yod red zer na nga tshos kyang dus rgyun lab kyi yod red pa/ 'o khong bla ma grub thob red/ 'jig rten gyi chos gang yang mkhyen gyi ma red khong nyams len gnang gi yod par brten gang yang mkhyen gyi ma red zer nas bshad kyi yod red/ byas tsang khong tshos lkugs pa chags 'gro ba red zer nas lab pa red/ yin na yang de ma red zer yag mi 'dug /skad cha de yang dngos gnas 'dra po 'dug ste yin na yang kho gnas tshul khag khag red pa/ gnas tshul khag khag red de yin na yang lab yong dus tog tsam khyad mtshar po zhig yod red/

kun gzhi skye ba med par bag chags sdig sgrib spong*// kun gzhi zer yag de gang red/ 'di'i skabs su kun gzhi de kun gzhi rnam shes la go yi yod ma red/ kun gyi gzhi mtshan nyid skye ba med pa zer mkhan de la go dgos kyi yod red/ skye ba med pa zer yag de sems nyid dam sems kyi gnas lugs skye ba med pa'am kun gyi gzhi zer yag de red/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi snang gzhi/ 'khor 'das kyi skye ba thams cad kyi skye sa'i gzhi/ srid pa dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi snang gzhi da lta do ha mdzod nang la/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba'i// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// gsungs 'dug /yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ba'i sems/ kun gzhi zer yag de 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi skye sa'i gzhi red/ skye ba med pa zer na sems nyid skye ba med pa/ sems nyid skye ba med pa klong du gyur yong dus rang snang bag chags kyi sdig sgrib de rnams rang bzhin gyis zad 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ bag chags kyi sdig sgrib ched du badz+ra satwa gsag dgos yag 'dra po dang sbyin sreg blugs dgos yag la sogs pa de 'dras sdig sgrib spong ma dgos pa red/ sems kyi gnas lugs de skye ba med pa shes song na sdig sgrib sbyong thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sa bcu pa'i mdo sde'i nang la mnyam nyid bcu gsungs yod red/ mnyam nyid bcu'i nang nas skye ba med pa'i mnyam pa nyid de rtogs thub pa yin na lhag ma dgu po de rang bzhin gyis rtogs thub kyi red gsungs 'dug /da bzhin mgon po klu grub kyis dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi dbur/ skye ba med pa'i mnyam pa nyid de gtso bor bzhag ste/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min// gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min// dngos po gang dang gang na yang*// skye ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes bdag las skye ba med pa gzhan las skye ba med pa/

gnyis ka dang gnyis min las skye ba med pa bcas skye ba med pa'i mtha' bzhi'i gtan tshigs de'i steng nas chos thams cad stong nyid yin pa rtogs dgos pa gsungs 'dug /da lta 'di'i skabs su yang skye ba med pa zer yag de gal chen po yin pa red/ kun gzhi kun gyi gzhi sems nyid skye ba med pa klong du gyur yong dus tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags dang sdig sgrib thams cad gnyen po la bsten nas gzhom ma dgos par/ kun gzhi skye ba med pa'i gnas lugs la gyur tsam nyid nas 'khyags rom chur zhu ba nang bzhin dang*/ rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa nang bzhin gyis sdig sgrib de ngang gis spong 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ rdo tsha po'i steng du kha ba bab yong dus kha ba de rdo tsha po la thug tsam nyid nas kha ba zhu 'gro gi red/ 'o de nang bzhin gyis kun gzhi skye ba med pa'i klong du rnal 'byor pa de slebs yong dus sam btsan sa zin yong dus sdig sgrib thams cad ched du gnyer nas spang ma dgos par rang bzhin gyis zad 'gro gi red gsungs pa red 'dug snyems byed rtsis gdab mi bya skye med snying por zhog /snyems byed zer yag de 'di'i skabs su bdag 'dzin la gsungs pa red/ bdag tu 'dzin pa dang rtsis gdab de 'dra byed kyi yod ma red gsungs pa red/ bdag 'dzin zer yag de snyems byed red/ snyems byed kyi bdud zer ba'i skabs su snyems byed kyi bdud de nga'o bsam pa'i ngar 'dzin de la snyems byed gsungs pa red pa/ snyems byed kyis chos ga 'dra zhig byed na'ang zag bcas su 'gyur ba las zag pa med pa'i lam du mi 'gro/ snyems byed dang bral bas zin na zag med lam du 'gro ba yin/ zag bcas kyi lam du 'gro ba dang zag pa dang bcas pa la 'gro ba dang 'du byed kyi chos su 'gro ba yin na snyems byed chags song ba red/ de yin dus snyems byed dam bdag tu 'dzin pa med par bdag 'dzin las grol ba la 'bad dgos/

rtsis gdab zer yag de rnam smin la re ba de la gtso bo zer ba red/ da lta las 'di 'dra zhig byed na nga la 'bras bu de 'dra zhig thob kyi red bsam nas re ba byed na de la rtsis gdab zer gyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus snyems byed bdag tu 'dzin pa dang phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len la brten nas 'bras bu de 'dra ba zhig thob na ci ma rung bsam pa'i re ba med pa'am/ lan la re ba med pa rnam smin la re ba med pa 'bras bu la re ba med pa de 'dra'i snyems byed rtsis gdab mi bya skye med snying por zhog /skye med snying por zhog zer yag de sems kyi gnas lugs de ye gdod ma nas skye ba med pa red ma gtogs gnyen po dang lam la brten nas skye med du song ba ma red/ sems kho rang gi gnas lugs la skye ba med pa yin pa la skye ba med pa yin pa de'i steng du ma bcos par zhog gsungs pa red 'dug /gnas lugs kyi steng du zhog /rang bzhin gyi steng du zhog /ma bcos par zhog zer ba la snying por zhog gsungs pa red ma gtogs snying po 'dra po zhig yod nas de'i steng du zhog gsungs pa ma red/ ma bcos par bzhag pa'i tshig de rang red/ snang ba rang snang blo yi chos rnams zad du chug /da lta nga rang tshos rang gi snang ba las byung ba'i blo yi chos thams cad de phyag rgya chen po la rtogs thub na snang ba rang snang blo yi chos rnams zad tshar ba red/ snang ba rang snang zer yag de gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan ga 'dra zhig snang na'ang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gang dang gang snang ba thams cad rang snang du thag bcad nas 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog zad du 'jug pa yin/ de la snang ba rang snang zer nas gsungs pa red pa/ snang ba de ga re'i snang ba red zer na phyi nas tshur snang yong ba red pas zer na/ rang gi blo yis snang ba red/

rang gi chos nyid kyi rtsal gyis snang ba red/ rang gi bag chags kyi stobs kyis snang ba yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus chos nyid kyi rtsal gyis snang ba dang bag chags kyi stobs kyis snang bsdad pa'i rang snang gi blo yi chos thams cad sems nyid skye ba med par rtogs thub pa yin na zad 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ zad du chug zer na ga re red/ zad chug shog gsungs pa red pa/ 'di zad 'gro gi 'dug zer nas sems khral ma byed gsungs pa red/ zad na yang zad chug shog gsungs pa red/ snang ba thams cad rang snang red ma gtogs don la snang ba bden par grub pa yod ma red/ don la bden par ma grub pa'i snang ba de ga tshod cig snang na yang khyad par yod ma red/ bzang po'i yon tan dang red ngan pa'i rnam rtog gang snang na'ang snang ba thams cad blo yi chos dang blo'i rtsal dang blo'i rol pa red/ blo'i rtsal dang blo'i rol pa yin dus de thams cad skye ba med pa'i steng la mnyam par bzhag thub na kho rang bzhin gyis zad 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ char chu skam yong dus lo tog thams cad rang bzhin gyis skam 'gro gi red pa/ de nang bzhin byed nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis zad 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ dper na ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu nang bzhin red/ ltag chu chad yong dus rdzing bu rang bzhin gyis skam 'gro yi red pa/ 'o de nang bzhin byed nas blo'i chos thams cad rang snang yin par ngo shes/ snang ba bden grub ma yin pa bag chags stobs kyis snang ba ma gtogs don la bden pa med pa blo yi chos yin pa la shes thub na 'dzin pa thams cad zad 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ bag chags thams cad zad 'gro gi red gsungs pa red/ 16711680da lta sgom spyod 'bras bstan pa ni/00000000 0000000000000255 mu mtha' yongs grol lta ba'i rgyal po mchog / 00000000mu dang mtha' med pa nyams su myong na lta ba'i rgyal po yin gsungs pa red/

phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs la yul yul can yod med sogs kyi mu yod ma red mtha' yod ma red dbus dang mtha' gang yang yod ma red/ de yin dus mu mtha' med gsungs pa red/ mur thug rgyu dang mthar reg rgyu med pa yin dus/ mu mtha' yongs grol lta ba'i rgyal po mchog /gsungs pa red/ 0000000000000255 mu med gting yangs bsgom pa'i rgyal po mchog / 00000000mu med cing ma yengs par/ 'di'i skabs su mu med zer ba de mtha' bral la go ba red/ gting yangs pa ni zad mi shes pa red/ yang ma yengs par bsgom pa'am ma yengs pa'i dran pa'i bya ra dang bcas pa'i thog nas gnas thub pa yin na sgom pa'i rgyal po yin gsungs pa red/ gting yangs pa zer ba'i skabs su klong yangs pa gu dog po med pa/ gu yangs po bag yangs po yod pa/ don la ma yengs pa'am yengs pa med pa red/ yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhi gsungs pa nang bzhin ma yengs par gnas thub na sgom pa'i rgyal po yin gsungs pa red/ 0000000000000255 mtha' chod phyogs bral spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog / 00000000mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'am dgag sgrub thams cad las 'das na spyod pa'i rgyal po yin gsungs pa red/ mtha' chod phyogs bral zer yag de phyogs dang bral ba zer yag de dgag sgrub dang bral ba de la phyogs dang bral ba gsungs dgos pa yin pa red/ mtha' chod zer na mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ mtha' bzhi dang spros pa brgyad kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ phyogs bral zer ba'i skabs su dgag sgrub las 'das pa/ dgag pa med pa bsgrub pa med pa de 'dra'i dgag sgrub thams cad las 'das na/ spyod pa'i rgyal po yin gsungs pa red/ de yin dus mu mtha' med pa de lta ba'i rgyal po chags song*/ mu mtha' med pa zer yag de ga re'i mu mtha' med pa red/ blo'i chos thams cad zad sar 'khyol ba'am blo'i chos thams cad gnas lugs kyi steng du la zla thub na de lta ba'i rgyal po yin pa dang*/

de nas de la yengs pa med par gnas thub na sgom pa'i rgyal po yin pa dang*/ de la dgag sgrub thams cad dang bral ba'am mtha' thams cad las bral na spyod pa'i rgyal po yin gsungs pa red/ 16711680 'bras bu lhun grub tu gnas par re dwogs mi dgos par bstan pa/ 00000000 0000000000000255 re med rang grol 'bras bu'i mchog yin no/ ༈ /18/ 00000000re dwogs med pa ma 'ongs pa la 'bras bu de lta bu zhig thob yong bsam pa'i re ba med pa/ de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob mi yong bsam pa'i dwogs pa med pa/ re ba dang dwogs pa gnyis ka rang grol du thub na 'bras bu'i mchog yin gsungs pa red 'dug /re ba dang dwogs pa med pa zer ba'i skabs su re ba dang dwogs pa thams cad chos nyid kyi klong du gyur pa'am/ re ba dang dwogs pa thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i klong du 'gyur ba'am phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs la 'gro thub na 'bras bu'i mchog yin gsungs pa red/ 16711680 da tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas nyams 'char tshul bstan pa/ 00000000 0000000000000255 las ni dang po gcong rong chu dang 'dra// bar du chu bo gad+gā dal zhing g.yo// tha ma chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa 'dra// 00000000las dang po pas bla med kyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa la lta sgom spyod gsum theg pa chung ngu nas byed rim pa bzhin du 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ de ma gtogs lam sang theg pa chen po'i zab dang rgya che ba'i lta sgom la 'jug thub yag de yong gi yod ma red/ de yin dus dang po theg pa chung ngu nas byed nas yar nyan thos bye brag smra ba/ de'i rjes su mdo sde pa/ de'i rjes su sems tsam pa/ de'i rjes su dbu ma/ de'i rjes su sngags kyi rim pa de tsho bshad/ de'i rjes su kye rdo rje la sogs pa bsten nas 'gro gi red zer nas lta ba rim gyis sgom pa rim gyis spyod pa rim gyis zer nas rim pas brgyud yod red/

de 'dra yin dus theg pa chung ngu nas rim bzhin 'dzegs te/ de yang lta ba'i thog nas bshad yong dus las dang po pa de ga 'dra shig yod red zer na/ las ni dang po zer yag de/ gang zag las dang po pa'am yang na dbang po rim gyis pa/ dbang po rim gyis pa'am las dang po pa de tsho'i lta ba de gang 'dra zhig yod red zer na/ gcong rong gi chu 'dra po zhig yod red gsungs pa red/ rnam rtog shugs chen po yod pa'i skad cha red pa/ dge sdig gi lta ba la shugs chen po yod pa/ dge ba zer mkhan de yag po yin pa/ sdig pa zer mkhan de spang bya yin pa la rnam rtog rags pa shugs chen po yod pa red/ gcong rong gi chu nang bzhin red gsungs pa red/ dper na tshogs bsags na dge ba red zer gyi yod red/ gnod pa dang log pa'i sems bskyed na sdig pa red zer nas lta stangs shugs chen po yod pa red pa/ rnam rtog rags pa lta stangs shugs chen po yod pa red/ de la brten nas gcong rong gi chu 'dra po red gsungs pa red/ 'di las dang po pa theg pa chung ngu'i skabs su gsungs kyi yod red/ theg pa chung ngu'i skabs su las dang po pa gcong rong gi chu 'dra po yin gsungs pa yin pa de shes dgos kyi yod pa red/ go ba len yong dus theg pa chung ngu gcig pus yin sa ma red/ spyir btang mdo'i skabs su zer na yag shos yin sa red/ mdo la theg pa che chung gnyis phyed kyi yod red pa/ theg pa chung ngu'i skabs dang theg pa chen po'i skabs la gcong rong gi chu nang bzhin de rnam rtog tshogs bsags pas dge bar lta ba dang*/ gnod pa lta bu log pa'i sems bskyed na sdig par lta ba'i 'dzin pa zhig yod red/ de 'dra yin dus de la gcong rong chu 'dra zer ba red/ gcong rong chu de shugs chen po yod pa red/ skad cor tsha po yod red/ de nang bzhin red gsungs pa red/ de nas de lta bu'i 'dzin pa las grol yong dus tshogs bsags pa'i dge bar blta ba dang gnod pa dang log pa'i sems bskyed yong dus sdig pa red zer yag de 'dra'i lta stangs kyi 'dzin pa de las grol yong nas gsang sngags kyi skabs su/

bar du chu bo gad+gā dal zhing g.yo// gsungs pa de gsang sngags kyi lam gyi skabs su skad cha bshad kyi yod red/ gsang sngags kyi skabs su gang 'dra yod red zer na/ gsang sngags kyi lam la zhugs pa'i skabs su/ dper na chu bo chen po gaṅgā de bab yong dus dal po byed nas g.yo yi yod red/ de yin dus dge ba yin na'ang 'dra sdig pa yin na'ang red 'dug dge sdig gang gis kyang gcig gis phan btags bzhag yag dang gcig gis gnod skyed yag gi lta stangs kyi 'dzin pa de zhi 'gro ba red/ tshogs bsags pa'i dge ba lta bus phan btags pa dang gnod pa dang log pa'i sems bskyed na sdig par lta bas gnod bskyed yag de mdor na dge sdig phan gnod kyi 'dzin pa de zhi yong dus bar du chu bo gad+gā dal zhing g.yo zhes de 'dras sbyar dgos kyi yod red/ chu bo gad+gā zer mkhan de ga ler dal zhing g.yo yi red ma gtogs skad cor tsha po de 'dra yod ma red pa/ de nang bzhin gsang sngags kyi lam la 'jug pa'i dus su 'dzin pa de tsho las grol yong dus dge ba dang sdig pa gang gis kyang phan btags pa med pa dang gnod skyel yag med pa'i lta stangs thog la gnas thub kyi red gsungs kyi yod red/

tha ma chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa 'dra// de yang gsang sngags kyi lam gyi lta stangs shig red de/ gsang sngags kyi lam gyi lta stangs de lta bu mi dmigs pa'i klong du 'gyur yong dus tha ma chu thams cad rgya mtsho la ma bu 'phrad pa nang bzhin chags 'gro gi yod red/ tha ma chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa 'dra// gsungs dus 'dzam bu gling la chu bo mang po yod red de chu bo thams cad de mthar rgya mtsho chen po la ma gtogs 'gro sa yod ma red/ de nang bzhin lta stangs dang 'dzin stangs mtha' dag zhig yong dus mthar thug de chos kyi dbyings sam mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la slebs yong gi red gsungs pa red/ dang po dge sdig yod par lta ba/ bar du dge sdig med par lta ba/ tha mar dge sdig thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas tshul slebs yong dus chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa 'dra gsungs pa 'di red/ dang po dge sdig gi phan gnod yod par lta ba de las dang po pa gcong rong gi chu dang 'dra ba/ bar du dge sdig gi phan gnod gang yang med par lta ba'i lta stangs de chu bo gaṅgā dal zhing g.yo ba gsang sngags kyi lam/ tha ma chu rnams ma bu 'phrad zer yag de tha ma dge sdig de yang rnam rtog tsam zhig red ma gtogs dge ba dang sdig pa gang yang ma grub pa chos thams cad chos nyid kyi klong du ro gcig pa mnyam pa nyid kyi sgang la slebs yong dus ma bu 'phrad pa 'dra gsungs pa red/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su sgom med zer yag cig 'dug pa de lta bu red/ sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sa zer yag 'dra po dang*/ mdo'i skabs su mthun mong theg pa'i skabs su bshad pa yin na chos thams cad mnyam nyid zer yag gi mnyam nyid kyi steng la slebs pa red/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i skabs su snang bzhi zer nas bshad yong dus snang ba stong pa spros bral zung 'jug zer nas bshad pa'i skabs shig yod red/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i skabs su stong pa spros bral zung 'jug mnyam nyid zer nas 'char rim bzhi bshad yong gi yod red/

de 'dra yin pa'i skabs su mnyam nyid zer yag 'dra po dang zung 'jug zer yag de tsho'i skabs la slebs yong dus tha ma chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa 'dra gsungs pa red 'dug /dpe'i steng du don nges bsdad pa red pa/ de yin dus mdo'i skabs su dang po dge sdig yod par lta ba'i rnam rtog /sngags kyi skabs su dge sdig med par lta ba'i lta stangs chu bo gaṅgā dal zhing g.yo ba 'dra po/ tha ma dge sdig dkar nag thams cad dang bral ba'i las de tsho tha ma chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa 'dra gsungs pa red/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ dang po ni las nag po yang byas/ bar du dkar po yang byas/ da lta las dkar nag gnyis ka dang bral zhing las kyi gzhi zad pas ma 'ongs pa na byed par mi 'gyur ba zhig yin gsungs pa ltar las sdig pa yang byas bar du dge ba yang byas zer yag de las dang po pa gcong rong gi chu 'dra ba dang bar du chu bo gaṅgā dal zhing g.yo ba 'dra po red 'dug /tha mar dge sdig dkar nag thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas su slebs song gsungs yong dus chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa 'dra zer ba de 'di red/ yang don gzhan las dang po pa'i mnyam gzhag rnam rtog stobs drag che ba gcong rong gi chu/ cung brtan pa thob pas dbang po mchog gi mnyam gzhag chu bo gaṅgā dal 'gro spang gnyen srid zhi mtha' dag ro gcig tu 'dres pas gzhi lam gyi 'od gsal dbyer med du gyur pa ni mthar chu rnams ma bu 'phrad pa ltar yin pa'ang go nus/ tha ma 'di dbang po ches shin tu mchog ldan pa la go ba yin/ 16711680 da gegs sel gyi tshul bstan pa/ 00000000 0000000000000255 blo dman skyes bu ngang la mi gnas na// 00000000da yin na yang blo dman gyi skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis de lta bu'i don de rtogs thub kyi yod ma red/ lam sang lam sang rtogs dgos na rtogs thub kyi ma red pa/ thabs la mkhas pa'i man ngag ga tshod bstan na yang kho rang la sngon sbyang gi las 'phro med na tshe 'di la sbyang stobs kho nas de 'dra'i snying po'i don gyi gnas lugs de rtogs thub kyi ma red/

de 'dra yin dus blo dman pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis de lta bu'i don de rtogs ma thub na'ang ngang la mi gnas na zer na/ gnas ma thub na zer ba'i tshig de yong dgos kyi yod red/ blo dman skyes bus ngang la mi gnas na// zer dus blo dman skye bu de 'dra bas snying po'i don gyi gnas lugs de'i steng du gnas ma thub na lab dgos kyi yod red/ blo dman blo gros dang shes rab skyes stobs dang sbyang stobs dman pa'i skyes bu de tshos de 'dra'i dge sdig dkar nag thams cad dang bral ba'i snying po don gyi gnas lugs de'i steng la gnas ma thub na/ 'o na thabs shes yod red pas zer na/ yod red/ 0000000000000255 rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcud la bor// 00000000rlung gi gnad bzung zer yag de chos drug gi skabs su slebs kyi yod red/ mthun mong 'dra po bshad pa yin na rlung bum pa can zer yag 'dra po dang*/ bar rlung gzung yag yod red/ rlung gi gnad gzung yag de gdam ngag mang po yod red pa/ de 'dra yin dus rlung gi gnad gzung yag dang sgom pa'i thabs mang po zhig gis sems gnad rlung*/ rlung gnad rtsa/ rtsa gnad mig la yod pas gnad bzung ba yin/ rig pa gcud la bor gsungs pa red/ rig pa gcud la bor zer na rlung la gnad du bsnun pas rig pa la gang shar gyi rjes su mi thal bar yal bar 'dor ba'am/ rig pa gnad la 'tshud pa dgos kyi red zer ba red/ rig pa ngo 'phrod pa dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rig pa de ngos zin pa byed dgos kyi red/ rig pa la sbar 'debs byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ sbar 'debs zer na rig pa de lag pa'i sbar mos bzung thub pa byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rig pa gcud la bor zer yag de rnam rtog shar na'ang rig pa gcud la bor/ rnam rtog bzang po shar na'ang rig pa gcud la bor/ rnam rtog ngan pa shar na'ang rig pa gcud la bor/

de 'dra'i gnad ka de ga nas ha go gi yod red zer na/ gnas skabs su chos can kun rdzob kyi blo'i 'dzin stangs kyi 'khrul pa 'dra mi 'dra yong gi yod red de de thams cad rig pa'i ngang nas phar 'phro ba red/ tha mar ngo shes yong dus rig pa'i ngang la tshur sdud yong ba/ 'phro 'du thams cad kyang rig pa gcig gi ngang nas byed kyi yod pa ha go yag de rig pa gcud la bor zer yag de red/ de 'dra ha go yong dus rje btsun mi la ras pa la lha 'dres cho 'phrul rtsal bstan kyang thams cad rig pa'i gcud la bor yong dus rig pa'i cho 'phrul yin pa dang rig pa'i rtsal snang yin pa sgom yong dus gnod bskyal thub kyi mi 'dug /de 'dra ha go ma thub yong dus phyi nang gi 'dzin pa tha dad du song*/ lta stangs 'dzin stangs thams cad tha dad du zhen yong dus 'khrul snang gi 'jigs skrag thams cad yong gi yod pa red 'dug /'khrul snang gi 'jigs skrag thams cad zhi bar byed pa la dang po rnam rtog gi 'khrul snang thams cad chos nyid kyi rig pa gcig gi ngang nas 'byung gi yod pa de ha go yong dus gnad 'gag med pa red/ rba rlabs rgya mtsho rang las byung ba red thim yang rgya mtsho la phar thim 'gro gi red ma gtogs rba rlabs dang rgya mtsho so so yod ma red/ 'o de bzhin rnam rtog dang po 'phro ba'i skabs su yang chos nyid kyi rang rtsal gcig gi ngang nas tshur 'phro yong ba red/ 'di ngo shes yong dus rnam rtog de rig pa'i cho 'phrul yin pa ha go yong dus rig pa'i ngang la rnam rtog rdzogs pa red/ rig pa'i ngang la rnam rtog yal ba red/ 'o de 'dra yin dus rig pa gcud la bor zer yag de 'di red/ bor zer yag de g.yug bzhag pa'i skad cha ma red/ rig pa gcud la bor zer yong dus rig pa'i lta stangs dang rig pa'i gdeng tshod de las phar ma 'das pa'am gang snang chos skus rgyas gdab dgos pa la go gi red gsungs pa red/

rig pa'i thog brdzis btang dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ 00000000 00000255 lta stangs sems 'dzin yan lag du ma yis// 00000000lta stangs zer yag de phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs kyi steng nas chos thams cad la lta stangs byed dgos kyi red gsungs pa red 'dug /de ma gtogs 'dzin pa dang 'dzin zhen bdag tu lta ba la sogs pa de 'dra'i dbang du ma song ba chos thams cad bdag med pa dang*/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid yin pa chos thams cad zung 'jug yin pa chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs de'i lta stangs de las ma 'das pa zhig dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ lta stangs de'i steng du gnas dgos pa red/ sems 'dzin yang de'i steng du gnas dgos pa red/ sems 'dzin zer yag de dus rtag tu bsam blo zhig btang na'ang de'i ngang la gnas dgos kyi red gsungs 'dug /spyir btang lta stangs zer yag de mnyam bzhag gi skabs dang sems 'dzin zer yag de rjes thob kyi skabs su go ba zhig len na yang yag po 'dug /lta stangs zer yag de spyir btang mnyam rjes gnyis med 'dres thub yag de sangs rgyas kyi skabs su ma gtogs yong gi yod ma red pa/ da lta mnyam rjes tha dad du yod bsdad pa'i skabs de la lta stangs zer yag de rig pa gcud la bor ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings la mnyam gzhag gi lta stangs de'i steng du bsdad dgos pa red lags/ mnyam bzhag de las yar ldang yong dus sems 'dzin zer ba'i skabs su 'am rjes thob kyi skabs su de lta bu'i don de yang nas yang du byed dgos kyi red zer ba'i skabs su sems 'dzin zer ba'i skabs su rjes thob kyi skabs su go yag dang lta stangs zer yag de mnyam gzhag gi skabs su go rgyu yin pa red/ mnyam gzhag gi skabs su de lta bu'i lta stangs las ma 'das pa/ mnyam bzhag las yar ldang yong ba'i skabs su rjes thob kyi skabs su yang de lta bu'i snying po don gyi gnas lugs de mnyam gzhag gi skabs su ga re nyams su myong ba de yang nas yang du yid la byed nas za nyal 'gro 'dug spyod lam gang dang gang byed na'ang de lta bu'i sems 'dzin de las ma 'das pa dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/

yan lag zer na thabs red/ thabs du ma'i sgo nas phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs sam phyag rgya chen po'i don de ma gtogs pa'i bar du/ 0000000000000255 rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du gcun/ ༈ /19/ 00000000rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du gcun zer ba'i skabs su la ga re red/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs de ma rtogs kyi bar du gcun dgos pa red/ gcu na zer na de'i steng du gnas dgos pa'am thabs sna tshogs pas sems gcun dgos red/ de'i sgang la 'dzin dgos kyi yod red/ de'i sgang la bsdad dgos kyi yod red/ de'i steng du thob bab byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ rig pa ngang la mi gnas zer ba de 'di red/ rig pa ngang la mi gnas zer yag de phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs ma rtogs kyi bar du zer nas gsungs pa red/ rig pa'i ngang la gnas zer yag de rnam rtog 'phro ba/ dge sdig gi rnam rtog zer na'ang red za nyal 'gro 'dug tha mal pa'i spyod lam gang dang gang byas na'ang de thams cad rig pa'i ngang las byed pa/ rig pa'i ngang la rdzogs pa/ rig pa'i ngang nas byed kyi yod pa la btsan sa zin ma thub kyi bar du rig pa'i gnad der gcun dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ gong du zhu ba nang bzhin nyal ba 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor/ 'gro 'dug spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor/ bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor/ bgo ba gos kyi rnal 'byor bcas cha tshang rnal 'byor gyi nang la 'gro ma thub kyi bar du gcun dgos pa red gsungs pa red 'dug /don dag snying po de snang srid thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su ma shar bar du gcun dgos pa red/ las sla po byed nas bshad na snang srid thams cad dag pa rab 'byams yin pa ngo ma 'phrod bar du chos nyid kyi rang rtsal yin pa ngo ma 'phrod kyi bar du rig pa'i gnad la gcun dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ rig pa la gcun dgos pa red/ rig pa la lta stangs byed dgos pa red/

rig pa la sems 'dzin dgos kyi yod pa red/ rig pa la ngo sprod dgos kyi yod red/ rig pa la yang nas yang du lta dgos kyi yod red/ rig pa la yang nas yang du sgom dgos kyi yod red/ rig pa'i ngang du gnas dgos pa red/ tha mal pa'i rnam rtog dang tha mal pa'i zhen pa'i bag chags kyi dbang du gtang rgyu yod ma red/ tha mal pa'i 'dzin zhen gyi bag chags kyi dbang du gtang rgyu yod ma red/ ga tshod yin na yang gnyen po drag po bsten nas phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs rtogs pa ma byung gi bar du tha mal 'dzin zhen dang 'brel ba'i bar chad kyi dbang du gtang rgyu yod ma red/ ga tshod yin na yang gnyen po drag po bsten nas phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs rtog pa tha ma 'byung gi bar du rig pa'i gnas la gcun gsungs pa red/ 16711680de'i laṃ bstan pa/00000000 00000000 0000000000000255 las rgya bsten na bde stong ye shes 'char// thabs dang shes rab byin rlabs snyoms par 'jug / dal bar dbab cing bskyil bzlog drangs ba dang*// gnas su bskyal dang lus la khyab par bya// de la chags zhen med na bde stong ye shes 'char/ ༈ /20/ 00000000de rnams grol lam gyi dbang du byas nas bshad kyi yod red/ spyir btang nga tshos thabs grol gnyis zer nas bshad kyi yod red pa/ thabs lam gcig dang grol lam gcig bcas gnyis bshad kyi yod red/ 'di grol lam gyi dbang du byas nas bshad pa red/ nga tshor dus rgyun dpe cha la sogs pa'i nang la 'pho med tshul khrims zer yag de tsho de'i steng nas yong gi yod red/ de tsho gtso bo de rten rab byung gi thog la gnang ba yod ma red/ mang che ba rten de khyim pa de tsho yin pa red/ las kyi phyag rgya/ chos kyi phyag rgya/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ phyag rgya chen po zer nas bzhi yod red/ snying po'i don rtogs par byed pa dang de gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i thabs su las rgya bsten na zer yong dus chos drug gi skabs su gzhan lus thabs ldan dang rang lus gtum mo la brten nas sgom stangs gnyis bshad kyi yod red/

'di jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i byang chub kyi lam sgron gyi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin na/ las rgya de rten rab byung la gnang ba med pa red/ las rgya de gtso bo de bud med bsten pa red pa/ gzhan lus bud med la thabs bsten pa yin pa red/ des na las rgya zer mkhan de gzhan lus thabs ldan zer yag de mdor na gtum mo'i skabs su a thung 'bar 'dzag la bsten nas khams zhu bde'i thog nas bde chen ye shes bskyed pa de bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ 'di'i skabs su gzhan lus thabs ldan la bsten cing lus la rten 'brel 'grig nas rtogs pa sems la 'char yag de las rgya la bsten nas yong gi yod/ rten 'brel lus la 'grig rtogs pa sems la 'char zer yag de yin dus las rgya bud med bsten na rang rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes 'char gyi red gsungs pa red/ bde ba dang stong pa zung 'jug gi ye shes 'char gyi red/ sngags kyi skabs su snang stong zung 'jug /gsal stong zung 'jug /rig stong zung 'jug /bde stong zung 'jug bcas bzhi bshad kyi yod red/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de dus kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su e yig phyag rgya chen po dang*/ waṃ yig 'gyur med bde ba chen po zer nas gnyis bshad kyi 'dug /de yin dus e waṃ zung 'jug de bde stong zung 'jug red/ e waṃ zung 'jug bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes de las rgya bud med la bsten na 'char gyi red/ de la las rgya bsten na zer ba'i skabs su spyir btang bud med bsten zer ba'i skad ca ma red/ las rgya bsten yag la dang po rang la thabs du ma tshang dgos kyi red/ cha rkyen mang po zhig tshang dgos kyi yod red/ las rgya bsten thub yag la mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan gyi red/ de bzhin bla mas lung bstan gyi red/ rang la yang sems la 'o da las rgya bsten pa'i dus tshod red 'dug bsam nas rtog pa shar yag yod pa red 'dug

/de 'dra red ma gtogs de ga tsam sngags chas zhig gyon nas 'gro bsdad pas phan gyi yod ma red/ de yin dus las rgya bsten na dus tshod cig gi steng la slebs yong dus mkha' 'gro mas brda lung bstan yong dus las kyi phyag rgya bsten yong dus bde stong gi ye shes 'char gyi red gsungs pa red/ 'dis grol lam bshad yong dus zab po yin pa red/

00000000thabs dang shes rab byin rlabs snyoms par 'jug /de nas 'di'i skabs su thabs bde ba chen po dang shes rab stong pa nyid gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i rtogs pa sems la 'char yong dus byin rlabs snyoms par 'jug zer ba de red/ snyoms par 'jug zer yong dus gzhan lus thabs ldan dang rang lus gnyis po de snyoms par 'jug dgos pa red gsungs pa red/ der brten dga' ba bzhi dang stong pa bzhi'i rim pa de tsho yong bsdad kyi yod red/ dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ khyad dga'/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba zer nas dga' ba bzhi bshad kyi yod red pa/ mar nas yar byed pa'i skabs su dga' ba bzhi/ yar nas mar byed na stong pa bzhi/ de yin dus dga' ba bzhi dang stong pa bzhi de mnyam du 'grogs nas snyoms par 'jug dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ de tsho zhe drag rgyas pa zhu dgos yag gang yang mi 'dug / 00000000dal bar dbab cing bskyil bzlog drangs pa dang*// gnas su bskyal dang lus la khyab par bya// de la chags zhen med na bde stong ye shes 'char// de ltar gong du bshad pa'i lus kyi thig le dbab bskyil bzlog drangs bskyal khyab la gnad du legs par bsnun pas der chags zhen med na bde stong ye shes 'char yong ba red 'dug /'di zab po yod pa red/ de nas dngos gnas drang gnas bde stong gi ye shes 'char yong ba red 'dug /de dka' las khag po red pa/ dbab yag las sla po red de bskyil yag dka' las khag po red/ bskyil yag las sla po red de bzlog yag dka' las khag po red la drangs yag dka' las khag po red/ dus rgyun nga tshos kha skad la rten 'brel lus la 'grig na rtogs pa sems la 'char zer ba'i don de red/ rten 'brel lus la gang 'dra 'grig dgos kyi red/ rten 'brel lus la 'grig yag la de 'dra dang po dal bar dbab de nas bskyil de nas yar bzlog de nas drangs de nas bskyal nas lus thams cad la khyab yong dus rten 'brel lus la 'grig yong dus lus la bde drod rgyas/

lus la bde drod rgyas yong dus de nas sems la rtogs pa 'char ba yin gsungs pa red/ 'di'i skabs su chags zhen med pa zhig dgos kyi yod pa red/ chags zhen du shor song ba yin na mi 'grig pa red/ dper na sdom gsum rnam nges las/ spang bsgyur lam du byed pa so so yang*// nyon mongs rang mtshan spong bar mkhas rnams mthun// gsungs 'dug /nyan thos pa'i skabs su nyon mongs spang bar bshad yong red/ de ga nang bzhin gyi theg pa chen po'i skabs su nyon mongs bsgyur bar bshad yod red/ gsang sngags kyi skabs su nyon mongs lam du byed par gsungs kyi yod/ spang ba dang bsgyur ba dang lam du byed pa la thabs so sor yod na yang dngos gnas drang gnas ngos zin yag de/ nyon mongs rang mtshan spong bar mkhas rnams mthun// gsungs 'dug /nyon mongs rang mtshan pa de spong dgos pa red ma gtogs nyon mongs rang mtshan par shor song na spang bsgyur lam du byed na yang phan rgyu med pa red/ de nang bzhin byed nas da lta 'di'i skabs su yang dal bar dbab pa dang bskyil ba dang bzlog pa dang drangs pa dang bskyal nas lus thams cad la bde drod rgyas par du rten 'brel lus la 'grig rtogs pa sems la bde stong gi ye shes 'char yong ba de chags zhen med pa zhig dgos kyi red ma gtogs chags zhen de tshe 'di'i 'khri ba'i dbang du song ba yin na ye shes 'char yag phar zhog dang po tog tsam yod pa de yang brlag 'gro gi red/ de la brten nas 'pho med du 'grems gsungs pa red/ dge slong gi tshul khrims bsrung ba las lhag tsam de yin gsungs kyi yod red/ 'pho ba med pa'i tshul khrims zer yag de tshul khrims yag shos de yin pa red/ tshul khrims mchog tu gyur pa yin pa red/ rab kyi tshul khrims de yin pa red/ mchog gi tshul khrims yin pa red/ des na man ngag de grol lam gyi dbang du byed nas gsungs kyi yod red/

'di thabs lam red/ spyir btang chos drug gi nyams len de thabs lam red de yin na yang spyir btang sngags kyi skabs su bskyed rdzogs gnyis bshad yong dus rdzogs rim gyi thog nas gtso bo de chos drug yong gi yod red/ de'i nang nas rdzogs rim de la yang chos drug de rdzogs rim gyi bogs 'don red ma gtogs dngos gzhi de yong thub kyi yod ma red/ da lta de 'dra po yin na ni de 'dra'i nyams len yag po yod na rdzogs rim dngos gnas drang gnas chags bsdad kyi yod red/ rdzogs rim yang dag pa zhig chags bsdad kyi yod red/ de 'dra'i rdzogs rim de yang dag pa zhig nyams len byed nas rten 'brel lus la 'grigs rtogs pa sems la 'char thub pa 'byung na/ thig le dal bar mar dbab pa dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa de la thig le de rdo rje'i lam la bskyil ba dang*/ yar bzlog pa/ de nas drangs pa dang*/ bskyal ba/ de nas rten 'brel lus la 'grig yong dus lus thams cad la khyab yag de rim pa bzhin du 'gro dgos kyi 'dug /gang mtshams shig nas de la goms yong dus dal bar dbab pa dang bskyil ba dang bzlog pa dang drangs pa dang bskyal ba de tshang ma lhan cig la yong thub kyi yod red/ rim pa bzhin du bsgom ma dgos par dus gcig la cha tshang byed thub kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i thabs zab mo'i grol lam thog la slebs thub kyi yod na/ 00000000 00000255 tshe ring skra dkar med cing zla ltar rgyas par 'gyur// bkrag mdangs gsal la stobs kyang seng ge 'dra// thun mong dngos grub myur thob mchog la gzhol bar 'gyur/ ༈ /21/ 00000000'di tshos yon tan bshad kyi yod red/ de lta bu'i rten 'brel lus la 'grig nas rtogs pa sems la 'char thub pa byung na yon tan ga re yod red zer na/ tshe ring po dang skra dkar po yong gi ma red gsungs pa red/ skra dkar po med zer yag de lo rgas yag med gsungs pa red pa/

lo rgad po chags kyi ma red/ lus kyi bkrag mdangs de tsho zla ba nang bzhin gsal gyi red gsungs pa 'dug /zla ltar rgyas par 'gyur zer na zla ba nang bzhin rgyas kyi red gsungs pa red/ 00000000bkrag mdangs gsal la stobs kyang seng ge 'dra// de nas bkrag mdangs thams cad gsal po chags/ phar mthong yong dus nas mthong mkhan kho rang la yang dngos gnas drang gnas kyi sems la bde ba dang spro ba bskyed thub yag dang*/ de nas rang gi lus la stobs kyang seng ge dang 'dra ba de tsho thams cad mthun mong gi dngos grub red/ thun mong dngos grub myur thob mchog la gzhol bar 'gyur// mthun mong gi dngos grub de tsho red/ tshe ring ba skra dkar med pa lus kyi 'od zla ba ltar rgyas pa bkrag mdangs thams cad nyi ma lta bur gsal ba stobs kyang seng ge dang 'dra ba de tsho mthun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob kyi red/ de nas mthun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob tshar na de'i rjes la mchog la gzhol bar 'gyur gsungs pa red/ mchog zer yag de ga re red/ 'bras bu mchog de la mchog gi dngos grub zer ba red/ dang po mthun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob/ de'i rjes la mchog la gzhol bar 'gyur zer na mchog de mchog gi dngos grub la gzhol thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ gzhol zer na mchog gi dngos grub la bab thub kyi red gnas thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ 0000000000000255 phyag rgya chen po gnad kyi man ngag 'di// 'gro ba skal ldan snying la gnas par shog / ༈ /22/ 00000000'di smon lam red/ de 'dra po'i phyag rgya chen po de shar chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du tai lo pas nā ro pa la gsungs pa'i gnad kyi man ngag /gnad kyi man ngag zer yag de spyir phyag rgya chen po la 'dra mi 'dra mang po yod red/ yin na yang phyag rgya chen po'i gnad 'gag ngo ma de 'di yin gsungs pa red/ tshig nyung nyung don zab po/

nyams su len na tshe 'di nyid la grol thub mkhan/ lus de spang mi dgos par/ lus de ma spang par tshe 'di nyid la grol thub pa/ 'gro ba skal ldan snying la gnas par shog /'gro ba skal ldan de lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len de 'gro ba skal pa dang ldan pa thams cad kyi snying la gnas par shog /skal ldan gsungs dgos yag de gal chen po red 'dug /skal med rnams la bstan na yag po yong gi yod ma red/ dper na seng ge'i 'o ma blugs sa de rin po che'i za ma tog nang la blugs nas seng ge'i 'o ma bsdad kyi red ma gtogs de ga tsam dkar yol phal pa zhig gi nang la blugs na dkar yol chag 'gro yi red dkar yol chag song na seng ge'i 'o ma yang bo 'gro gi yod red/ de nang bzhin gyis skal pa dang ldan pa zer mkhan de gang 'dra zhig dgos kyi yod red zer na/ skal pa dang ldan pa zer mkhan de phyag rgya chen po'i don la the tshom med pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i don la spro ba yod pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i don ston mkhan gyi bla ma la mos gus yod pa/ mos gus de la thang lhod med pa/ de lta bu zhig gi skal pa dang ldan pa gcig yod na/ de'i snying la gnas par shog gsungs pa red/ de ma gtogs sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas gsungs pa nang bzhin byed nas/ rmongs pas phyag rgya che bsgom na// phal cher dud 'gro'i gnas su skye// yang na gzugs med khams su skye// gsungs pa red/ rmongs pa skal pa med mkhan zhig gis phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa yin na/ yang na dud 'gro la skye 'gro ba red/ gang dang gang yang med par nag thom mer byed nas bsgom pas der skye ba gsungs pa red/ mi rtog pa'i ngang la bsdad dgos kyi red zer nas rtog pa thams cad phar bkag dgos red zer nas bsdad pa yin na dud 'gro la skye gi red/ yang na ni 'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med pa'i khams gsum nang nas gzugs med khams nang la skye yag gi nyen kha yod red gsungs pa red/

gzugs med khams nang la yang ci yang med pa'i nang la slebs yag gi nyen kha yod pa red/ 'o de 'dra yin dus sa paṇa gyis gsungs pa de yang bden pa yod red/ de yin dus rmongs pas ma yin pa skal pa dang ldan pa skal pa mchog tu 'gyur ba'i snying la gnas par shog gsungs pa red/ 00000000 00000255 phyag rgya chen po grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal tai lo pa chen po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas la grub pa'i nā ro pas dka' ba bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i rting la chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du tai lo pas gsung pa phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i tshig rkang nyi shu rtsa dgu pa rdzogs so// nā ro pa chen po'i zhal snga nas dang*/ de nas na ro pa chen pos/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis/ byang phul+la har ri bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rdzogs so// -ithi/ dge'o// 23/ 00000000de nas na ro pa chen pos/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros la gsungs/ de gsung sa de byang phul+la har ri la gsungs pa red 'dug /de nas sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros rang nyid kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rdzogs so// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mthong zhing*// gang de'i zhal chab man ngag yang zhun la// dad dang yid ches tshul bzhin brtson pa yis// bla ma rang sems dbyer med rtogs gyur cig /ces phyag chen gaṅgā ma'i 'grel pa 'di ni 'brug spa gro stag tshang du lte ba bcad pa sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i ming tsam pa des rang gis chos bshad byas pa'i sgra 'khor nas rang nyid kyis yi ger phabs te bris pa'o/// /
